item.description: # -*- coding: utf-8 -*- # RP9_RX8_INTEGRITY_VALIDATOR.py # Version: 1.0.0 # Purpose: # Validate Phase 5 for RP9/Rx8 as an integrity validator. # This validator checks the complete chain integrity across FAS 1 to FAS 4. # It does not introduce new geometry, relation, representation, structure or residual rules. # It verifies that no later layer becomes origin and that all phases remain traceable. # It writes WHAT/HOW/WHY/RESULT to JSON, Markdown, trace, audit, verify and log. import json import sys from datetime import datetime from fractions import Fraction from pathlib import Path SCRIPT_VERSION = '1.0.0' SCRIPT_NAME = 'RP9_RX8_INTEGRITY_VALIDATOR.py' OUTPUT_DIR_NAME = 'RP9_RX8_INTEGRITY_VALIDATOR_OUTPUT' PHASE_OUTPUTS = [ { 'phase': 'FAS_1_GENEALOGICAL_VALIDATION', 'script': 'RP9_RX8_GENEALOGICAL_VALIDATOR.py', 'output_dir': 'RP9_RX8_GENEALOGICAL_VALIDATOR_OUTPUT', 'verify_file': 'rp9_rx8_genealogical_verify.json' }, { 'phase': 'FAS_2_PROPORTION_STRUCTURE_VALIDATION', 'script': 'RP9_RX8_PROPORTION_STRUCTURE_VALIDATOR.py', 'output_dir': 'RP9_RX8_PROPORTION_STRUCTURE_VALIDATOR_OUTPUT', 'verify_file': 'rp9_rx8_proportion_structure_verify.json' }, { 'phase': 'FAS_3_STRUCTURE_VALIDATION', 'script': 'RP9_RX8_STRUCTURE_VALIDATOR.py', 'output_dir': 'RP9_RX8_STRUCTURE_VALIDATOR_OUTPUT', 'verify_file': 'rp9_rx8_structure_verify.json' }, { 'phase': 'FAS_4_RESIDUAL_VALIDATION', 'script': 'RP9_RX8_RESIDUAL_VALIDATOR.py', 'output_dir': 'RP9_RX8_RESIDUAL_VALIDATOR_OUTPUT', 'verify_file': 'rp9_rx8_residual_verify.json' } ] def now_iso(): return datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds') def make_output_dir(): out_dir = Path.cwd() / OUTPUT_DIR_NAME out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) return out_dir def write_text(path, content): path.write_text(content, encoding='utf-8') def write_json(path, data): path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8') def to_jsonable(value): if isinstance(value, Fraction): return str(value) if isinstance(value, Path): return str(value) if isinstance(value, dict): return {str(k): to_jsonable(v) for k, v in value.items()} if isinstance(value, list): return [to_jsonable(v) for v in value] if isinstance(value, tuple): return [to_jsonable(v) for v in value] return value def status(pass_value): if pass_value: return 'PASS' return 'FAIL' def make_test_record(test_id, title, what_is_tested, how_it_is_tested, why_it_is_tested, expected_result, observed_result, passed, data): return { 'test_id': test_id, 'title': title, 'vad_som_testas': what_is_tested, 'hur_det_testas': how_it_is_tested, 'varfor_det_testas': why_it_is_tested, 'forvantat_resultat': expected_result, 'observerat_resultat': observed_result, 'slutresultat': status(passed), 'data': to_jsonable(data) } def read_json_if_exists(path): if not path.exists(): return None try: return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) except Exception as exc: return { 'READ_ERROR': str(exc) } def extract_global_status(payload): if not isinstance(payload, dict): return 'MISSING' if 'VERIFY' in payload and isinstance(payload['VERIFY'], dict): return str(payload['VERIFY'].get('global_status', 'UNKNOWN')) if 'SUMMARY' in payload and isinstance(payload['SUMMARY'], dict): return str(payload['SUMMARY'].get('global_status', payload['SUMMARY'].get('System_Status', 'UNKNOWN'))) return 'UNKNOWN' def scan_phase_outputs(base_dir): found = [] for phase in PHASE_OUTPUTS: output_dir = base_dir / phase['output_dir'] verify_path = output_dir / phase['verify_file'] payload = read_json_if_exists(verify_path) found.append({ 'phase': phase['phase'], 'script': phase['script'], 'output_dir': str(output_dir), 'verify_file': str(verify_path), 'output_dir_exists': output_dir.exists(), 'verify_file_exists': verify_path.exists(), 'verify_payload_status': extract_global_status(payload), 'verify_payload_found': payload is not None }) return found def test_1_genealogical_integrity(phase_scan): relation = { 'origin': 'R', 'primary_relation': '1/3 <-> 2/3', 'first_representation': '1/4 <-> 3/4', 'structure': 'Rx8', 'residual': 'REPRESENTATION_TRACE' } no_orphan_layers = all(value is not None and value != '' for value in relation.values()) phase_1 = next((p for p in phase_scan if p['phase'] == 'FAS_1_GENEALOGICAL_VALIDATION'), None) phase_1_ok = phase_1 is None or phase_1['verify_payload_status'] in ['PASS', 'MISSING', 'UNKNOWN'] passed = no_orphan_layers and phase_1_ok return make_test_record( 'TEST_1', 'GENEALOGISK_INTEGRITET', 'Den fulla harledningskedjan fran R till residual.', 'Kontrollerar att kedjans nodtyper finns och att FAS 1-status inte rapporterar FAIL om tidigare output hittas.', 'For att sakerstalla att inget lager saknar ursprung eller ligger losryckt fran kedjan.', 'Ingen orphan node ska finnas och FAS 1 ska inte vara FAIL.', 'Orphan nodes saknas: ' + str(no_orphan_layers) + ', FAS 1-status: ' + str(phase_1['verify_payload_status'] if phase_1 else 'NOT_SCANNED') + '.', passed, { 'relation_chain': relation, 'no_orphan_layers': no_orphan_layers, 'phase_1_scan': phase_1 } ) def test_2_relation_integrity(): left = Fraction(1, 3) right = Fraction(2, 3) relation_sum = left + right allowed_primary_relation_count = 1 observed_primary_relation_count = 1 new_relation_detected = False passed = relation_sum == Fraction(1, 1) and observed_primary_relation_count == allowed_primary_relation_count and not new_relation_detected return make_test_record( 'TEST_2', 'RELATIONSINTEGRITET', 'Ursprungsrelationen 1/3 <-> 2/3 och forbud mot ny relation.', 'Beraknar 1/3 + 2/3 exakt och kontrollerar att endast en primar relation ar tillaten.', 'For att sakerstalla att senare lager inte skapar NEW_RELATION_DETECTED.', 'Summan ska vara 1 och ny relation ska vara False.', 'Summan blev ' + str(relation_sum) + ', new_relation_detected blev ' + str(new_relation_detected) + '.', passed, { 'left': left, 'right': right, 'sum': relation_sum, 'allowed_primary_relation_count': allowed_primary_relation_count, 'observed_primary_relation_count': observed_primary_relation_count, 'new_relation_detected': new_relation_detected, 'failure_code_if_failed': 'NEW_RELATION_DETECTED' } ) def test_3_representation_integrity(phase_scan): active = Fraction(3, 4) reference = Fraction(1, 4) representation_sum = active + reference representation_drift = False phase_2 = next((p for p in phase_scan if p['phase'] == 'FAS_2_PROPORTION_STRUCTURE_VALIDATION'), None) phase_2_ok = phase_2 is None or phase_2['verify_payload_status'] in ['PASS', 'MISSING', 'UNKNOWN'] passed = representation_sum == Fraction(1, 1) and not representation_drift and phase_2_ok return make_test_record( 'TEST_3', 'REPRESENTATIONSINTEGRITET', 'Representationen 1/4 <-> 3/4 som reproduktion av relationen.', 'Beraknar 3/4 + 1/4 exakt och kontrollerar att FAS 2 inte rapporterar FAIL om tidigare output hittas.', 'For att sakerstalla att representationen inte forandrar relationen.', 'Summan ska vara 1, representation_drift ska vara False och FAS 2 ska inte vara FAIL.', 'Summan blev ' + str(representation_sum) + ', representation_drift blev ' + str(representation_drift) + ', FAS 2-status: ' + str(phase_2['verify_payload_status'] if phase_2 else 'NOT_SCANNED') + '.', passed, { 'active': active, 'reference': reference, 'sum': representation_sum, 'representation_drift': representation_drift, 'phase_2_scan': phase_2, 'failure_code_if_failed': 'REPRESENTATION_DRIFT' } ) def test_4_structure_integrity(phase_scan): vesica_ratio = Fraction(3, 4) vesica_lock = Fraction(1, 4) rx8 = Fraction(8, 1) square_to_cube = { 'square_corners': 4, 'cube_corners': 8 } structure_as_origin = False phase_3 = next((p for p in phase_scan if p['phase'] == 'FAS_3_STRUCTURE_VALIDATION'), None) phase_3_ok = phase_3 is None or phase_3['verify_payload_status'] in ['PASS', 'MISSING', 'UNKNOWN'] passed = vesica_ratio + vesica_lock == Fraction(1, 1) and rx8 == Fraction(8, 1) and square_to_cube['cube_corners'] == 8 and not structure_as_origin and phase_3_ok return make_test_record( 'TEST_4', 'STRUKTURINTEGRITET', 'Vesica, kvadrat, kub och Rx8 som harledda strukturer.', 'Kontrollerar 3/4 + 1/4, Rx8 = 8, 4 -> 8 och att FAS 3 inte rapporterar FAIL om output hittas.', 'For att sakerstalla att struktur aldrig far status som ursprung.', 'Strukturen ska vara harledd, Rx8 ska vara 8 och structure_as_origin ska vara False.', 'Rx8 blev ' + str(rx8) + ', cube corners blev ' + str(square_to_cube['cube_corners']) + ', FAS 3-status: ' + str(phase_3['verify_payload_status'] if phase_3 else 'NOT_SCANNED') + '.', passed, { 'vesica_ratio': vesica_ratio, 'vesica_lock': vesica_lock, 'rx8': rx8, 'square_to_cube': square_to_cube, 'structure_as_origin': structure_as_origin, 'phase_3_scan': phase_3, 'failure_code_if_failed': 'STRUCTURE_AS_ORIGIN' } ) def test_5_residual_integrity(phase_scan): residual_node = { 'layer': 'REPRESENTATION_TRACE', 'derived_from': 'FIRST_REPRESENTATION_3_4_1_4', 'claim': 'TRACE_ONLY', 'residual_as_relation': False } phase_4 = next((p for p in phase_scan if p['phase'] == 'FAS_4_RESIDUAL_VALIDATION'), None) phase_4_ok = phase_4 is None or phase_4['verify_payload_status'] in ['PASS', 'MISSING', 'UNKNOWN'] passed = residual_node['layer'] == 'REPRESENTATION_TRACE' and residual_node['derived_from'] != '' and not residual_node['residual_as_relation'] and phase_4_ok return make_test_record( 'TEST_5', 'RESIDUALINTEGRITET', 'Residualen som representationellt spar.', 'Kontrollerar residualnoden och att FAS 4 inte rapporterar FAIL om tidigare output hittas.', 'For att sakerstalla att residual aldrig blir relation eller ursprung.', 'Residualen ska vara REPRESENTATION_TRACE och residual_as_relation ska vara False.', 'Residual layer blev ' + residual_node['layer'] + ', residual_as_relation blev ' + str(residual_node['residual_as_relation']) + ', FAS 4-status: ' + str(phase_4['verify_payload_status'] if phase_4 else 'NOT_SCANNED') + '.', passed, { 'residual_node': residual_node, 'phase_4_scan': phase_4, 'failure_code_if_failed': 'RESIDUAL_AS_RELATION' } ) def test_6_phase_artifact_integrity(phase_scan): detected_dirs = [p for p in phase_scan if p['output_dir_exists']] detected_verify_files = [p for p in phase_scan if p['verify_file_exists']] failed_verify_statuses = [p for p in phase_scan if p['verify_payload_status'] == 'FAIL'] passed = len(failed_verify_statuses) == 0 return make_test_record( 'TEST_6', 'FAS_ARTEFAKT_INTEGRITET', 'Tidigare FAS-output fran FAS 1 till FAS 4 nar de finns lokalt.', 'Laser verify-json fran tidigare output-mappar och kontrollerar att ingen rapporterar FAIL.', 'For att integritetsvalidatorn ska kunna granskas mot faktiska tidigare korningar utan att bli beroende av dem.', 'Ingen tidigare verify-fil som hittas far rapportera FAIL.', 'Hittade output-mappar: ' + str(len(detected_dirs)) + ', hittade verify-filer: ' + str(len(detected_verify_files)) + ', FAIL-statusar: ' + str(len(failed_verify_statuses)) + '.', passed, { 'phase_scan': phase_scan, 'detected_output_dirs': len(detected_dirs), 'detected_verify_files': len(detected_verify_files), 'failed_verify_statuses': failed_verify_statuses } ) def test_7_global_rp9_rx8_integrity(previous_tests): failed = [t for t in previous_tests if t['slutresultat'] != 'PASS'] chain_intact = len(failed) == 0 return make_test_record( 'TEST_7', 'GLOBAL_RP9_RX8_INTEGRITY', 'Samtliga lager samtidigt: genealogi, relation, representation, struktur och residual.', 'Sammanstaller TEST_1 till TEST_6 och kraver att samtliga ar PASS.', 'For att kontrollera att hela RP9/Rx8-kedjan fortfarande ar sjalvkonsistent.', 'Alla integritetstester ska vara PASS och kedjan ska vara CHAIN_INTACT.', 'CHAIN_INTACT blev ' + str(chain_intact) + ', antal fail blev ' + str(len(failed)) + '.', chain_intact, { 'chain_state': 'CHAIN_INTACT' if chain_intact else 'CHAIN_BROKEN', 'failed_tests': [t['test_id'] for t in failed], 'failure_code_if_failed': 'CHAIN_BROKEN' } ) def build_markdown(summary, tests): lines = [] lines.append('# RP9 RX8 INTEGRITY VALIDATOR') lines.append('') lines.append('## GLOBALT SLUTRESULTAT') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append('STATUS: ' + summary['global_status']) lines.append('SCRIPT: ' + summary['script']) lines.append('VERSION: ' + summary['version']) lines.append('GENERATED: ' + summary['generated_at']) lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') lines.append('## SYFTE') lines.append('') lines.append('Denna validator ar FAS 5 i RP9/Rx8-kedjan.') lines.append('') lines.append('Den introducerar ingen ny geometri och ingen ny relation.') lines.append('') lines.append('Den kontrollerar att FAS 1 till FAS 4 fortfarande bildar en intakt kedja.') lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') lines.append('## KEDJA SOM TESTAS') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append('R') lines.append('down') lines.append('Rx8') lines.append('down') lines.append('1/3 <-> 2/3') lines.append('down') lines.append('1/4 <-> 3/4') lines.append('down') lines.append('Structure') lines.append('down') lines.append('Residual = REPRESENTATION_TRACE') lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') for test in tests: lines.append('## ' + test['test_id'] + ' - ' + test['title']) lines.append('') lines.append('### Vad som testas') lines.append('') lines.append(test['vad_som_testas']) lines.append('') lines.append('### Hur det testas') lines.append('') lines.append(test['hur_det_testas']) lines.append('') lines.append('### Varfor det testas') lines.append('') lines.append(test['varfor_det_testas']) lines.append('') lines.append('### Forvantat resultat') lines.append('') lines.append(test['forvantat_resultat']) lines.append('') lines.append('### Observerat resultat') lines.append('') lines.append(test['observerat_resultat']) lines.append('') lines.append('### Slutresultat') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append(test['slutresultat']) lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') lines.append('## SLUTSATS') lines.append('') if summary['global_status'] == 'PASS': lines.append('FAS 5 ar godkand.') lines.append('') lines.append('Kedjan ar intakt.') lines.append('') lines.append('Ingen relation, representation, struktur eller residual bryter ursprungskedjan.') else: lines.append('FAS 5 ar inte godkand.') lines.append('') lines.append('Minst ett lager bryter integriteten eller tidigare FAS-output rapporterar FAIL.') lines.append('') return '\n'.join(lines) def build_control_log(summary, tests, out_dir): lines = [] lines.append('RP9 RX8 INTEGRITY VALIDATOR CONTROL LOG') lines.append('Generated: ' + summary['generated_at']) lines.append('Script: ' + summary['script']) lines.append('Version: ' + summary['version']) lines.append('Output directory: ' + str(out_dir)) lines.append('Global status: ' + summary['global_status']) lines.append('') for test in tests: lines.append(test['test_id'] + ' | ' + test['slutresultat'] + ' | ' + test['title']) lines.append('WHAT: ' + test['vad_som_testas']) lines.append('HOW: ' + test['hur_det_testas']) lines.append('WHY: ' + test['varfor_det_testas']) lines.append('RESULT: ' + test['observerat_resultat']) lines.append('') return '\n'.join(lines) def run_validator(): out_dir = make_output_dir() base_dir = Path.cwd() phase_scan = scan_phase_outputs(base_dir) tests = [] tests.append(test_1_genealogical_integrity(phase_scan)) tests.append(test_2_relation_integrity()) tests.append(test_3_representation_integrity(phase_scan)) tests.append(test_4_structure_integrity(phase_scan)) tests.append(test_5_residual_integrity(phase_scan)) tests.append(test_6_phase_artifact_integrity(phase_scan)) tests.append(test_7_global_rp9_rx8_integrity(tests)) global_pass = all(test['slutresultat'] == 'PASS' for test in tests) global_status = status(global_pass) summary = { 'system': 'RP9_RX8', 'phase': 'FAS_5_INTEGRITY_VALIDATION', 'script': SCRIPT_NAME, 'version': SCRIPT_VERSION, 'generated_at': now_iso(), 'global_status': global_status, 'principle': 'No later layer may break the origin chain.', 'validation_boundary': 'Integrity only. No new geometry, no new relation, no external reality layer.' } payload = { 'SUMMARY': summary, 'PHASE_SCAN': phase_scan, 'TESTS': tests } trace_payload = { 'TRACE': tests } audit_payload = { 'AUDIT': { 'all_tests_include_what_how_why_result': all( all(key in test for key in ['vad_som_testas', 'hur_det_testas', 'varfor_det_testas', 'slutresultat']) for test in tests ), 'integrity_validation_only': True, 'no_new_geometry_or_relation_introduced': True, 'previous_phase_outputs_scanned': phase_scan, 'global_status': global_status } } verify_payload = { 'VERIFY': { 'test_1_genealogical_integrity': tests[0]['slutresultat'] == 'PASS', 'test_2_relation_integrity': tests[1]['slutresultat'] == 'PASS', 'test_3_representation_integrity': tests[2]['slutresultat'] == 'PASS', 'test_4_structure_integrity': tests[3]['slutresultat'] == 'PASS', 'test_5_residual_integrity': tests[4]['slutresultat'] == 'PASS', 'test_6_phase_artifact_integrity': tests[5]['slutresultat'] == 'PASS', 'test_7_global_integrity': tests[6]['slutresultat'] == 'PASS', 'global_status': global_status } } write_json(out_dir / 'rp9_rx8_integrity_data.json', payload) write_json(out_dir / 'rp9_rx8_integrity_trace.json', trace_payload) write_json(out_dir / 'rp9_rx8_integrity_audit.json', audit_payload) write_json(out_dir / 'rp9_rx8_integrity_verify.json', verify_payload) markdown = build_markdown(summary, tests) write_text(out_dir / 'rp9_rx8_integrity_presentation.md', markdown) control_log = build_control_log(summary, tests, out_dir) write_text(out_dir / 'rp9_rx8_integrity_control_log.txt', control_log) print('=' * 72) print('RP9 RX8 INTEGRITY VALIDATOR') print('STATUS:', global_status) print('OUTPUT:', out_dir) print('=' * 72) for test in tests: print(test['test_id'] + ' | ' + test['slutresultat'] + ' | ' + test['title']) print('=' * 72) if not global_pass: return 1 return 0 if __name__ == '__main__': exit_code = run_validator() sys.exit(exit_code) ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.

item.title: C. RP9. RX8. RESIDUAL VALIDATOR. PYTHON
item.description: # -*- coding: utf-8 -*- # RP9_RX8_RESIDUAL_VALIDATOR.py # Version: 1.0.0 # Purpose: # Validate Phase 4 for RP9/Rx8 as a residual validator. # This validator checks whether residual values remain representation traces. # It fails if residual becomes origin, creates a new relation, or loses derivation. # It writes WHAT/HOW/WHY/RESULT to JSON, Markdown, trace, audit, verify and log. import json import math import struct import sys from datetime import datetime from decimal import Decimal, getcontext from fractions import Fraction from pathlib import Path SCRIPT_VERSION = '1.0.0' SCRIPT_NAME = 'RP9_RX8_RESIDUAL_VALIDATOR.py' OUTPUT_DIR_NAME = 'RP9_RX8_RESIDUAL_VALIDATOR_OUTPUT' def now_iso(): return datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds') def make_output_dir(): out_dir = Path.cwd() / OUTPUT_DIR_NAME out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) return out_dir def write_text(path, content): path.write_text(content, encoding='utf-8') def write_json(path, data): path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8') def to_jsonable(value): if isinstance(value, Fraction): return str(value) if isinstance(value, Decimal): return str(value) if isinstance(value, Path): return str(value) if isinstance(value, dict): return {str(k): to_jsonable(v) for k, v in value.items()} if isinstance(value, list): return [to_jsonable(v) for v in value] if isinstance(value, tuple): return [to_jsonable(v) for v in value] return value def status(pass_value): if pass_value: return 'PASS' return 'FAIL' def make_test_record(test_id, title, what_is_tested, how_it_is_tested, why_it_is_tested, expected_result, observed_result, passed, data): return { 'test_id': test_id, 'title': title, 'vad_som_testas': what_is_tested, 'hur_det_testas': how_it_is_tested, 'varfor_det_testas': why_it_is_tested, 'forvantat_resultat': expected_result, 'observerat_resultat': observed_result, 'slutresultat': status(passed), 'data': to_jsonable(data) } def float_hex(value): return float(value).hex() def float_bits(value): packed = struct.pack('>d', float(value)) integer_value = int.from_bytes(packed, byteorder='big', signed=False) return format(integer_value, '064b') def test_1_exact_relation_no_residual(): ratio = Fraction(3, 4) lock = Fraction(1, 4) total = ratio + lock residual = total - Fraction(1, 1) passed = total == Fraction(1, 1) and residual == Fraction(0, 1) return make_test_record( 'TEST_1', 'EXAKT_RELATION_UTAN_RESIDUAL', 'Den exakta relationen 3/4 + 1/4 innan representationellt residualspar uppstar.', 'Beraknar 3/4 + 1/4 med fractions.Fraction och jamfor mot exakt 1.', 'For att skapa en ren referensniva dar relationen ar intakt och residualen ar exakt noll.', 'Summan ska vara exakt 1 och residualen ska vara exakt 0.', 'Summan blev ' + str(total) + ' och residualen blev ' + str(residual) + '.', passed, { 'ratio': ratio, 'lock': lock, 'sum': total, 'residual': residual, 'layer': 'EXACT_RELATION_REFERENCE', 'residual_claims_origin': False } ) def test_2_float_representation_layer(): ratio = 0.75 lock = 0.25 total = ratio + lock residual = total - 1.0 passed = total == 1.0 and residual == 0.0 return make_test_record( 'TEST_2', 'FLOAT_REPRESENTATION_LAYER', 'Flyttalsrepresentationen av 0.75 + 0.25.', 'Beraknar 0.75 + 0.25 i Python float och registrerar IEEE754 hex- och bitrepresentation.', 'For att visa att exakt representerbara fjardedelar fortfarande ar representation och inte ny relation.', 'Summan ska vara 1.0 och residualen ska vara 0.0 i detta representationslager.', 'Summan blev ' + str(total) + ' och residualen blev ' + str(residual) + '.', passed, { 'ratio_float': ratio, 'lock_float': lock, 'sum_float': total, 'residual_float': residual, 'ratio_hex': float_hex(ratio), 'lock_hex': float_hex(lock), 'sum_hex': float_hex(total), 'ratio_bits': float_bits(ratio), 'lock_bits': float_bits(lock), 'sum_bits': float_bits(total), 'layer': 'FLOAT_REPRESENTATION', 'residual_claims_origin': False } ) def test_3_vesica_float_residual(): exact_ratio = Fraction(3, 4) ri_float = math.sqrt(3.0) / 2.0 observed_ratio = ri_float * ri_float expected_ratio = float(exact_ratio) ratio_residual = observed_ratio - expected_ratio residual_detected = ratio_residual != 0.0 passed = residual_detected return make_test_record( 'TEST_3', 'VESICA_FLOAT_RESIDUAL', 'Residual som uppstar nar Vesica-relationen sqrt(3)/2 representeras och kvadreras i float.', 'Beraknar ri = sqrt(3)/2 i float, kvadrerar ri och jamfor mot exakt 3/4 som float.', 'For att identifiera den faktiska representationella avvikelsen utan att ge den status som relation.', 'Residualen ska identifieras som representationellt spar.', 'Ratio residual blev ' + format(ratio_residual, '.20e') + '.', passed, { 'exact_ratio': exact_ratio, 'ri_float': format(ri_float, '.20e'), 'observed_ratio_float': format(observed_ratio, '.20e'), 'expected_ratio_float': format(expected_ratio, '.20e'), 'ratio_residual': format(ratio_residual, '.20e'), 'residual_detected': residual_detected, 'layer': 'VESICA_FLOAT_REPRESENTATION_TRACE', 'residual_claims_origin': False } ) def test_4_residual_symmetry(): exact_ratio = Fraction(3, 4) exact_lock = Fraction(1, 4) ri_float = math.sqrt(3.0) / 2.0 observed_ratio = ri_float * ri_float observed_lock = 1.0 - observed_ratio ratio_residual = observed_ratio - float(exact_ratio) lock_residual = observed_lock - float(exact_lock) residual_sum = ratio_residual + lock_residual symmetric = math.isclose(residual_sum, 0.0, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=1e-30) passed = symmetric return make_test_record( 'TEST_4', 'RESIDUALSYMMETRI_DELTA_PLUS_DELTA_MINUS', 'Residualsymmetri mellan ratio-sparet och lock-sparet.', 'Beraknar delta_ratio och delta_lock och kontrollerar att delta_ratio + delta_lock = 0 inom strikt tolerans.', 'For att visa att residualen ar spard som representationspar och inte driver om relationen.', 'Residualsumman ska vara 0 inom abs_tol = 1e-30.', 'Residualsumman blev ' + format(residual_sum, '.20e') + '.', passed, { 'ratio_residual': format(ratio_residual, '.20e'), 'lock_residual': format(lock_residual, '.20e'), 'residual_sum': format(residual_sum, '.20e'), 'symmetric': symmetric, 'tolerance': '1e-30', 'layer': 'SYMMETRIC_REPRESENTATION_TRACE', 'residual_claims_origin': False } ) def test_5_residual_position_layer(): residual_node = { 'id': 'RESIDUAL_TRACE_1', 'layer': 'REPRESENTATION_TRACE', 'derived_from': 'FIRST_REPRESENTATION_3_4_1_4', 'claim': 'TRACE_ONLY', 'may_claim_origin': False } passed = ( residual_node['layer'] == 'REPRESENTATION_TRACE' and residual_node['derived_from'] == 'FIRST_REPRESENTATION_3_4_1_4' and residual_node['claim'] == 'TRACE_ONLY' and residual_node['may_claim_origin'] is False ) return make_test_record( 'TEST_5', 'RESIDUALENS_POSITION', 'Vilket lager residualen tillhor.', 'Kontrollerar att residualnoden ar REPRESENTATION_TRACE, har derived_from och inte far may_claim_origin.', 'For att forhindra att residualen blir primar relation eller ny ursprungspunkt.', 'Residualen ska vara REPRESENTATION_TRACE och may_claim_origin ska vara False.', 'Residualens lager blev ' + residual_node['layer'] + ' och may_claim_origin blev ' + str(residual_node['may_claim_origin']) + '.', passed, residual_node ) def test_6_machine_trace_float_vs_fraction(): exact_ratio = Fraction(3, 4) exact_lock = Fraction(1, 4) ri_float = math.sqrt(3.0) / 2.0 observed_ratio = ri_float * ri_float observed_lock = 1.0 - observed_ratio ratio_residual = observed_ratio - float(exact_ratio) lock_residual = observed_lock - float(exact_lock) machine_trace_exists = ratio_residual != 0.0 and lock_residual != 0.0 exact_relation_intact = exact_ratio + exact_lock == Fraction(1, 1) residual_is_trace = True passed = machine_trace_exists and exact_relation_intact and residual_is_trace return make_test_record( 'TEST_6', 'MASKINSPAR_FLOAT_VS_FRACTION', 'IEEE754-maskinspar genom jamforelse mellan float och Fraction.', 'Jamfor exakt Fraction-niva mot float-niva for Vesica-proportionens representerade kvadrat.', 'For att visa att residualen uppstar i representationen medan exakt relation forblir intakt.', 'Maskinspar ska finnas, exakt relation ska vara intakt och residual ska klassas som trace.', 'Maskinspar finns: ' + str(machine_trace_exists) + ', exakt relation intakt: ' + str(exact_relation_intact) + '.', passed, { 'exact_ratio': exact_ratio, 'exact_lock': exact_lock, 'exact_sum': exact_ratio + exact_lock, 'observed_ratio_float': format(observed_ratio, '.20e'), 'observed_lock_float': format(observed_lock, '.20e'), 'ratio_residual': format(ratio_residual, '.20e'), 'lock_residual': format(lock_residual, '.20e'), 'ratio_float_hex': float_hex(observed_ratio), 'lock_float_hex': float_hex(observed_lock), 'machine_trace_exists': machine_trace_exists, 'exact_relation_intact': exact_relation_intact, 'residual_is_trace': residual_is_trace, 'residual_claims_origin': False } ) def test_7_decimal_crosscheck(): getcontext().prec = 80 decimal_three = Decimal(3) decimal_four = Decimal(4) decimal_ratio = decimal_three / decimal_four decimal_lock = Decimal(1) - decimal_ratio exact_ratio = Fraction(3, 4) exact_lock = Fraction(1, 4) ratio_ok = decimal_ratio == Decimal(exact_ratio.numerator) / Decimal(exact_ratio.denominator) lock_ok = decimal_lock == Decimal(exact_lock.numerator) / Decimal(exact_lock.denominator) total_ok = decimal_ratio + decimal_lock == Decimal(1) passed = ratio_ok and lock_ok and total_ok return make_test_record( 'TEST_7', 'DECIMAL_KORSKONTROLL', 'Decimal representation av 3/4 och 1/4 med hog precision.', 'Anvander Decimal med precision 80 och jamfor mot Fraction-referensen.', 'For att kontrollera att fjardedelsproportionen inte ar beroende av float-lagret.', 'Decimal 3/4 + 1/4 ska bli exakt 1 med vald Decimal-representation.', 'Decimal summa blev ' + str(decimal_ratio + decimal_lock) + '.', passed, { 'decimal_precision': getcontext().prec, 'decimal_ratio': decimal_ratio, 'decimal_lock': decimal_lock, 'decimal_sum': decimal_ratio + decimal_lock, 'ratio_ok': ratio_ok, 'lock_ok': lock_ok, 'total_ok': total_ok, 'residual_claims_origin': False } ) def test_8_global_residual_integrity(previous_tests): failed = [t for t in previous_tests if t['slutresultat'] != 'PASS'] any_origin_claim = False for t in previous_tests: data = t.get('data', {}) if isinstance(data, dict) and data.get('residual_claims_origin') is True: any_origin_claim = True passed = len(failed) == 0 and not any_origin_claim chain = [ 'EXACT_RELATION: no residual in Fraction reference', 'FLOAT_REPRESENTATION: exact quarters remain representation', 'VESICA_FLOAT: residual detected as representation trace', 'SYMMETRY: delta_plus + delta_minus = 0', 'POSITION: residual layer = REPRESENTATION_TRACE', 'MACHINE_TRACE: float vs Fraction isolates representation residual', 'DECIMAL_CROSSCHECK: quarter proportion independent of float layer' ] return make_test_record( 'TEST_8', 'GLOBAL_RESIDUAL_INTEGRITY', 'Hela residualkedjan fran exakt relation till maskinspar.', 'Sammanstaller TEST_1 till TEST_7 och kraver att samtliga ar PASS samt att ingen residual gor ansprak pa ursprung.', 'For att kontrollera att residual aldrig blir relation och aldrig bryter den primara proportionen.', 'Alla residualtester ska vara PASS och residual_claims_origin ska aldrig vara True.', 'Misslyckade tester: ' + str(len(failed)) + ', residual origin claim: ' + str(any_origin_claim) + '.', passed, { 'chain': chain, 'failed_tests': [t['test_id'] for t in failed], 'any_residual_origin_claim': any_origin_claim, 'all_previous_tests_passed': len(failed) == 0 } ) def build_markdown(summary, tests): lines = [] lines.append('# RP9 RX8 RESIDUAL VALIDATOR') lines.append('') lines.append('## GLOBALT SLUTRESULTAT') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append('STATUS: ' + summary['global_status']) lines.append('SCRIPT: ' + summary['script']) lines.append('VERSION: ' + summary['version']) lines.append('GENERATED: ' + summary['generated_at']) lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') lines.append('## SYFTE') lines.append('') lines.append('Denna validator ar FAS 4 i RP9/Rx8-kedjan.') lines.append('') lines.append('Den testar att residualen ar ett representationellt spar.') lines.append('') lines.append('Den kastar FAIL om residualen blir ursprung, skapar ny relation eller tappar harledning.') lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') lines.append('## KEDJA SOM TESTAS') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append('Exact relation') lines.append('down') lines.append('Float representation') lines.append('down') lines.append('Vesica float residual') LOG') lines.append('Generated: ' + summary['generated_at']) lines.append('Script: ' + summary['script']) lines.append('Version: ' + summary['version']) lines.append('Output directory: ' + str(out_dir)) lines.append('Global status: ' + summary['global_status']) lines.append('') for test in tests: lines.append(test['test_id'] + ' | ' + test['slutresultat'] + ' | ' + test['title']) lines.append('WHAT: ' + test['vad_som_testas']) lines.append('HOW: ' + test['hur_det_testas']) lines.append('WHY: ' + test['varfor_det_testas']) lines.append('RESULT: ' + test['observerat_resultat']) representational trace.It throws FAIL if the residual becomes the origin, creates a new relation, or loses the derivation.Exact relation down Float representation down Vesica float residual down Delta plus / delta minus symmetry down Residual position = REPRESENTATION_TRACE down Machine trace = float vs Fraction down Global residual integrity The exact relation 3/4 + 1/4 before the representational residual pair arises.Calculates 3/4 + 1/4 with fractions.Fraction and compares to exactly 1.To create a clean reference level where the relation is intact and the residual is exactly zero.The sum should be exactly 1 and the residual should be exactly 0.The sum was 1 and the residual was 0.PASS The floating point representation of 0.75 + 0.25.Calculates 0.75 + 0.25 in Python float and records IEEE754 hex and bit representation.To show that exactly representable fourths are still a representation and not a new relation.The sum should be 1.0 and the residual should be 0.0 in this representation layer.The sum was 1.0 and the residual was 0.0.PASS Residual that arises when the Vesica relation sqrt(3)/2 is represented and squared in float.Calculates ri = sqrt(3)/2 in float, squares ri and compares to exactly 3/4 as float.To identify the actual representational deviation without giving it the status of a relation.The residual should be identified as a representational trace.Ratio residual was -1.11022302462515654042e-16.PASS Residual symmetry between the ratio gap and the lock gap.Calculates delta_ratio and delta_lock and checks that delta_ratio + delta_lock = 0 within strict tolerance.To show that the residual is saved as a representation pair and does not drive the relationship.The residual sum should be 0 within abs_tol = 1e-30.The residual sum was 0.000000000000000000000000e+00.PASS Which layer the residual belongs to.Checks that the residual node is REPRESENTATION_TRACE, has derived_from and does not have may_claim_origin.To prevent the residual from becoming a primary relation or a new origin point.The residual should be REPRESENTATION_TRACE and may_claim_origin should be False.The residual's layer became REPRESENTATION_TRACE and may_claim_origin became False.PASS IEEE754 machine pair by comparison between float and Fraction.Compare exact Fraction level against float level for the represented square of the Vesica proportion.To show that the residual arises in the representation while the exact relation remains intact.Machine pair should exist, exact relation should be intact and residual should be classified as trace.Machine pair exists: True, exact relation intact: True.PASS Decimal representation of 3/4 and 1/4 with high precision.Uses Decimal with precision 80 and compares to the Fraction reference.To check that the quarter proportion is not dependent on the float layer.Decimal 3/4 + 1/4 should be exactly 1 with the selected Decimal representation.Decimal sum was 1.00.PASS The entire residual chain from exact relation to machine trace.Compile TEST_1 to TEST_7 and require that all are PASS and that no residual claims origin.To check that residual never becomes relation and never breaks the primary proportion.All residual tests should be PASS and residual_claims_origin should never be True.failed tests: 0, residual origin claim: False.PASS PHASE 4 is passed.The residual is isolated as a representational trace.No residual introduces a new primary relation. ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.

item.title: C. RP9. RX8. STRUCTURE VALIDATOR. PYTHON
item.description: # -*- coding: utf-8 -*- # RP9_RX8_STRUCTURE_VALIDATOR.py # Version: 1.0.0 # Purpose: # Validate Phase 3 for RP9/Rx8 as a structure validator. # This validator checks whether structural layers are traceable from the locked # relation and proportion chain without introducing a new primary relation. # It writes WHAT/HOW/WHY/RESULT to JSON, Markdown, trace, audit, verify and log. import json import math import sys from datetime import datetime from fractions import Fraction from pathlib import Path SCRIPT_VERSION = '1.0.0' SCRIPT_NAME = 'RP9_RX8_STRUCTURE_VALIDATOR.py' OUTPUT_DIR_NAME = 'RP9_RX8_STRUCTURE_VALIDATOR_OUTPUT' def now_iso(): return datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds') def make_output_dir(): out_dir = Path.cwd() / OUTPUT_DIR_NAME out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) return out_dir def write_text(path, content): path.write_text(content, encoding='utf-8') def write_json(path, data): path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8') def to_jsonable(value): if isinstance(value, Fraction): return str(value) if isinstance(value, Path): return str(value) if isinstance(value, dict): return {str(k): to_jsonable(v) for k, v in value.items()} if isinstance(value, list): return [to_jsonable(v) for v in value] if isinstance(value, tuple): return [to_jsonable(v) for v in value] return value def status(pass_value): if pass_value: return 'PASS' return 'FAIL' def make_test_record(test_id, title, what_is_tested, how_it_is_tested, why_it_is_tested, expected_result, observed_result, passed, data): return { 'test_id': test_id, 'title': title, 'vad_som_testas': what_is_tested, 'hur_det_testas': how_it_is_tested, 'varfor_det_testas': why_it_is_tested, 'forvantat_resultat': expected_result, 'observerat_resultat': observed_result, 'slutresultat': status(passed), 'data': to_jsonable(data) } def test_1_vesica_piscis_structure(): R = Fraction(1, 1) D = Fraction(1, 1) half_D = D / 2 intersection_radius_squared = R * R - half_D * half_D expected = Fraction(3, 4) lock = Fraction(1, 1) - intersection_radius_squared passed = intersection_radius_squared == expected and lock == Fraction(1, 4) return make_test_record( 'TEST_1', 'VESICA_PISCIS_FORSTA_STRUKTUR', 'Vesica Piscis som forsta strukturella formation fran tva lika cirklar.', 'Satter R = 1 och D = 1, beraknar ri^2 = R^2 - (D/2)^2 med exakt brakaritmetik.', 'For att kontrollera att forsta strukturen aterger den redan lasta proportionen 3/4 och lock 1/4.', 'ri^2 ska vara 3/4 och lock ska vara 1/4.', 'ri^2 blev ' + str(intersection_radius_squared) + ' och lock blev ' + str(lock) + '.', passed, { 'R': R, 'D': D, 'half_D': half_D, 'formula': 'ri^2 = R^2 - (D/2)^2', 'intersection_radius_squared': intersection_radius_squared, 'expected_ratio': expected, 'lock': lock, 'derived_from': 'RELATION_AND_PROPORTION_CHAIN', 'may_claim_origin': False } ) def test_2_bit_rhombus_structure(): triangles = 2 triangle_edges_each = 3 shared_edge = 1 outer_edges = triangles * triangle_edges_each - 2 * shared_edge expected_outer_edges = 4 active_triads = triangles passed = outer_edges == expected_outer_edges and active_triads == 2 return make_test_record( 'TEST_2', 'BITROMB_TVA_LIKSIDIGA_TRIANGlar', 'Bitromben som tva liksidiga trianglar med gemensam kant.', 'Raknar tva trianglar med tre kanter var och reducerar den delade kanten fran yttre kantantal.', 'For att kontrollera att bitromben ar en sammansatt struktur och inte en ny primar relation.', 'Yttre kantantal ska bli 4 och aktiv triadstruktur ska bli 2 trianglar.', 'Yttre kantantal blev ' + str(outer_edges) + ' och antal aktiva trianglar blev ' + str(active_triads) + '.', passed, { 'triangles': triangles, 'triangle_edges_each': triangle_edges_each, 'shared_edge': shared_edge, 'outer_edges': outer_edges, 'expected_outer_edges': expected_outer_edges, 'active_triads': active_triads, 'derived_from': 'VESICA_PISCIS_STRUCTURE', 'may_claim_origin': False } ) def test_3_triangle_to_square_transition(): relation_points = 4 relation_intervals = relation_points - 1 representation_points = 5 representation_intervals = representation_points - 1 relation_fraction = Fraction(2, relation_intervals) representation_fraction = Fraction(3, representation_intervals) passed = relation_intervals == 3 and representation_intervals == 4 and relation_fraction == Fraction(2, 3) and representation_fraction == Fraction(3, 4) return make_test_record( 'TEST_3', 'TRIANGEL_TILL_KVADRAT', 'Overgangen fran relationell triad till representativ fyrdelning.', 'Raknar intervall: A-B-C-D ger 3 relationella intervall och A-B-C-D-E ger 4 representativa intervall.', 'For att kontrollera att 3 till 4 ar en representativ overgang och inte ett nytt ursprung.', 'Relationen ska ge 2/3 och representationen ska ge 3/4.', 'Relationell fraktion blev ' + str(relation_fraction) + ' och representativ fraktion blev ' + str(representation_fraction) + '.', passed, { 'relation_points': relation_points, 'relation_intervals': relation_intervals, 'relation_fraction': relation_fraction, 'representation_points': representation_points, 'representation_intervals': representation_intervals, 'representation_fraction': representation_fraction, 'transition': '3_to_4', 'derived_from': 'FIRST_RELATION_TO_FIRST_REPRESENTATION', 'may_claim_origin': False } ) def test_4_square_to_cube_transition(): square_corners = 4 cube_corners = square_corners * 2 expected_cube_corners = 8 square_edges = 4 cube_edges = 12 passed = cube_corners == expected_cube_corners and square_edges == 4 and cube_edges == 12 return make_test_record( 'TEST_4', 'KVADRAT_TILL_KUB', 'Overgangen fran plan fyrdelning till volymkapsling.', 'Dubblar kvadratens fyra horn till kubens atta horn och kontrollerar kubens kantantal.', 'For att kontrollera att 4 till 8 ar en volymiserad rekonstruktion av samma strukturprincip.', 'Kubens horn ska vara 8 och kubens kanter ska vara 12.', 'Kubens horn blev ' + str(cube_corners) + ' och kubens kanter anges som ' + str(cube_edges) + '.', passed, { 'square_corners': square_corners, 'cube_corners': cube_corners, 'expected_cube_corners': expected_cube_corners, 'square_edges': square_edges, 'cube_edges': cube_edges, 'transition': '4_to_8', 'derived_from': 'RX8_CAPSULATION', 'may_claim_origin': False } ) def test_5_seven_plus_one_lock(): cube_outer = 8 active = 7 reference = 1 total = active + reference active_ratio = Fraction(active, total) reference_ratio = Fraction(reference, total) passed = total == cube_outer and active_ratio == Fraction(7, 8) and reference_ratio == Fraction(1, 8) return make_test_record( 'TEST_5', 'SJU_PLUS_ETT_LASNING', '7+1 som strukturell lasning inom atta-positioners kapsling.', 'Summerar 7 aktiva positioner och 1 referensposition till 8 och beraknar proportionerna 7/8 och 1/8.', 'For att kontrollera att 7+1 ar en intern strukturstatus inom Rx8 och inte en ny relation.', '7 + 1 ska vara 8, aktiv kvot ska vara 7/8 och referenskvot ska vara 1/8.', 'Total blev ' + str(total) + ', aktiv kvot ' + str(active_ratio) + ', referenskvot ' + str(reference_ratio) + '.', passed, { 'active': active, 'reference': reference, 'total': total, 'active_ratio': active_ratio, 'reference_ratio': reference_ratio, 'derived_from': 'CUBE_EIGHT_POSITION_CAPSULATION', 'may_claim_origin': False } ) def test_6_abc_classes_668(): class_A = 6 class_B = 6 class_C = 8 total = class_A + class_B + class_C expected_total = 20 abc_vector = [class_A, class_B, class_C] passed = abc_vector == [6, 6, 8] and total == expected_total return make_test_record( 'TEST_6', 'ABC_KLASSER_6_6_8', 'A/B/C-klasser som 6-6-8-struktur.', 'Kontrollerar klassfordelningen A = 6, B = 6 och C = 8 samt totalen 20.', 'For att kontrollera att 6-6-8 ar en strukturklassificering inom kedjan och inte ett nytt ursprung.', 'Klassvektorn ska vara [6, 6, 8] och totalen ska vara 20.', 'Klassvektorn blev ' + str(abc_vector) + ' och totalen blev ' + str(total) + '.', passed, { 'class_A_one_axis': class_A, 'class_B_two_axes': class_B, 'class_C_three_axes': class_C, 'abc_vector': abc_vector, 'total': total, 'expected_total': expected_total, 'derived_from': 'STRUCTURAL_CLASSIFICATION_LAYER', 'may_claim_origin': False } ) def test_7_four_ten_twenty_development(): first_layer = 4 second_layer = first_layer + 6 third_layer = second_layer * 2 expected_second = 10 expected_third = 20 passed = second_layer == expected_second and third_layer == expected_third return make_test_record( 'TEST_7', 'FYRA_TILL_TIO_TILL_TJUGO', 'Rekursiv strukturutveckling 4 -> 10 -> 20.', 'Beraknar 4 + 6 = 10 och 10 x 2 = 20 som strukturell utvecklingskedja.', 'For att kontrollera att senare totalstruktur ar utveckling av tidigare lager och inte ny ursprungsrelation.', 'Kedjan ska ge 4 -> 10 -> 20.', 'Kedjan gav ' + str(first_layer) + ' -> ' + str(second_layer) + ' -> ' + str(third_layer) + '.', passed, { 'first_layer': first_layer, 'operation_1': '4 + 6', 'second_layer': second_layer, 'operation_2': '10 * 2', 'third_layer': third_layer, 'expected_second': expected_second, 'expected_third': expected_third, 'derived_from': '4_8_AND_6_6_8_STRUCTURE_LAYERS', 'may_claim_origin': False } ) def test_8_global_structure_trace(previous_tests): failed = [t for t in previous_tests if t['slutresultat'] != 'PASS'] passed = len(failed) == 0 chain = [ 'VESICA_PISCIS: ri^2 = 3/4, lock = 1/4', 'BITRHOMBUS: two equilateral triangles as composite structure', 'TRIANGLE_TO_SQUARE: 3 intervals to 4 intervals', 'SQUARE_TO_CUBE: 4 corners to 8 corners', 'SEVEN_PLUS_ONE: 7 active + 1 reference = 8', 'ABC_CLASSES: 6 + 6 + 8 = 20', 'STRUCTURE_DEVELOPMENT: 4 -> 10 -> 20' ] return make_test_record( 'TEST_8', 'GLOBAL_STRUKTURELL_SPARNINGSKEDJA', 'Hela strukturkedjan fran forsta struktur till 4 -> 10 -> 20.', 'Sammanstaller TEST_1 till TEST_7 och kraver att samtliga ar PASS.', 'For att kontrollera att ingen struktur bryter sparbarheten eller introducerar ny primar relation.', 'Alla tidigare strukturtester ska vara PASS.', 'Antal misslyckade tidigare tester: ' + str(len(failed)) + '.', passed, { 'chain': chain, 'failed_tests': [t['test_id'] for t in failed], 'all_previous_tests_passed': passed, 'no_structure_claims_origin': passed } ) def build_markdown(summary, tests): lines = [] lines.append('# RP9 RX8 STRUCTURE VALIDATOR') lines.append('') lines.append('## GLOBALT SLUTRESULTAT') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append('STATUS: ' + summary['global_status']) lines.append('SCRIPT: ' + summary['script']) lines.append('VERSION: ' + summary['version']) lines.append('GENERATED: ' + summary['generated_at']) lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') lines.append('## SYFTE') lines.append('') lines.append('Denna validator ar FAS 3 i RP9/Rx8-kedjan.') lines.append('') lines.append('Den testar om struktur harleds fran tidigare last relation och proportion.') lines.append('') lines.append('Den kastar FAIL om en struktur introducerar en ny primar relation eller tappar sparbarhet.') lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') lines.append('## KEDJA SOM TESTAS') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append('Relation') lines.append('down') lines.append('Representation') lines.append('down') lines.append('Proportion') lines.append('down') lines.append('Vesica Piscis') lines.append('down') lines.append('Bitromb') lines.append('down') lines.append('Triangel -> Kvadrat') lines.append('down') lines.append('Kvadrat -> Kub') lines.append('down') lines.append('7 + 1') lines.append('down') lines.append('6 - 6 - 8') lines.append('down') lines.append('4 -> 10 -> 20') lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') for test in tests: lines.append('## ' + test['test_id'] + ' - ' + test['title']) lines.append('') lines.append('### Vad som testas') lines.append('') lines.append(test['vad_som_testas']) lines.append('') lines.append('### Hur det testas') lines.append('## SLUTSATS') lines.append('') if summary['global_status'] == 'PASS': lines.append('FAS 3 ar godkand.') lines.append('') lines.append('Strukturlagren ar sparbara fran tidigare relation och proportion.') lines.append('') lines.append('Ingen struktur introducerar en ny primar relation.') else: lines.append('FAS 3 ar inte godkand.') lines.append('') lines.append('Minst en struktur bryter sparbarhet eller introducerar ny primar relation.') lines.append('') return '\n'.join(lines) def build_control_log(summary, tests, out_dir): lines = [] lines.append('RP9 RX8 STRUCTURE VALIDATOR CONTROL LOG') lines.append('Generated: ' + summary['generated_at']) lines.append('Script: ' + summary['script']) lines.append('Version: ' + summary['version']) lines.append('Output directory: ' + str(out_dir)) lines.append('Global status: ' + summary['global_status']) lines.append('') for test in tests: lines.append(test['test_id'] + ' | ' + test['slutresultat'] + ' | ' + test['title']) tests.append(test_3_triangle_to_square_transition()) tests.append(test_4_square_to_cube_transition()) tests.append(test_5_seven_plus_one_lock()) tests.append(test_6_abc_classes_668()) tests.append(test_7_four_ten_twenty_development()) tests.append(test_8_global_structure_trace(tests)) global_pass = all(test['slutresultat'] == 'PASS' for test in tests) global_status = status(global_pass) summary = { 'system': 'RP9_RX8', 'phase': 'FAS_3_STRUCTURE_VALIDATION', 'script': SCRIPT_NAME, 'version': SCRIPT_VERSION, 'generated_at': now_iso(), 'global_status': global_status, 'hur_det_testas', 'varfor_det_testas', 'slutresultat']) for test in tests ), 'structure_validation_only': True, 'no_structure_may_claim_origin': all(test['data'].get('may_claim_origin') is False for test in tests if isinstance(test.get('data'), dict) and 'may_claim_origin' in test['data']), 'global_status': global_status } } verify_payload = { 'VERIFY': { 'test_1_vesica_piscis': tests[0]['slutresultat'] == 'PASS', 'test_2_bitrhombus': tests[1]['slutresultat'] == 'PASS', 'test_3_triangle_to_square': tests[2]['slutresultat'] == 'PASS', 'test_4_square_to_cube': tests[3]['slutresultat'] == 'PASS', 'test_5_seven_plus_one': tests[4]['slutresultat'] == 'PASS', 'test_6_abc_668': tests[5]['slutresultat'] == 'PASS', 'test_7_four_ten_twenty': tests[6]['slutresultat'] == 'PASS', 'test_8_global_structure_trace': tests[7]['slutresultat'] == 'PASS', 'global_status': global_status } } write_json(out_dir / 'rp9_rx8_structure_data.json', payload) write_json(out_dir / 'rp9_rx8_structure_trace.json', trace_payload) write_json(out_dir / 'rp9_rx8_structure_audit.json', audit_payload) write_json(out_dir / 'rp9_rx8_structure_verify.json', verify_payload) markdown = build_markdown(summary, tests) write_text(out_dir / 'rp9_rx8_structure_presentation.md', markdown) control_log = build_control_log(summary, tests, out_dir) write_text(out_dir / 'rp9_rx8_structure_control_log.txt', control_log) print('=' * 72) print('RP9 RX8 STRUCTURE VALIDATOR') print('STATUS:', global_status) print('OUTPUT:', out_dir) print('=' * 72) for test in tests: print(test['test_id'] + ' | ' + test['slutresultat'] + ' | ' + test['title']) print('=' * 72) if not global_pass: return 1 return 0 if __name__ == '__main__': exit_code = run_validator() sys.exit(exit_code) ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.

item.title: C. RP9. RX8. PROPORTION STRUCTURE VALIDATOR. PYTHON
item.description: # -*- coding: utf-8 -*- # RP9_RX8_PROPORTION_STRUCTURE_VALIDATOR.py # Version: 1.0.0 # Purpose: # Validate Phase 2 for RP9/Rx8 as a proportion and structure validator. # This validator checks whether the same relational proportion is preserved # through relation, representation, Rx8 capsulation and residual position. # It does not search for competing external relations. # It does not import an external reality-test layer. # It validates proportion through form and structure. import json import math import sys from datetime import datetime from fractions import Fraction from pathlib import Path SCRIPT_VERSION = '1.0.0' SCRIPT_NAME = 'RP9_RX8_PROPORTION_STRUCTURE_VALIDATOR.py' OUTPUT_DIR_NAME = 'RP9_RX8_PROPORTION_STRUCTURE_VALIDATOR_OUTPUT' def now_iso(): return datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds') def make_output_dir(): out_dir = Path.cwd() / OUTPUT_DIR_NAME out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) return out_dir def write_text(path, content): path.write_text(content, encoding='utf-8') def write_json(path, data): path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8') def to_jsonable(value): if isinstance(value, Fraction): return str(value) if isinstance(value, Path): return str(value) if isinstance(value, dict): return {str(k): to_jsonable(v) for k, v in value.items()} if isinstance(value, list): return [to_jsonable(v) for v in value] if isinstance(value, tuple): return [to_jsonable(v) for v in value] return value def status(pass_value): if pass_value: return 'PASS' return 'FAIL' def make_test_record(test_id, title, what_is_tested, how_it_is_tested, why_it_is_tested, expected_result, observed_result, passed, data): return { 'test_id': test_id, 'title': title, 'vad_som_testas': what_is_tested, 'hur_det_testas': how_it_is_tested, 'varfor_det_testas': why_it_is_tested, 'forvantat_resultat': expected_result, 'observerat_resultat': observed_result, 'slutresultat': status(passed), 'data': to_jsonable(data) } def test_1_relational_closure(): left = Fraction(1, 3) right = Fraction(2, 3) total = left + right passed = total == Fraction(1, 1) return make_test_record( 'TEST_1', 'RELATIONELL_SLUTNING', 'Forsta relationens proportion: 1/3 <-> 2/3.', 'Beraknar 1/3 + 2/3 med exakt rationell aritmetik via fractions.Fraction.', 'For att kontrollera att ursprungsrelationen ar sluten innan representation skapas.', 'Summan ska vara exakt 1.', 'Summan blev ' + str(total) + '.', passed, { 'left': left, 'right': right, 'sum': total, 'closure_target': Fraction(1, 1), 'relation_layer': 'RELATION', 'may_claim_origin': True } ) def test_2_representational_closure(): reference = Fraction(1, 4) active = Fraction(3, 4) total = reference + active passed = total == Fraction(1, 1) return make_test_record( 'TEST_2', 'REPRESENTATIONELL_SLUTNING', 'Forsta representationens proportion: 1/4 <-> 3/4.', 'Beraknar 1/4 + 3/4 med exakt rationell aritmetik via fractions.Fraction.', 'For att kontrollera att representationen fortfarande beskriver samma slutna helhet.', 'Summan ska vara exakt 1.', 'Summan blev ' + str(total) + '.', passed, { 'reference': reference, 'active': active, 'sum': total, 'closure_target': Fraction(1, 1), 'representation_layer': 'REPRESENTATION', 'may_claim_origin': False } ) def test_3_rx8_capsulation(): r_symbol = 'R' diameter = Fraction(2, 1) square_sides = 4 perimeter_coefficient = diameter * square_sides expected = Fraction(8, 1) passed = perimeter_coefficient == expected return make_test_record( 'TEST_3', 'GEOMETRISK_KAPSLING_RX8', 'Rx8 som kapsling och rekonstruktion: 2R x 4 = 8R.', 'Beraknar kvadratens fyra sidor som 4 stycken diameterlinjer, dar varje diameter ar 2R.', 'For att kontrollera att Rx8 uppstar som strukturell kapsling av R och inte som ny ursprungsrelation.', 'Perimeterkoefficienten ska vara exakt 8.', 'Perimeterkoefficienten blev ' + str(perimeter_coefficient) + ', dvs 8R.', passed, { 'R_status': 'symbolic_not_measured', 'R_symbol': r_symbol, 'diameter': '2R', 'square_sides': square_sides, 'calculation': '2R * 4 = 8R', 'perimeter_coefficient': perimeter_coefficient, 'expected_coefficient': expected, 'rx8_layer': 'STRUCTURE_RECONSTRUCTION', 'may_claim_origin': False } ) def test_4_proportion_preservation(): exact_active = Fraction(3, 4) exact_reference = Fraction(1, 4) decimal_active = 0.75 decimal_reference = 0.25 active_preserved = float(exact_active) == decimal_active reference_preserved = float(exact_reference) == decimal_reference sum_preserved = math.isclose(decimal_active + decimal_reference, 1.0, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=0.0) passed = active_preserved and reference_preserved and sum_preserved return make_test_record( 'TEST_4', 'PROPORTIONSBEVARANDE', 'Bevarande av 3/4 <-> 1/4 genom decimal representation: 0.75 <-> 0.25.', 'Jamfor exakt brakaritmetik mot decimal/flyttalsrepresentation for 3/4 och 1/4.', 'For att kontrollera att representationen visar proportionen utan att andra relationer skapas.', '3/4 ska representeras som 0.75, 1/4 som 0.25, och summan ska vara 1.0.', 'Observerat: 0.75 + 0.25 = ' + str(decimal_active + decimal_reference) + '.', passed, { 'exact_active': exact_active, 'exact_reference': exact_reference, 'decimal_active': decimal_active, 'decimal_reference': decimal_reference, 'active_preserved': active_preserved, 'reference_preserved': reference_preserved, 'sum_preserved': sum_preserved, 'representation_creates_new_relation': False } ) def test_5_residual_position(): exact_ratio = Fraction(3, 4) exact_lock = Fraction(1, 4) ri_float = math.sqrt(3.0) / 2.0 observed_ratio = ri_float * ri_float observed_lock = 1.0 - observed_ratio expected_ratio = float(exact_ratio) expected_lock = float(exact_lock) ratio_residual = observed_ratio - expected_ratio lock_residual = observed_lock - expected_lock residual_sum = ratio_residual + lock_residual symmetric_residual = math.isclose(residual_sum, 0.0, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=1e-30) exact_relation_intact = exact_ratio + exact_lock == Fraction(1, 1) residual_claims_origin = False passed = symmetric_residual and exact_relation_intact and not residual_claims_origin return make_test_record( 'TEST_5', 'RESIDUALPOSITION', 'Residualens lagerposition: ideal proportion minus maskinell representation.', 'Beraknar sqrt(3)/2 i float, kvadrerar den, jamfor mot exakt 3/4 och isolerar residualparet.', 'For att kontrollera att residualen ar ett representationsspar och inte en ny relation.', 'Residualerna ska vara symmetriska och den exakta relationen 3/4 + 1/4 ska forbli intakt.', 'Ratio residual ' + format(ratio_residual, '.20e') + ', lock residual ' + format(lock_residual, '.20e') + '.', passed, { 'exact_ratio': exact_ratio, 'exact_lock': exact_lock, 'exact_sum': exact_ratio + exact_lock, 'ri_float': format(ri_float, '.20e'), 'observed_ratio_float': format(observed_ratio, '.20e'), 'observed_lock_float': format(observed_lock, '.20e'), 'expected_ratio_float': format(expected_ratio, '.20e'), 'expected_lock_float': format(expected_lock, '.20e'), 'ratio_residual': format(ratio_residual, '.20e'), 'lock_residual': format(lock_residual, '.20e'), 'residual_sum': format(residual_sum, '.20e'), 'symmetric_residual': symmetric_residual, 'exact_relation_intact': exact_relation_intact, 'residual_layer': 'REPRESENTATION_TRACE', 'residual_claims_origin': residual_claims_origin } ) def test_6_global_proportional_invariance(previous_tests): failed = [t for t in previous_tests if t['slutresultat'] != 'PASS'] passed = len(failed) == 0 chain = [ 'RELATION: 1/3 <-> 2/3', 'REPRESENTATION: 1/4 <-> 3/4', 'STRUCTURE: 2R x 4 = 8R', 'PROPORTION: 3/4 <-> 1/4 preserved as 0.75 <-> 0.25', 'RESIDUAL: representation trace, not origin' ] return make_test_record( 'TEST_6', 'GLOBAL_PROPORTIONELL_INVARIANS', 'Hela proportionskedjan fran relation till residual.', 'Sammanstaller status fran TEST_1 till TEST_5 och kraver att samtliga ar PASS.', 'For att kontrollera att ingen del av kedjan bryter proportionen eller gor sig sjalv till ursprung.', 'Alla tidigare tester ska vara PASS.', 'Antal misslyckade tidigare tester: ' + str(len(failed)) + '.', passed, { 'chain': chain, 'failed_tests': [t['test_id'] for t in failed], 'all_previous_tests_passed': passed, 'no_later_layer_claims_origin': passed } ) def build_markdown(summary, tests): lines = [] lines.append('# RP9 RX8 PROPORTION STRUCTURE VALIDATOR') lines.append('') lines.append('## GLOBALT SLUTRESULTAT') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append('STATUS: ' + summary['global_status']) lines.append('SCRIPT: ' + summary['script']) lines.append('VERSION: ' + summary['version']) lines.append('GENERATED: ' + summary['generated_at']) lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') lines.append('## SYFTE') lines.append('') lines.append('Denna validator ar FAS 2 i RP9/Rx8-kedjan.') lines.append('') lines.append('Den testar inte extern verklighet.') lines.append('') lines.append('Den testar om relationell proportion bevaras genom form, struktur, representation och residual.') lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') lines.append('## KEDJA SOM TESTAS') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append('Relation: 1/3 <-> 2/3') lines.append('down') lines.append('Representation: 1/4 <-> 3/4') lines.append('down') lines.append('Rx8: 2R x 4 = 8R') lines.append('down') lines.append('Proportionsbevarande: 3/4 <-> 1/4 = 0.75 <-> 0.25') lines.append('down') lines.append('Residual: representationellt spar') lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') for test in tests: lines.append('## ' + test['test_id'] + ' - ' + test['title']) lines.append('') lines.append('### Vad som testas') lines.append('') lines.append(test['vad_som_testas']) lines.append('') lines.append('### Hur det testas') lines.append('') lines.append(test['hur_det_testas']) lines.append('') lines.append('### Varfor det testas') lines.append('') lines.append(test['varfor_det_testas']) lines.append('') lines.append('### Forvantat resultat') lines.append('') lines.append(test['forvantat_resultat']) lines.append('') lines.append('### Observerat resultat') lines.append('') lines.append(test['observerat_resultat']) lines.append('') lines.append('### Slutresultat') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append(test['slutresultat']) lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') lines.append('## SLUTSATS') lines.append('') if summary['global_status'] == 'PASS': lines.append('FAS 2 ar godkand.') lines.append('') lines.append('Samma proportionella identitet bevaras genom relation, representation, Rx8-kapsling och residualposition.') lines.append('') lines.append('Ingen senare struktur skapar en ny primar relation.') else: lines.append('FAS 2 ar inte godkand.') lines.append('') lines.append('Minst ett lager bryter proportionen, tappar sparbarhet eller gor residual/struktur till ursprung.') lines.append('') return '\n'.join(lines) def build_control_log(summary, tests, out_dir): lines = [] lines.append('RP9 RX8 PROPORTION STRUCTURE VALIDATOR CONTROL LOG') lines.append('Generated: ' + summary['generated_at']) lines.append('Script: ' + summary['script']) lines.append('Version: ' + summary['version']) lines.append('Output directory: ' + str(out_dir)) lines.append('Global status: ' + summary['global_status']) lines.append('') for test in tests: lines.append(test['test_id'] + ' | ' + test['slutresultat'] + ' | ' + test['title']) lines.append('WHAT: ' + test['vad_som_testas']) lines.append('HOW: ' + test['hur_det_testas']) lines.append('WHY: ' + test['varfor_det_testas']) lines.append('RESULT: ' + test['observerat_resultat']) lines.append('') return '\n'.join(lines) def run_validator(): out_dir = make_output_dir() tests = [] tests.append(test_1_relational_closure()) tests.append(test_2_representational_closure()) tests.append(test_3_rx8_capsulation()) tests.append(test_4_proportion_preservation()) tests.append(test_5_residual_position()) tests.append(test_6_global_proportional_invariance(tests)) global_pass = all(test['slutresultat'] == 'PASS' for test in tests) global_status = status(global_pass) summary = { 'system': 'RP9_RX8', 'phase': 'FAS_2_PROPORTION_STRUCTURE_VALIDATION', 'script': SCRIPT_NAME, 'version': SCRIPT_VERSION, 'generated_at': now_iso(), 'global_status': global_status, 'principle': 'Relation and proportion are primary through form and structure.', 'validation_boundary': 'No external reality layer. Only relation, proportion, form, structure and residual position are tested.' } payload = { 'SUMMARY': summary, 'TESTS': tests } trace_payload = { 'TRACE': tests } audit_payload = { 'AUDIT': { 'all_tests_include_what_how_why_result': all( all(key in test for key in ['vad_som_testas', 'hur_det_testas', 'varfor_det_testas', 'slutresultat']) for test in tests ), 'no_external_reality_layer': True, 'proportion_structure_validation_only': True, 'later_layer_origin_claim_detected': False if global_pass else 'SEE_FAILED_TESTS', 'global_status': global_status } } verify_payload = { 'VERIFY': { 'test_1_relational_closure': tests[0]['slutresultat'] == 'PASS', 'test_2_representational_closure': tests[1]['slutresultat'] == 'PASS', 'test_3_rx8_capsulation': tests[2]['slutresultat'] == 'PASS', 'test_4_proportion_preservation': tests[3]['slutresultat'] == 'PASS', 'test_5_residual_position': tests[4]['slutresultat'] == 'PASS', 'test_6_global_invariance': tests[5]['slutresultat'] == 'PASS', 'global_status': global_status } } write_json(out_dir / 'rp9_rx8_proportion_structure_data.json', payload) write_json(out_dir / 'rp9_rx8_proportion_structure_trace.json', trace_payload) write_json(out_dir / 'rp9_rx8_proportion_structure_audit.json', audit_payload) write_json(out_dir / 'rp9_rx8_proportion_structure_verify.json', verify_payload) markdown = build_markdown(summary, tests) write_text(out_dir / 'rp9_rx8_proportion_structure_presentation.md', markdown) control_log = build_control_log(summary, tests, out_dir) write_text(out_dir / 'rp9_rx8_proportion_structure_control_log.txt', control_log) print('=' * 72) print('RP9 RX8 PROPORTION STRUCTURE VALIDATOR') print('STATUS:', global_status) print('OUTPUT:', out_dir) print('=' * 72) for test in tests: print(test['test_id'] + ' | ' + test['slutresultat'] + ' | ' + test['title']) print('=' * 72) if not global_pass: return 1 return 0 if __name__ == '__main__': exit_code = run_validator() sys.exit(exit_code) ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.
