item.title: C. RP9. RX8. GENEALOGICAL VALIDATOR. PYTHON
item.description: # -*- coding: utf-8 -*- # RP9_RX8_GENEALOGICAL_VALIDATOR.py # Version: 1.1.0 # Purpose: # Validate Rx8 as a genealogical derivation chain. # This script writes what is tested, how it is tested, why it is tested, and the final result. # Output is written to both Markdown and JSON. import json import math import sys from datetime import datetime from fractions import Fraction from pathlib import Path SCRIPT_VERSION = "1.1.0" SCRIPT_NAME = "RP9_RX8_GENEALOGICAL_VALIDATOR.py" OUTPUT_DIR_NAME = "RP9_RX8_GENEALOGICAL_VALIDATOR_OUTPUT" def now_iso(): return datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds") def make_output_dir(): out_dir = Path.cwd() / OUTPUT_DIR_NAME out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) return out_dir def write_text(path, content): path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8") def write_json(path, data): path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8") def fraction_to_text(value): if isinstance(value, Fraction): return str(value) return str(value) def status_from_bool(value): if value: return "PASS" return "FAIL" def make_record(step_id, title, what_is_tested, how_it_is_tested, why_it_is_tested, passed, final_result, data=None): return { "step_id": step_id, "title": title, "what_is_tested": what_is_tested, "how_it_is_tested": how_it_is_tested, "why_it_is_tested": why_it_is_tested, "status": status_from_bool(passed), "final_result": final_result, "data": data or {} } def validate_first_relation(): relation = { "id": "RELATION_ORIGIN_1", "layer": "RELATION", "name": "FIRST_RELATIONAL_DIFFERENTIATION", "left": Fraction(1, 3), "right": Fraction(2, 3), "total": Fraction(1, 1), "claim": "PRIMARY_ORIGIN_RELATION", "derived_from": None, "may_claim_origin": True } passed = ( relation["left"] + relation["right"] == relation["total"] and relation["left"] == Fraction(1, 3) and relation["right"] == Fraction(2, 3) and relation["may_claim_origin"] is True ) data = { "left": fraction_to_text(relation["left"]), "right": fraction_to_text(relation["right"]), "sum": fraction_to_text(relation["left"] + relation["right"]), "claim": relation["claim"], "may_claim_origin": relation["may_claim_origin"] } final_result = "First relation is locked as origin." if passed else "First relation failed origin validation." record = make_record( "1", "VERIFY_FIRST_RELATION_POSITION", "The first relation position 1/3 <-> 2/3.", "The script verifies that 1/3 + 2/3 = 1 and that this node alone may claim origin status.", "This prevents later representations from being mistaken for the first relation.", passed, final_result, data ) return relation, record def derive_first_representation(relation): representation = { "id": "REPRESENTATION_1", "layer": "REPRESENTATION", "name": "FIRST_FRACTAL_REPRESENTATION", "active": Fraction(3, 4), "reference": Fraction(1, 4), "total": Fraction(1, 1), "claim": "DERIVED_REPRESENTATION", "derived_from": relation["id"], "may_claim_origin": False } passed = ( representation["active"] + representation["reference"] == representation["total"] and representation["derived_from"] == relation["id"] and representation["may_claim_origin"] is False ) data = { "active": fraction_to_text(representation["active"]), "reference": fraction_to_text(representation["reference"]), "sum": fraction_to_text(representation["active"] + representation["reference"]), "derived_from": representation["derived_from"], "claim": representation["claim"], "may_claim_origin": representation["may_claim_origin"] } final_result = "First representation is derived and does not claim origin." if passed else "First representation failed derivation validation." record = make_record( "2", "DERIVE_FIRST_REPRESENTATION", "The first representation 1/4 <-> 3/4.", "The script verifies that 1/4 + 3/4 = 1 and that the representation is derived from RELATION_ORIGIN_1.", "This locks representation as after-construction, not as a new primary relation.", passed, final_result, data ) return representation, record def check_representation_does_not_create_new_relation(relation, representation): passed = ( representation["derived_from"] == relation["id"] and representation["may_claim_origin"] is False and representation["claim"] != "PRIMARY_ORIGIN_RELATION" ) data = { "origin_relation": relation["id"], "representation": representation["id"], "representation_claim": representation["claim"], "representation_may_claim_origin": representation["may_claim_origin"] } final_result = "Representation did not create a new primary relation." if passed else "Representation incorrectly introduced or claimed a new primary relation." return make_record( "3", "CHECK_NO_NEW_RELATION_CREATED", "Whether representation creates a new relation.", "The script checks that the representation remains derived, cannot claim origin, and does not use PRIMARY_ORIGIN_RELATION as its claim.", "This is the lock against circular self-confirmation and false origin transfer.", passed, final_result, data ) def validate_rx8_capsulation(representation): rx8 = { "id": "RX8_CAPSULATION_1", "layer": "RECONSTRUCTION", "name": "R_TIMES_8_CAPSULATION", "R": "symbolic_R_not_measured", "diameter_coefficient": Fraction(2, 1), "square_sides": 4, "perimeter_coefficient": Fraction(8, 1), "derived_from": representation["id"], "claim": "CAPSULATION_RECONSTRUCTION", "may_claim_origin": False } calculated_perimeter = rx8["diameter_coefficient"] * rx8["square_sides"] passed = ( calculated_perimeter == rx8["perimeter_coefficient"] and rx8["perimeter_coefficient"] == Fraction(8, 1) and rx8["derived_from"] == representation["id"] and rx8["may_claim_origin"] is False ) data = { "R_status": rx8["R"], "diameter": "2R", "square_sides": rx8["square_sides"], "calculated_perimeter": "8R", "perimeter_coefficient": fraction_to_text(rx8["perimeter_coefficient"]), "derived_from": rx8["derived_from"], "may_claim_origin": rx8["may_claim_origin"] } final_result = "Rx8 is validated as capsulation and reconstruction." if passed else "Rx8 capsulation failed validation." record = make_record( "4", "VALIDATE_RX8_CAPSULATION", "Rx8 as R x 8 capsulation.", "The script keeps R symbolic and verifies that four square sides of 2R create 8R without measuring R.", "This shows Rx8 as reconstruction of R, not as a new origin value.", passed, final_result, data ) return rx8, record def validate_residual_belongs_to_representation(representation): exact_ratio = Fraction(3, 4) exact_lock = Fraction(1, 4) ri_float = math.sqrt(3.0) / 2.0 ratio_observed = ri_float * ri_float lock_observed = 1.0 - ratio_observed ratio_expected = float(exact_ratio) lock_expected = float(exact_lock) ratio_residual = ratio_observed - ratio_expected lock_residual = lock_observed - lock_expected symmetric_residual = math.isclose(ratio_residual + lock_residual, 0.0, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=1e-30) exact_relation_preserved = exact_ratio + exact_lock == Fraction(1, 1) residual = { "id": "RESIDUAL_1", "layer": "RESIDUAL", "name": "FLOAT_REPRESENTATION_RESIDUAL", "derived_from": representation["id"], "claim": "REPRESENTATION_TRACE", "may_claim_origin": False, "ratio_residual": ratio_residual, "lock_residual": lock_residual, "symmetric_residual": symmetric_residual } passed = ( residual["derived_from"] == representation["id"] and residual["may_claim_origin"] is False and symmetric_residual is True and exact_relation_preserved is True ) data = { "exact_ratio": fraction_to_text(exact_ratio), "exact_lock": fraction_to_text(exact_lock), "exact_sum": fraction_to_text(exact_ratio + exact_lock), "ratio_observed_float": format(ratio_observed, ".20e"), "lock_observed_float": format(lock_observed, ".20e"), "ratio_residual": format(ratio_residual, ".20e"), "lock_residual": format(lock_residual, ".20e"), "symmetric_residual": symmetric_residual, "residual_layer": residual["layer"], "derived_from": residual["derived_from"], "may_claim_origin": residual["may_claim_origin"] } final_result = "Residual is isolated to representation and exact relation remains unchanged." if passed else "Residual isolation failed." record = make_record( "5", "VALIDATE_RESIDUAL_LAYER", "Whether float residual belongs to representation.", "The script compares exact 3/4 and 1/4 against float-derived values and checks symmetric residual cancellation.", "This proves residual as representation trace, not as a mutation of the relation.", passed, final_result, data ) return residual, record def validate_no_ungrounded_later_origin(nodes): failures = [] for node in nodes: if node["layer"] != "RELATION": if node.get("may_claim_origin") is True: failures.append({ "node_id": node["id"], "reason": "Later layer claims origin." }) if node.get("derived_from") is None: failures.append({ "node_id": node["id"], "reason": "Later layer has no derivation source." }) passed = len(failures) == 0 data = { "checked_nodes": [node["id"] for node in nodes], "failures": failures } final_result = "No later layer introduced an ungrounded primary relation." if passed else "Ungrounded later relation detected." return make_record( "6", "FAIL_IF_LATER_LAYER_INTRODUCES_UNGROUNDED_RELATION", "Whether any later layer introduces an ungrounded origin relation.", "The script scans every non-relation node and fails if it claims origin or lacks a derivation source.", "This is the final lock: no after-construction may be promoted into origin.", passed, final_result, data ) def normalize_nodes_for_json(nodes): cleaned = [] for node in nodes: item = {} for key, value in node.items(): if isinstance(value, Fraction): item[key] = str(value) else: item[key] = value cleaned.append(item) return cleaned def build_presentation(summary, records): lines = [] lines.append("# RP9 RX8 GENEALOGICAL VALIDATOR") lines.append("") lines.append("## SLUTRESULTAT") lines.append("") lines.append("```text") lines.append("STATUS: " + summary["global_status"]) lines.append("SCRIPT: " + SCRIPT_NAME) lines.append("VERSION: " + SCRIPT_VERSION) lines.append("GENERATED: " + summary["generated_at"]) lines.append("```") lines.append("") lines.append("---") lines.append("") lines.append("## VAD SOM PROVAS") lines.append("") lines.append("Koden provar om Rx8-kedjan är en genealogisk härledning från första relationen, inte en samling nya ogrundade relationer.") lines.append("") lines.append("---") lines.append("") lines.append("## HUR DET PROVAS") lines.append("") lines.append("Varje lager får en explicit status: RELATION, REPRESENTATION, RECONSTRUCTION eller RESIDUAL.") lines.append("") lines.append("Koden kastar FAIL om ett senare lager saknar härledning eller försöker ta ursprungsstatus.") lines.append("") lines.append("---") lines.append("") lines.append("## VARFÖR DET PROVAS") lines.append("") lines.append("Syftet är att låsa principen relation före projektion. Representation, Rx8 och residual får bara vara efterhandskonstruktioner av den första relationen.") lines.append("") lines.append("---") lines.append("") lines.append("## KONTROLLKEDJA") lines.append("") lines.append("```text") lines.append("R") lines.append("down") lines.append("first relation: 1/3 <-> 2/3") lines.append("down") lines.append("first representation: 1/4 <-> 3/4") lines.append("down") lines.append("Rx8: R x 8 capsulation") lines.append("down") lines.append("residual: representation trace") lines.append("```") lines.append("") lines.append("---") lines.append("") lines.append("## STEGRESULTAT") lines.append("") lines.append("| Steg | Titel | Vad provas | Hur provas det | Varför provas det | Status | Slutresultat |") lines.append("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|") for record in records: row = ( "| " + record["step_id"] + " | " + record["title"] + " | " + record["what_is_tested"] + " | " + record["how_it_is_tested"] + " | " + record["why_it_is_tested"] + " | " + record["status"] + " | " + record["final_result"] + " |" ) lines.append(row) lines.append("") lines.append("---") lines.append("") lines.append("## SLUTSATS") lines.append("") if summary["global_status"] == "PASS": lines.append("PASS: Kedjan är låst. Inget senare lager introducerar en ogrundad ny relation.") else: lines.append("FAIL: Kedjan är inte låst. Minst ett senare lager bröt härledningskravet.") lines.append("") return "\n".join(lines) def build_log(records, out_dir, global_status): lines = [] lines.append("RP9 RX8 GENEALOGICAL VALIDATOR LOG") lines.append("Generated: " + now_iso()) lines.append("Script: " + SCRIPT_NAME) lines.append("Version: " + SCRIPT_VERSION) lines.append("Output directory: " + str(out_dir)) lines.append("Global status: " + global_status) lines.append("") for record in records: lines.append(record["step_id"] + " | " + record["status"] + " | " + record["title"] + " | " + record["final_result"]) lines.append("") return "\n".join(lines) def run_validator(): out_dir = make_output_dir() trace = [] nodes = [] relation, record_1 = validate_first_relation() trace.append(record_1) nodes.append(relation) representation, record_2 = derive_first_representation(relation) trace.append(record_2) nodes.append(representation) record_3 = check_representation_does_not_create_new_relation(relation, representation) trace.append(record_3) rx8, record_4 = validate_rx8_capsulation(representation) trace.append(record_4) nodes.append(rx8) residual, record_5 = validate_residual_belongs_to_representation(representation) trace.append(record_5) nodes.append(residual) record_6 = validate_no_ungrounded_later_origin(nodes) trace.append(record_6) global_pass = all(record["status"] == "PASS" for record in trace) global_status = status_from_bool(global_pass) summary = { "system": "RP9_RX8", "validator": SCRIPT_NAME, "version": SCRIPT_VERSION, "generated_at": now_iso(), "global_status": global_status, "what_is_tested": "Rx8 as a genealogical derivation from the first relation.", "how_it_is_tested": "Every later layer must be derived and must not claim origin status.", "why_it_is_tested": "To lock relation before projection and prevent after-constructions from becoming origin claims.", "final_result": "PASS means the genealogy is locked. FAIL means an ungrounded later relation was introduced." } data_payload = { "SUMMARY": summary, "NODES": normalize_nodes_for_json(nodes), "TRACE": trace } audit_payload = { "AUDIT": { "what_is_tested": "Audit of origin claims across all layers.", "how_it_is_tested": "Counts origin-capable relation nodes and checks later layers for illegal origin claims.", "why_it_is_tested": "Only the first relation may carry origin status.", "no_competing_relation_search": True, "genealogical_validation_only": True, "origin_relation_count_expected": 1, "origin_relation_count_observed": len([node for node in nodes if node["layer"] == "RELATION" and node.get("may_claim_origin") is True]), "later_origin_claims": [ node["id"] for node in nodes if node["layer"] != "RELATION" and node.get("may_claim_origin") is True ], "global_status": global_status, "final_result": global_status } } verify_payload = { "VERIFY": { "what_is_tested": "Machine-readable final verification flags.", "how_it_is_tested": "Each step must return PASS for global PASS.", "why_it_is_tested": "This gives a direct audit surface for external review.", "first_relation_locked": record_1["status"] == "PASS", "first_representation_derived": record_2["status"] == "PASS", "representation_does_not_create_new_relation": record_3["status"] == "PASS", "rx8_is_capsulation": record_4["status"] == "PASS", "residual_belongs_to_representation": record_5["status"] == "PASS", "no_ungrounded_later_relation": record_6["status"] == "PASS", "global_status": global_status, "final_result": global_status } } write_json(out_dir / "rp9_rx8_genealogical_data.json", data_payload) write_json(out_dir / "rp9_rx8_genealogical_trace.json", {"TRACE": trace}) write_json(out_dir / "rp9_rx8_genealogical_audit.json", audit_payload) write_json(out_dir / "rp9_rx8_genealogical_verify.json", verify_payload) presentation = build_presentation(summary, trace) write_text(out_dir / "rp9_rx8_genealogical_presentation.md", presentation) log_text = build_log(trace, out_dir, global_status) write_text(out_dir / "rp9_rx8_genealogical_control_log.txt", log_text) print("=" * 72) print("RP9 RX8 GENEALOGICAL VALIDATOR") print("VAD SOM PROVAS: Rx8 som genealogisk härledning från första relationen.") print("HUR DET PROVAS: varje senare lager måste vara härlett och får inte ta ursprungsstatus.") print("VARFÖR DET PROVAS: relation före projektion måste låsas operationellt.") print("SLUTRESULTAT:", global_status) print("OUTPUT:", out_dir) print("=" * 72) for record in trace: print(record["step_id"] + " | " + record["status"] + " | " + record["title"] + " | " + record["final_result"]) print("=" * 72) if not global_pass: return 1 return 0 if __name__ == "__main__": exit_code = run_validator() sys.exit(exit_code) ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.

item.description: import numpy as np import plotly.graph_objects as go import plotly.io as pio import os import webbrowser pio.renderers.default = "browser" # ============================================================ # PARAMETRAR # ============================================================ R = 2.0 # radie RES = 100 # upplösning COLOR_BG = "black" COLOR_SPHERE = "royalblue" COLOR_CENTER = "white" # ============================================================ # SFÄR # ============================================================ def create_sphere(center, r, resolution=60): u = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, resolution) v = np.linspace(0, np.pi, resolution) x = r * np.outer(np.cos(u), np.sin(v)) + center[0] y = r * np.outer(np.sin(u), np.sin(v)) + center[1] z = r * np.outer(np.ones_like(u), np.cos(v)) + center[2] return x, y, z # ============================================================ # CENTRUM # ============================================================ C0 = np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.0]) # ============================================================ # BYGG # ============================================================ traces = [] # enda sfären (P0 / potential) x, y, z = create_sphere(C0, R, RES) traces.append(go.Surface( x=x, y=y, z=z, opacity=0.22, colorscale=[[0, COLOR_SPHERE], [1, COLOR_SPHERE]], showscale=False )) # centrum traces.append(go.Scatter3d( x=[C0[0]], y=[C0[1]], z=[C0[2]], mode="markers", marker=dict(size=6, color=COLOR_CENTER), showlegend=False )) # ============================================================ # RENDER # ============================================================ fig = go.Figure(data=traces) fig.update_layout( template="plotly_dark", scene=dict( xaxis=dict(visible=False), yaxis=dict(visible=False), zaxis=dict(visible=False), aspectmode="data", bgcolor=COLOR_BG, camera=dict( eye=dict(x=1.6, y=1.6, z=1.2) ) ), paper_bgcolor=COLOR_BG, margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=40, b=0) ) out = "RP9_LEVEL0_potential_sphere.html" fig.write_html(out) webbrowser.open("file://" + os.path.abspath(out)) fig.show() ⚖️ — License & CopyrightLicensed under RP9-LA-2026Copyright © 2026 Anton WallinSee LICENSE for full terms.

item.title: 01. invertdoz. PYTHON
item.description: import numpy as np import plotly.graph_objects as go import plotly.io as pio import os import webbrowser pio.renderers.default = "browser" # ============================================================ # PARAMETRAR (ABSOLUT + RELATIONELLT) # ============================================================ R_ABS = 100.0 # absolut storlek (oförändrad) H_FACTOR = 0.25 # HALVERING (25%) D_FACTOR = 2.0 # DUBBLERING RES = 120 COLOR_BG = "black" COLOR_SPHERE_1 = "royalblue" COLOR_SPHERE_2 = "crimson" COLOR_INTERSECTION = "#00ffcc" # ============================================================ # H-D-R OPERATÖR (PÅ POTENTIAL) # ============================================================ def HDR_operator(radius_abs): """ H: komprimerar till 25% (relationellt, inte absolut) D: återför till systemskala R: genererar halva-halva relation (center offset) """ # HALVERING (relationell kompression) r_rel = radius_abs * H_FACTOR # DUBBLERING (återför till system) r_reconstructed = r_rel * D_FACTOR * 2.0 # => tillbaka till R_ABS # RELATION (halva-halva) center_offset = radius_abs # exakt halva-halva return radius_abs, center_offset # ============================================================ # GEOMETRI # ============================================================ def create_sphere(center, r, resolution=60): u = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, resolution) v = np.linspace(0, np.pi, resolution) x = r * np.outer(np.cos(u), np.sin(v)) + center[0] y = r * np.outer(np.sin(u), np.sin(v)) + center[1] z = r * np.outer(np.ones_like(u), np.cos(v)) + center[2] return x, y, z def intersection_circle(c1, c2, r, d, num=300): mid = (c1 + c2) / 2.0 normal = c2 - c1 normal = normal / np.linalg.norm(normal) if abs(normal[0]) < 0.9: ref = np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0]) else: ref = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0]) v1 = np.cross(normal, ref) v1 = v1 / np.linalg.norm(v1) v2 = np.cross(normal, v1) r_c = np.sqrt(r**2 - (d / 2.0)**2) t = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, num) circle = ( mid.reshape(3, 1) + r_c * np.cos(t) * v1.reshape(3, 1) + r_c * np.sin(t) * v2.reshape(3, 1) ) return circle # ============================================================ # H-D-R EXECUTION # ============================================================ R, D = HDR_operator(R_ABS) # centra enligt halva-halva C1 = np.array([-D / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0]) C2 = np.array([ D / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0]) # ============================================================ # BUILD # ============================================================ traces = [] # SFÄR 1 (potential) x, y, z = create_sphere(C1, R, RES) traces.append(go.Surface( x=x, y=y, z=z, opacity=0.25, colorscale=[[0, COLOR_SPHERE_1], [1, COLOR_SPHERE_1]], showscale=False )) # SFÄR 2 (skapad via H-D-R) x, y, z = create_sphere(C2, R, RES) traces.append(go.Surface( x=x, y=y, z=z, opacity=0.25, colorscale=[[0, COLOR_SPHERE_2], [1, COLOR_SPHERE_2]], showscale=False )) # INTERSEKTION (första relationella struktur) circle = intersection_circle(C1, C2, R, D) traces.append(go.Scatter3d( x=circle[0], y=circle[1], z=circle[2], mode="lines", line=dict(color=COLOR_INTERSECTION, width=6), showlegend=False )) # CENTRA traces.append(go.Scatter3d( x=[C1[0], C2[0]], y=[C1[1], C2[1]], z=[C1[2], C2[2]], mode="markers", marker=dict(size=6, color="white"), showlegend=False )) # ============================================================ # RENDER # ============================================================ fig = go.Figure(data=traces) fig.update_layout( template="plotly_dark", scene=dict( xaxis=dict(visible=False), yaxis=dict(visible=False), zaxis=dict(visible=False), aspectmode="data", bgcolor=COLOR_BG, camera=dict(eye=dict(x=1.5, y=1.5, z=1.2)) ), paper_bgcolor=COLOR_BG, margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=40, b=0) ) out = "RP9_LEVEL1_HDR_relation.html" fig.write_html(out) webbrowser.open("file://" + os.path.abspath(out)) fig.show() ⚖️ — License & CopyrightLicensed under RP9-LA-2026Copyright © 2026 Anton WallinSee LICENSE for full terms.

item.title: 02. invertdoz. PYTHON
item.description: import numpy as np import plotly.graph_objects as go import plotly.io as pio import os import webbrowser pio.renderers.default = "browser" # ============================================================ # PARAMETRAR # ============================================================ R_ABS = 100.0 H_FACTOR = 0.25 RES_SPHERE = 120 RES_CIRCLE = 300 COLOR_BG = "black" COLOR_SPHERE_1 = "royalblue" COLOR_SPHERE_2 = "crimson" COLOR_CIRCLE_1 = "#00ffff" # Cyan COLOR_CIRCLE_2 = "#ff00ff" # Magenta COLOR_CENTER = "white" # Alla centrumnoder (sfärer + cirklar) COLOR_INTERSECT = "#00ff00" # Geometriskt absoluta intersektioner (Grön) # ============================================================ # GEOMETRI-FUNKTIONER (ABSOLUTA RELATIONER) # ============================================================ def hdr_value(value): return value * H_FACTOR * 4.0 def create_sphere(center, r, resolution): u = np.linspace(0.0, 2.0 * np.pi, resolution) v = np.linspace(0.0, np.pi, resolution) x = r * np.outer(np.cos(u), np.sin(v)) + center[0] y = r * np.outer(np.sin(u), np.sin(v)) + center[1] z = r * np.outer(np.ones_like(u), np.cos(v)) + center[2] return x, y, z def orthonormal_basis(normal): normal = normal / np.linalg.norm(normal) ref = np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0]) if abs(normal[0]) < 0.9 else np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0]) v1 = np.cross(normal, ref) v1 /= np.linalg.norm(v1) v2 = np.cross(normal, v1) return v1, v2 def circle_points(center, r, v1, v2, num_points): t = np.linspace(0.0, 2.0 * np.pi, num_points) return center.reshape(3, 1) + r * np.cos(t) * v1.reshape(3, 1) + r * np.sin(t) * v2.reshape(3, 1) def get_circle_intersections(c1, c2, r, v_plane, v_common): """ Beräknar de absoluta skärningspunkterna mellan två cirklar i 3D. Eftersom de ligger i samma plan och har samma radie är de fixerade. """ d = np.linalg.norm(c2 - c1) if d > 2*r: return [] mid = (c1 + c2) / 2.0 h = np.sqrt(max(0, r**2 - (d/2)**2)) # Punkterna rör sig längs den gemensamma axeln (v_common) p1 = mid + h * v_common p2 = mid - h * v_common return [p1, p2] # ============================================================ # BERÄKNINGSKEDJA # ============================================================ R = hdr_value(R_ABS) D = R # Sfärernas position C1 = np.array([-D / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0]) C2 = np.array([ D / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0]) # 1. Hitta skärningsplanet mellan sfärerna mid_global = (C1 + C2) / 2.0 normal_global = (C2 - C1) / np.linalg.norm(C2 - C1) v1, v2 = orthonormal_basis(normal_global) r_inter = np.sqrt(R**2 - (D/2)**2) # 2. Skapa de två cirklarnas centra på v1-axeln (vinkelrätt mot normal_global) child_r = r_inter * 0.5 CC1 = mid_global - (child_r / 2.0) * v1 CC2 = mid_global + (child_r / 2.0) * v1 # Cirklarnas plan definieras av v1 och normal_global # Intersektionerna kommer att ske längs v2-axeln circle1_pts = circle_points(CC1, child_r, v1, normal_global, RES_CIRCLE) circle2_pts = circle_points(CC2, child_r, v1, normal_global, RES_CIRCLE) # 3. Absoluta intersektioner (Gröna fixerade punkter) intersections = get_circle_intersections(CC1, CC2, child_r, v1, normal_global) # ============================================================ # RENDERING (BUILD) # ============================================================ def trace_sphere(c, r, col): x, y, z = create_sphere(c, r, RES_SPHERE) return go.Surface(x=x, y=y, z=z, opacity=0.12, colorscale=[[0, col], [1, col]], showscale=False) def trace_circle(pts, col): return go.Scatter3d(x=pts[0], y=pts[1], z=pts[2], mode="lines", line=dict(color=col, width=6)) def trace_markers(pts, col, size, symbol='circle'): return go.Scatter3d(x=[p[0] for p in pts], y=[p[1] for p in pts], z=[p[2] for p in pts], mode="markers", marker=dict(size=size, color=col, symbol=symbol)) traces = [ trace_sphere(C1, R, COLOR_SPHERE_1), trace_sphere(C2, R, COLOR_SPHERE_2), trace_circle(circle1_pts, COLOR_CIRCLE_1), trace_circle(circle2_pts, COLOR_CIRCLE_2), # Centernoder (VITA) trace_markers([C1, C2, CC1, CC2], COLOR_CENTER, 5), # Intersektioner (GRÖNA - ABSOLUTA) trace_markers(intersections, COLOR_INTERSECT, 9) ] fig = go.Figure(data=traces) fig.update_layout( template="plotly_dark", scene=dict(xaxis=dict(visible=False), yaxis=dict(visible=False), zaxis=dict(visible=False), aspectmode="data"), paper_bgcolor=COLOR_BG, margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=0, b=0), showlegend=False ) out = "absolute_geometric_relation.html" fig.write_html(out) webbrowser.open("file://" + os.path.abspath(out)) fig.show() ⚖️ — License & CopyrightLicensed under RP9-LA-2026Copyright © 2026 Anton WallinSee LICENSE for full terms.

item.title: 03. invertdoz. PYTHON
item.description:
import numpy as np import plotly.graph_objects as go import plotly.io as pio import os import webbrowser pio.renderers.default = "browser" # ============================================================ # PARAMETRAR # ============================================================ R_ABS = 100.0 H_FACTOR = 0.25 RES_SPHERE = 120 RES_CIRCLE = 300 COLOR_BG = "black" COLOR_SPHERE_1 = "royalblue" COLOR_SPHERE_2 = "crimson" COLOR_CIRCLE_1 = "#00ffff" # Cyan COLOR_CIRCLE_2 = "#ff00ff" # Magenta COLOR_CENTER = "white" # Alla centrumnoder (sfärer + cirklar) COLOR_INTERSECT = "#00ff00" # Geometriskt absoluta intersektioner (Grön) # ============================================================ # GEOMETRI-FUNKTIONER (ABSOLUTA RELATIONER) # ============================================================ def hdr_value(value): return value * H_FACTOR * 4.0 def create_sphere(center, r, resolution): u = np.linspace(0.0, 2.0 * np.pi, resolution) v = np.linspace(0.0, np.pi, resolution) x = r * np.outer(np.cos(u), np.sin(v)) + center[0] y = r * np.outer(np.sin(u), np.sin(v)) + center[1] z = r * np.outer(np.ones_like(u), np.cos(v)) + center[2] return x, y, z def orthonormal_basis(normal): normal = normal / np.linalg.norm(normal) ref = np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0]) if abs(normal[0]) < 0.9 else np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0]) v1 = np.cross(normal, ref) v1 /= np.linalg.norm(v1) v2 = np.cross(normal, v1) return v1, v2 def circle_points(center, r, v1, v2, num_points): t = np.linspace(0.0, 2.0 * np.pi, num_points) return center.reshape(3, 1) + r * np.cos(t) * v1.reshape(3, 1) + r * np.sin(t) * v2.reshape(3, 1) def get_circle_intersections(c1, c2, r, v_plane, v_common): """ Beräknar de absoluta skärningspunkterna mellan två cirklar i 3D. Eftersom de ligger i samma plan och har samma radie är de fixerade. """ d = np.linalg.norm(c2 - c1) if d > 2*r: return [] mid = (c1 + c2) / 2.0 h = np.sqrt(max(0, r**2 - (d/2)**2)) # Punkterna rör sig längs den gemensamma axeln (v_common) p1 = mid + h * v_common p2 = mid - h * v_common return [p1, p2] # ============================================================ # BERÄKNINGSKEDJA # ============================================================ R = hdr_value(R_ABS) D = R # Sfärernas position C1 = np.array([-D / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0]) C2 = np.array([ D / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0]) # 1. Hitta skärningsplanet mellan sfärerna mid_global = (C1 + C2) / 2.0 normal_global = (C2 - C1) / np.linalg.norm(C2 - C1) v1, v2 = orthonormal_basis(normal_global) r_inter = np.sqrt(R**2 - (D/2)**2) # 2. Skapa de två cirklarnas centra på v1-axeln (vinkelrätt mot normal_global) child_r = r_inter * 0.5 CC1 = mid_global - (child_r / 2.0) * v1 CC2 = mid_global + (child_r / 2.0) * v1 # Cirklarnas plan definieras av v1 och normal_global # Intersektionerna kommer att ske längs v2-axeln circle1_pts = circle_points(CC1, child_r, v1, normal_global, RES_CIRCLE) circle2_pts = circle_points(CC2, child_r, v1, normal_global, RES_CIRCLE) # 3. Absoluta intersektioner (Gröna fixerade punkter) intersections = get_circle_intersections(CC1, CC2, child_r, v1, normal_global) # ============================================================ # RENDERING (BUILD) # ============================================================ def trace_sphere(c, r, col): x, y, z = create_sphere(c, r, RES_SPHERE) return go.Surface(x=x, y=y, z=z, opacity=0.12, colorscale=[[0, col], [1, col]], showscale=False) def trace_circle(pts, col): return go.Scatter3d(x=pts[0], y=pts[1], z=pts[2], mode="lines", line=dict(color=col, width=6)) def trace_markers(pts, col, size, symbol='circle'): return go.Scatter3d(x=[p[0] for p in pts], y=[p[1] for p in pts], z=[p[2] for p in pts], mode="markers", marker=dict(size=size, color=col, symbol=symbol)) traces = [ trace_sphere(C1, R, COLOR_SPHERE_1), trace_sphere(C2, R, COLOR_SPHERE_2), trace_circle(circle1_pts, COLOR_CIRCLE_1), trace_circle(circle2_pts, COLOR_CIRCLE_2), # Centernoder (VITA) trace_markers([C1, C2, CC1, CC2], COLOR_CENTER, 5), # Intersektioner (GRÖNA - ABSOLUTA) trace_markers(intersections, COLOR_INTERSECT, 9) ] fig = go.Figure(data=traces) fig.update_layout( template="plotly_dark", scene=dict(xaxis=dict(visible=False), yaxis=dict(visible=False), zaxis=dict(visible=False), aspectmode="data"), paper_bgcolor=COLOR_BG, margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=0, b=0), showlegend=False ) out = "absolute_geometric_relation.html" fig.write_html(out) webbrowser.open("file://" + os.path.abspath(out)) fig.show() # ============================================================ # RP9 — DATA + DERIVATION SHEET (H-D-R) # ============================================================ import math import json import os # ========================= # H — HALVERING / GRUND # ========================= r = 1.0 d = r # ========================= # D — DIFFERENS / POSITION # ========================= C1 = (-d/2, 0.0) C2 = ( d/2, 0.0) mid = ((C1[0]+C2[0])/2, (C1[1]+C2[1])/2) # ========================= # R — RELATION / KONSEKVENS # ========================= h = math.sqrt(3)/2 * r P_top = (r/2, h) P_bottom = (r/2, -h) # ========================= # DERIVATION STEPS # ========================= derivation = [ { "step": "H1", "type": "HALVERING", "description": "Definierar grundradie", "value": r }, { "step": "H2", "type": "HALVERING", "description": "Center distance = r", "value": d }, { "step": "D1", "type": "DIFFERENS", "description": "Skapar två centra", "C1": C1, "C2": C2 }, { "step": "D2", "type": "DIFFERENS", "description": "Beräknar mittpunkt", "midpoint": mid }, { "step": "R1", "type": "RELATION", "description": "Beräknar vesica-höjd", "formula": "sqrt(3)/2 * r", "value": h }, { "step": "R2", "type": "RELATION", "description": "Beräknar skärningspunkter", "top": P_top, "bottom": P_bottom } ] # ========================= # DATA SHEET # ========================= data_sheet = { "relation": { "radius": r, "center_distance": d }, "geometry": { "height": h, "top": P_top, "bottom": P_bottom }, "constants": { "sqrt2": math.sqrt(2), "sqrt3": math.sqrt(3), "sqrt5": math.sqrt(5), "pi": math.pi } } # ========================= # EXPORT # ========================= output = { "DATA_SHEET": data_sheet, "DERIVATION": derivation } # JSON with open("RP9_FULL_EXPORT.json", "w") as f: json.dump(output, f, indent=4) # MARKDOWN (utan triple quotes enligt din regel) md_lines = [] md_lines.append("# RP9 — FULL DATA + DERIVATION
") md_lines.append("## DATA SHEET
") md_lines.append("```json
") md_lines.append(json.dumps(data_sheet, indent=4)) md_lines.append("
```
") md_lines.append("## DERIVATION (H-D-R)
") for step in derivation: md_lines.append("- " + step["step"] + " — " + step["type"]) md_lines.append(" " + step["description"]) for k, v in step.items(): if k not in ["step", "type", "description"]: md_lines.append(" " + k + ": " + str(v)) md_lines.append("") with open("RP9_FULL_EXPORT.md", "w") as f: f.write("
".join(md_lines)) print("KLART — DATA + DERIVATION GENERERAD") ⚖️ — License & CopyrightLicensed under RP9-LA-2026Copyright © 2026 Anton WallinSee LICENSE for full terms.

item.title: 04. Info-render. PYTHON
item.description: import numpy as np import math import plotly.graph_objects as go import webbrowser import os # ============================================================ # PARAMETRAR # ============================================================ R_ABS = 100.0 # ============================================================ # HDR LOGIK # ============================================================ def hdr_value(r): # Systemnivå bibehålls return r # ============================================================ # GEOMETRI # ============================================================ R = hdr_value(R_ABS) D = R # SFÄRER → 2D projektion C1 = np.array([0.0, 0.0]) C2 = np.array([R, 0.0]) # VESICA h = math.sqrt(3) / 2 * R P_top = np.array([R/2, h]) P_bottom = np.array([R/2, -h]) # ============================================================ # HDR PÅ CIRKEL (KORREKT) # ============================================================ parent_radius = h child_r = parent_radius * 0.5 # HALVA-HALVA RELATION offset = child_r CC1 = np.array([R/2 - offset/2, 0]) CC2 = np.array([R/2 + offset/2, 0]) # ============================================================ # CIRKLAR # ============================================================ theta = np.linspace(0, 2*np.pi, 800) def circle(C, r): return ( C[0] + r*np.cos(theta), C[1] + r*np.sin(theta) ) # ============================================================ # FIGUR # ============================================================ fig = go.Figure() # ORIGINAL VESICA (referens) c1 = circle(C1, R) c2 = circle(C2, R) fig.add_trace(go.Scatter( x=c1[0], y=c1[1], mode="lines", line=dict(color="#00bfff", width=3), name="Circle C1" )) fig.add_trace(go.Scatter( x=c2[0], y=c2[1], mode="lines", line=dict(color="#ffcc00", width=3), name="Circle C2" )) # HDR CIRKLAR c_hdr1 = circle(CC1, child_r) c_hdr2 = circle(CC2, child_r) fig.add_trace(go.Scatter( x=c_hdr1[0], y=c_hdr1[1], mode="lines", line=dict(color="#00ffff", width=3), name="HDR C1" )) fig.add_trace(go.Scatter( x=c_hdr2[0], y=c_hdr2[1], mode="lines", line=dict(color="#ff00ff", width=3), name="HDR C2" )) # CENTER LINE fig.add_trace(go.Scatter( x=[C1[0], C2[0]], y=[C1[1], C2[1]], mode="lines", line=dict(color="white", dash="dot", width=1), name="Center distance = r" )) # INTERSEKTIONER (VESICA) fig.add_trace(go.Scatter( x=[P_top[0], P_bottom[0]], y=[P_top[1], P_bottom[1]], mode="markers", marker=dict(color="red", size=8), name="Intersections" )) # ============================================================ # ANNOTATIONER (EXAKT SOM DIN) # ============================================================ annotations = [] offset_text = R * 0.08 annotations.append(dict( x=P_top[0], y=P_top[1] + offset_text, text="Vesica height = √3 / 2", showarrow=False, font=dict(color="red", size=13), xanchor="center" )) annotations.append(dict( x=P_bottom[0], y=P_bottom[1] - offset_text, text="Vesica height = √3 / 2", showarrow=False, font=dict(color="red", size=13), xanchor="center" )) annotations.append(dict( x=R/2, y=0, text=f"Center distance = r = {R:.1f}", showarrow=False, font=dict(color="white", size=12), xanchor="center", yanchor="middle", bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0.6)" )) # ============================================================ # DATA PANEL (NU KORREKT HDR) # ============================================================ panel_text = ( "<b>STATUS</b><br>" "HDR-applied<br>" "Relational<br>" "Derived<br><br>" "<b>RELATIONS</b><br>" f"Radius (base) = {R:.1f}<br>" f"Radius (HDR) = {child_r:.4f}<br>" "Center distance = r<br><br>" "<b>GEOMETRY</b><br>" f"Height = √3 / 2 * r ≈ {h:.6f}<br>" f"HDR radius = {child_r:.6f}<br>" f"C1 = ({CC1[0]:.3f}, {CC1[1]:.3f})<br>" f"C2 = ({CC2[0]:.3f}, {CC2[1]:.3f})<br><br>" "<b>STRUCTURE</b><br>" "Halvering = aktiv<br>" "Dubblering = aktiv<br>" "Relation = Vesica<br><br>" "<b>LOCK</b><br>" "No free parameters<br>" "Deterministic" ) annotations.append(dict( x=R * 1.8, y=0, text=panel_text, showarrow=False, align="left", font=dict(color="#e0e0e0", size=12), bordercolor="white", borderwidth=1, bgcolor="black", xanchor="left", yanchor="middle" )) # ============================================================ # LAYOUT # ============================================================ fig.update_layout( annotations=annotations, title="RP9 — Vesica Piscis (HDR Data Sheet)", paper_bgcolor="black", plot_bgcolor="black", xaxis=dict(visible=False, range=[-R*0.5, R*2.5]), yaxis=dict(visible=False, scaleanchor="x", range=[-R*1.5, R*1.5]), font=dict(color="#e0e0e0"), margin=dict(l=20, r=20, t=50, b=20) ) # ============================================================ # EXPORT # ============================================================ out = os.path.abspath("RP9_HDR_DataSheet_FINAL.html") fig.write_html( out, include_plotlyjs=True, full_html=True, auto_open=False ) webbrowser.open(f"file:///{out}") print("KLART — HDR DATASHEET (KORREKT)") # ============================================================ # DATA EXPORT (HDR + VESICA) # LÄGG DIREKT OVANFÖR fig.show() # ============================================================ import json # --- BASDATA --- data = { "base": { "radius": R, "center_distance": D }, "vesica": { "height": h, "top": [P_top[0], P_top[1]], "bottom": [P_bottom[0], P_bottom[1]] }, "hdr": { "parent_radius": parent_radius, "child_radius": child_r, "scale_ratio": child_r / parent_radius, "centers": { "C1": [CC1[0], CC1[1]], "C2": [CC2[0], CC2[1]] } }, "constants": { "sqrt2": math.sqrt(2), "sqrt3": math.sqrt(3), "sqrt5": math.sqrt(5), "pi": math.pi } } # --- PRINT --- print("\n================= DATA SHEET =================") print(json.dumps(data, indent=4)) # --- SAVE JSON --- json_file = "RP9_HDR_FULL.json" with open(json_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(data, f, indent=4) print(f"\nJSON sparad: {os.path.abspath(json_file)}") # ============================================================ # VISUELL OVERLAY PANEL (MATCHAR DIN PRO) # ============================================================ panel_text = ( "<b>FULL DATA</b><br><br>" "<b>BASE</b><br>" f"R = {R:.3f}<br>" f"D = {D:.3f}<br><br>" "<b>VESICA</b><br>" f"h = {h:.6f}<br>" f"Top = ({P_top[0]:.3f}, {P_top[1]:.6f})<br>" f"Bottom = ({P_bottom[0]:.3f}, {P_bottom[1]:.6f})<br><br>" "<b>HDR</b><br>" f"Parent r = {parent_radius:.6f}<br>" f"Child r = {child_r:.6f}<br>" f"Scale = {child_r/parent_radius:.3f}<br>" f"C1 = ({CC1[0]:.3f}, {CC1[1]:.3f})<br>" f"C2 = ({CC2[0]:.3f}, {CC2[1]:.3f})<br><br>" "<b>CONSTANTS</b><br>" f"√2 = {math.sqrt(2):.6f}<br>" f"√3 = {math.sqrt(3):.6f}<br>" f"√5 = {math.sqrt(5):.6f}<br>" f"π = {math.pi:.6f}" ) fig.add_annotation( x=R * 2.2, y=0, text=panel_text, showarrow=False, align="left", font=dict(color="#e0e0e0", size=12), bordercolor="white", borderwidth=1, bgcolor="black", xanchor="left", yanchor="middle" ) ⚖️ — License & CopyrightLicensed under RP9-LA-2026Copyright © 2026 Anton WallinSee LICENSE for full terms.

item.title: 05. Info-render. PYTHON
item.description:
import numpy as np import math import json import os import webbrowser import plotly.graph_objects as go import plotly.io as pio pio.renderers.default = "browser" # ============================================================ # PARAMETRAR # ============================================================ R_ABS = 100.0 H_FACTOR = 0.25 RES = 800 COLOR_BG = "black" COLOR_BASE_1 = "#00bfff" COLOR_BASE_2 = "#ffcc00" COLOR_HDR_1 = "#00ffff" COLOR_HDR_2 = "#ff00ff" COLOR_CENTER_BASE = "white" COLOR_CENTER_HDR = "#ffff00" COLOR_INTERSECTION_BASE = "red" COLOR_INTERSECTION_HDR = "#ff8800" COLOR_CENTERLINE = "white" # ============================================================ # HDR # ============================================================ def hdr_value(v): # Samma systemnivå tillbaka return (v * H_FACTOR) * 4.0 # ============================================================ # GEOMETRI # ============================================================ def circle(center, radius, num=800): theta = np.linspace(0.0, 2.0 * np.pi, num) x = center[0] + radius * np.cos(theta) y = center[1] + radius * np.sin(theta) return x, y def circle_intersections(c1, c2, radius): d = np.linalg.norm(c2 - c1) a = d / 2.0 h = np.sqrt(radius**2 - a**2) mid = (c1 + c2) / 2.0 direction = (c2 - c1) / d perp = np.array([-direction[1], direction[0]]) p1 = mid + h * perp p2 = mid - h * perp return p1, p2, h def hdr_circle(center, radius): # Halvering = faktisk storlekshalvering child_radius = radius * 0.5 # Relation = center distance = radius offset = child_radius / 2.0 c1 = center - np.array([offset, 0.0]) c2 = center + np.array([offset, 0.0]) return c1, c2, child_radius def as_float(x): return float(x) def as_list(arr): return [float(v) for v in arr] # ============================================================ # 1. BAS → VESICA # ============================================================ R = hdr_value(R_ABS) D = R C1 = np.array([0.0, 0.0]) C2 = np.array([D, 0.0]) P_top, P_bottom, h = circle_intersections(C1, C2, R) parent_center = np.array([D / 2.0, 0.0]) parent_radius = h # ============================================================ # 2. HDR PÅ VESICA-CIRKEL # ============================================================ CC1, CC2, child_r = hdr_circle(parent_center, parent_radius) # ============================================================ # 3. INTERSEKTION AV HDR-CIRKLAR # ============================================================ P2_top, P2_bottom, h2 = circle_intersections(CC1, CC2, child_r) dist_children = np.linalg.norm(CC2 - CC1) # ============================================================ # VERIFIERING # ============================================================ verification = { "vesica": { "expected_height": as_float((math.sqrt(3.0) / 2.0) * R), "computed_height": as_float(h), "height_valid": bool(abs(((math.sqrt(3.0) / 2.0) * R) - h) < 1e-9) }, "hdr": { "parent_radius": as_float(parent_radius), "child_radius": as_float(child_r), "expected_child_radius": as_float(parent_radius * 0.5), "child_radius_valid": bool(abs((parent_radius * 0.5) - child_r) < 1e-9), "center_distance": as_float(dist_children), "relation_valid": bool(abs(dist_children - child_r) < 1e-9) }, "second_vesica": { "expected_height": as_float((math.sqrt(3.0) / 2.0) * child_r), "computed_height": as_float(h2), "height_valid": bool(abs(((math.sqrt(3.0) / 2.0) * child_r) - h2) < 1e-9) } } # ============================================================ # HÄRLEDNING # ============================================================ derivation = { "STEP_1_BASE_INPUT": { "input_radius_absolute": as_float(R_ABS), "H_factor": "25%", "D_factor": "x4", "result_radius": as_float(R) }, "STEP_2_BASE_RELATION": { "rule": "center_distance = radius", "base_center_1": as_list(C1), "base_center_2": as_list(C2), "distance": as_float(D) }, "STEP_3_FIRST_VESICA": { "formula": "h = sqrt(r^2 - (r/2)^2)", "height": as_float(h), "top": as_list(P_top), "bottom": as_list(P_bottom) }, "STEP_4_HDR_ON_VESICA_CIRCLE": { "operation_H": "child_radius = parent_radius * 0.5", "operation_D": "2 circles", "operation_R": "center_distance = child_radius", "parent_center": as_list(parent_center), "parent_radius": as_float(parent_radius), "child_radius": as_float(child_r), "child_center_1": as_list(CC1), "child_center_2": as_list(CC2) }, "STEP_5_SECOND_VESICA": { "formula": "h2 = sqrt(r^2 - (r/2)^2)", "height": as_float(h2), "top": as_list(P2_top), "bottom": as_list(P2_bottom) } } # ============================================================ # DATA SHEET # ============================================================ data_sheet = { "base": { "radius": as_float(R), "center_distance": as_float(D), "center_1": as_list(C1), "center_2": as_list(C2) }, "vesica": { "height": as_float(h), "top": as_list(P_top), "bottom": as_list(P_bottom), "relational_center": as_list(parent_center), "parent_radius": as_float(parent_radius) }, "hdr": { "child_radius": as_float(child_r), "child_center_distance": as_float(dist_children), "centers": { "C1": as_list(CC1), "C2": as_list(CC2) } }, "hdr_intersections": { "top": as_list(P2_top), "bottom": as_list(P2_bottom), "height": as_float(h2) }, "constants": { "sqrt2": as_float(math.sqrt(2.0)), "sqrt3": as_float(math.sqrt(3.0)), "sqrt5": as_float(math.sqrt(5.0)), "pi": as_float(math.pi) }, "verification": verification, "derivation": derivation } # ============================================================ # PRINT + EXPORT # ============================================================ json_output = json.dumps(data_sheet, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False) print("") print("=========== FULL DATA SHEET ===========") print(json_output) print("======================================") json_file = "RP9_HDR_FULL_DATASHEET.json" with open(json_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(data_sheet, f, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False) markdown_output = ( "# RP9 HDR Full Data Sheet

" "## JSON Output

" "```json
" + json_output + "
```

" "## Härledning

" "```text
" "R_abs
" "→ H(25%)
" "→ D(x4)
" "→ R
" "→ två bascirklar
" "→ vesica
" "→ parent_radius = vesica_height
" "→ H(parent_radius * 0.5)
" "→ D(2 HDR-cirklar)
" "→ R(center_distance = child_radius)
" "→ andra vesica / intersektion
" "```
" ) md_file = "RP9_HDR_FULL_DATASHEET.md" with open(md_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(markdown_output) print("") print("Filer skapade:") print(os.path.abspath(json_file)) print(os.path.abspath(md_file)) # ============================================================ # FIGUR # ============================================================ fig = go.Figure() # Bas-cirklar x1, y1 = circle(C1, R, RES) x2, y2 = circle(C2, R, RES) fig.add_trace(go.Scatter( x=x1, y=y1, mode="lines", line=dict(color=COLOR_BASE_1, width=3), name="Base Circle C1" )) fig.add_trace(go.Scatter( x=x2, y=y2, mode="lines", line=dict(color=COLOR_BASE_2, width=3), name="Base Circle C2" )) # HDR-cirklar x3, y3 = circle(CC1, child_r, RES) x4, y4 = circle(CC2, child_r, RES) fig.add_trace(go.Scatter( x=x3, y=y3, mode="lines", line=dict(color=COLOR_HDR_1, width=3), name="HDR Circle C1" )) fig.add_trace(go.Scatter( x=x4, y=y4, mode="lines", line=dict(color=COLOR_HDR_2, width=3), name="HDR Circle C2" )) # Centerlinje bas fig.add_trace(go.Scatter( x=[C1[0], C2[0]], y=[C1[1], C2[1]], mode="lines", line=dict(color=COLOR_CENTERLINE, dash="dot", width=1), name="Base center distance" )) # Bas-intersektioner fig.add_trace(go.Scatter( x=[P_top[0], P_bottom[0]], y=[P_top[1], P_bottom[1]], mode="markers", marker=dict(color=COLOR_INTERSECTION_BASE, size=9), name="Base intersections" )) # HDR-intersektioner fig.add_trace(go.Scatter( x=[P2_top[0], P2_bottom[0]], y=[P2_top[1], P2_bottom[1]], mode="markers", marker=dict(color=COLOR_INTERSECTION_HDR, size=9), name="HDR intersections" )) # Bas-centra fig.add_trace(go.Scatter( x=[C1[0], C2[0]], y=[C1[1], C2[1]], mode="markers", marker=dict(color=COLOR_CENTER_BASE, size=8), name="Base centers" )) # HDR-centra fig.add_trace(go.Scatter( x=[CC1[0], CC2[0]], y=[CC1[1], CC2[1]], mode="markers", marker=dict(color=COLOR_CENTER_HDR, size=8), name="HDR centers" )) # ============================================================ # ANNOTATIONS # ============================================================ offset_text = R * 0.08 annotations = [] annotations.append(dict( x=P_top[0], y=P_top[1] + offset_text, text="Base vesica height = √3 / 2 · R", showarrow=False, font=dict(color=COLOR_INTERSECTION_BASE, size=13), xanchor="center" )) annotations.append(dict( x=P_bottom[0], y=P_bottom[1] - offset_text, text="Base vesica height = √3 / 2 · item.title: 06. MASTER-RUNNER. PYTHON
item.description: # ============================================================ # MASTER-RUNNER.py # RP9 PIPELINE ORCHESTRATOR # VERSION: 2.0 # ============================================================ import os import sys import subprocess import time from datetime import datetime # ============================================================ # CONFIG # ============================================================ PIPELINE = [ "00_invertdoz.py", "01_invertdoz.py", "02_invertdoz.py", "03_invertdoz.py", "04_Info_render_invertdoz.py", "05_Info_render_invertdoz.py" ] # ============================================================ # ROOT # ============================================================ ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)) OUTPUT_DIR = os.path.join(ROOT, "OUTPUT") LOG_DIR = os.path.join(ROOT, "LOGS") os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True) os.makedirs(LOG_DIR, exist_ok=True) # ============================================================ # LOG # ============================================================ TIMESTAMP = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S") LOG_FILE = os.path.join( LOG_DIR, f"MASTER_RUNNER_{TIMESTAMP}.log" ) # ============================================================ # LOG FUNCTION # ============================================================ def write_log(text): timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") line = f"[{timestamp}] {text}" print(line) with open(LOG_FILE, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(line + "\n") # ============================================================ # HEADER # ============================================================ def print_header(): write_log("=" * 70) write_log("RP9 MASTER PIPELINE") write_log("START") write_log("=" * 70) write_log(f"ROOT: {ROOT}") write_log(f"OUTPUT: {OUTPUT_DIR}") write_log(f"LOG: {LOG_FILE}") write_log("") write_log("PIPELINE:") for i, step in enumerate(PIPELINE, start=1): write_log(f"{i:02d}. {step}") write_log("") write_log("=" * 70) # ============================================================ # VERIFY FILES # ============================================================ def verify_pipeline(): write_log("VERIFYING FILES") missing = [] for script in PIPELINE: full_path = os.path.join(ROOT, script) if os.path.exists(full_path): write_log(f"[OK] {script}") else: write_log(f"[MISSING] {script}") missing.append(script) if missing: write_log("") write_log("ABORTED — MISSING FILES DETECTED") for item in missing: write_log(f" - {item}") return False write_log("") write_log("ALL FILES VERIFIED") write_log("") return True # ============================================================ # RUN SCRIPT # ============================================================ def run_script(script_name): full_path = os.path.join(ROOT, script_name) write_log("") write_log("=" * 70) write_log(f"RUNNING: {script_name}") write_log("=" * 70) start_time = time.time() env = os.environ.copy() env["RP9_OUTPUT_DIR"] = OUTPUT_DIR try: result = subprocess.run( [sys.executable, full_path], cwd=ROOT, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True ) duration = round(time.time() - start_time, 3) write_log(f"EXIT CODE: {result.returncode}") write_log(f"DURATION: {duration} sec") # ==================================================== # STDOUT # ==================================================== if result.stdout.strip(): write_log("") write_log("STDOUT:") write_log("-" * 40) for line in result.stdout.splitlines(): write_log(line) # ==================================================== # STDERR # ==================================================== if result.stderr.strip(): write_log("") write_log("STDERR:") write_log("-" * 40) for line in result.stderr.splitlines(): write_log(line) # ==================================================== # STATUS # ==================================================== if result.returncode != 0: write_log("") write_log(f"[FAILED] {script_name}") return False write_log("") write_log(f"[SUCCESS] {script_name}") return True except Exception as e: write_log("") write_log(f"[EXCEPTION] {script_name}") write_log(str(e)) return False # ============================================================ # MAIN # ============================================================ def main(): print_header() verified = verify_pipeline() if not verified: return 1 success_count = 0 fail_count = 0 for script in PIPELINE: ok = run_script(script) if ok: success_count += 1 else: fail_count += 1 write_log("") write_log("=" * 70) write_log("PIPELINE ABORTED") write_log("=" * 70) break # ======================================================== # FINAL STATUS # ======================================================== write_log("") write_log("=" * 70) write_log("FINAL STATUS") write_log("=" * 70) write_log(f"SUCCESS: {success_count}") write_log(f"FAILED : {fail_count}") if fail_count == 0: write_log("") write_log("PIPELINE COMPLETE") else: write_log("") write_log("PIPELINE FAILED") write_log("") write_log(f"LOG FILE: {LOG_FILE}") return fail_count # ============================================================ # ENTRY # ============================================================ if __name__ == "__main__": exit_code = 0 try: exit_code = main() except KeyboardInterrupt: write_log("") write_log("ABORTED BY USER") exit_code = 999 except Exception as e: write_log("") write_log("FATAL ERROR") write_log(str(e)) exit_code = 500 print("") print("=" * 70) print("MASTER RUNNER FINISHED") print("=" * 70) print("") input("Press ENTER to close...") sys.exit(exit_code) ⚖️ — License & CopyrightLicensed under RP9-LA-2026Copyright © 2026 Anton WallinSee LICENSE for full terms.

HDR Multi Iteration Probe RP9 MULTI-STEP ANALYSIS OF THE H-D-R SEQUENCE verifies that the established structural relationship persists under successive H-D-R iteration.The purpose of the code is not to create a new relationship.The purpose of the code is to examine whether the previously verified structure:3/4 ↔ 1/4 remains invariant when the system is iterated through several levels.This layer verifies:Structural invariance The focus is not on:First relation First residual First structure but on:Stability of the structure through repetition. The code iterates the H-D-R sequence:H = R / 4 D = H × 4 R = D / 2 through several levels.The verification is performed for:1x HDR 2x HDR 3x HDR 4x HDR 5x HDR For each iteration, the following is recorded:r_exact area_ratio diagonal as well as the simplified relation.Previous layers verify:That the relation exists. But they do not answer the question:Does the relation survive repeated transformation? This layer therefore functions as the first recursive verification in K1 META.It examines whether:3/4 is a local resultoran invariant structure.The verification is divided into:1x HDR 2x HDR 3x HDR 4x HDR 5x HDR For each level, the following is checked:Radius Diagonal Area relation Simplified relation The results are exported to both:JSON Markdown for independent review.Expected development:R R/2 R/4 R/8 R/16 R/32 Expected observation:The scale changes but:3/4 remains at all iterations.The verification shows:Iteration 1 R = 1/2 Ratio = 3/4 Iteration 2 R = 1/4 Ratio = 3/4 Iteration 3 R = 1/8 Ratio = 3/4 Iteration 4 R = 1/16 Ratio = 3/4 Iteration 5 R = 1/32 Ratio = 3/4 The simplified relation:3/4 remains throughout the sequence.The code verifies that the H-D-R sequence changes:Size Radius Diagonal but not:Relation The result shows that:3/4 behaves as an invariant relation through several successive iterations.The verification thus supports that the structure is not bound to a specific scale.The code generates:RP9_HDR_Multi_Iteration_Probe.json RP9_HDR_Multi_Iteration_Probe.md and associated Python code.FIRST DIFFERENTIATION establishes:The first relation. item.title: C. (THE H-D-R. SEQ) . — PYTHON
item.description:
Quote DOCUMENT — id: K1. META FOLDER — Name: META GROUP 1-5 GROUP id — Name: THE H–D–R SEQUENCE GROUP id — Number: GROUP ID. K1. 01
LINK 🔗. GROUP ID. K1. 01
LINK — 🔗. K1. 5. D. H-D-R AS PURE GENERATOR from fractions import Fraction import sympy as sp import json from decimal import Decimal, getcontext from pathlib import Path getcontext().prec = 80 # ------------------------------------------------------------------- # SCRIPT FOLDER # ------------------------------------------------------------------- SCRIPT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent # ------------------------------------------------------------------- # OUTPUT FOLDER # ------------------------------------------------------------------- OUTPUT_DIR = SCRIPT_DIR / "RP9_MULTI-STEP_ANALYSIS_OF_THE_H–D–R_SEQUENCE" OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) # ------------------------------------------------------------------- # HDR # ------------------------------------------------------------------- def hdr_exact(iterations=1): r = sp.Rational(1) results = [] for i in range(1, iterations + 1): h = r / 4 d = h * 4 r_new = d / 2 ri = sp.sqrt(r_new**2 - (r_new / 2) ** 2) area_ratio = ( (sp.pi * ri**2) / (sp.pi * r_new**2) ) results.append( { "iteration": i, "r_exact": str(r_new), "area_ratio_exact": str(area_ratio), "area_ratio_simplified": str( sp.simplify(area_ratio) ), "diagonal": str( sp.sqrt(2) * r_new ), } ) r = r_new return results # ------------------------------------------------------------------- # ANALYSIS # ------------------------------------------------------------------- all_results = {} for n in [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]: print(f"\n=== {n}x H-D-R ===") res = hdr_exact(n) all_results[f"{n}x_HDR"] = res for step in res: print(step) # ------------------------------------------------------------------- # JSON # ------------------------------------------------------------------- json_file = ( OUTPUT_DIR / "RP9_HDR_Multi_Iteration_Probe.json" ) with open( json_file, "w", encoding="utf-8" ) as f: json.dump( all_results, f, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False ) # ------------------------------------------------------------------- # MARKDOWN # ------------------------------------------------------------------- md_lines = [] md_lines.append( "# RP9 HDR Multi Iteration Probe" ) md_lines.append("") md_lines.append( "Automatically generated report." ) md_lines.append("") for hdr_name, steps in all_results.items(): md_lines.append( f"## {hdr_name}" ) md_lines.append("") md_lines.append( "| Iteration | r_exact | Area Ratio | Simplified Ratio | Diagonal |" ) md_lines.append( "|-----------|---------|------------|--------------------|----------|" ) for step in steps: md_lines.append( f"| {step['iteration']} " f"| {step['r_exact']} " f"| {step['area_ratio_exact']} " f"| {step['area_ratio_simplified']} " f"| {step['diagonal']} |" ) md_lines.append("") md_file = ( OUTPUT_DIR / "RP9_HDR_Multi_Iteration_Probe.md" ) with open( md_file, "w", encoding="utf-8" ) as f: f.write( "\n".join(md_lines) ) # ------------------------------------------------------------------- # FINAL REPORT # ------------------------------------------------------------------- print("\nDONE") print("") print(f"OUTPUT FOLDER : {OUTPUT_DIR}") print(f"JSON : {json_file}") print(f"MARKDOWN : {md_file}") input("\nPress ENTER to exit...") ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.

README # VESCIA_PISCIS_presentation_V2.py # Version: 2.0.0 # File type: Python # Purpose: # - Presentation-grade Vesica Piscis verification for RP9. # - No HTML rendering. # - Obsidian-safe Markdown output without backtick-wrapped math in tables. # - Separates measurement, representation, trace, control log, audit, verify and RP9 interpretation. # - Self-contained: uses Python standard library only. import argparse import datetime import hashlib import json import math import platform import sys import traceback from decimal import Decimal, getcontext from fractions import Fraction from pathlib import Path getcontext().prec = 80 SCRIPT_NAME = "RP9_VESCIA_PISCIS_THE_FIRST_STRUCTURE.py" SCRIPT_VERSION = "RP9_VESCIA_PISCIS_THE_FIRST_STRUCTURE." OUTPUT_DIR_NAME = "RP9_VESCIA_PISCIS_THE_FIRST_STRUCTURE." def base_dir(): try: return Path(__file__).resolve().parent except NameError: return Path.cwd().resolve() BASE_DIR = base_dir() OUTPUT_DIR = BASE_DIR / OUTPUT_DIR_NAME def now_local(): return datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") def now_utc(): return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z") def ensure_output_dir(): OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) def sci(value, digits=20): return format(float(value), "." + str(digits) + "e") def fixed(value, digits=14): return format(float(value), "." + str(digits) + "f") def decimal_from_fraction(value, places): d = Decimal(value.numerator) / Decimal(value.denominator) return format(d, "." + str(places) + "f") def json_safe(obj): if isinstance(obj, dict): out = {} for key, value in obj.items(): out[str(key)] = json_safe(value) return out if isinstance(obj, list): return [json_safe(value) for value in obj] if isinstance(obj, tuple): return [json_safe(value) for value in obj] if isinstance(obj, Path): return str(obj) if isinstance(obj, Fraction): return str(obj) if isinstance(obj, Decimal): return str(obj) if isinstance(obj, bool): return bool(obj) if isinstance(obj, int): return int(obj) if isinstance(obj, float): return float(obj) if obj is None: return None return obj def write_json(path, payload): path.write_text(json.dumps(json_safe(payload), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8") def write_text(path, lines): path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8") def sha256_file(path): h = hashlib.sha256() with path.open("rb") as f: while True: chunk = f.read(1024 * 1024) if not chunk: break h.update(chunk) return h.hexdigest() def append_trace(trace, layer, operation, formula, inputs, result, status, note): trace.append({ "index": len(trace) + 1, "timestamp_utc": now_utc(), "layer": layer, "operation": operation, "formula": formula, "inputs": json_safe(inputs), "result": json_safe(result), "status": status, "note": note }) def append_audit(audit, action, status, details): audit.append({ "index": len(audit) + 1, "timestamp_utc": now_utc(), "action": action, "status": status, "details": json_safe(details) }) def run_vesica_analysis(): trace = [] r_exact = Fraction(1, 1) d_exact = Fraction(1, 1) half_distance_exact = d_exact / 2 h_central_squared_exact = r_exact * r_exact - half_distance_exact * half_distance_exact h_central_exact = "sqrt(3)/2" l_h_exact = "r" l_d_exact = "r" l_v_exact = "sqrt(3)*r" l_h_squared_exact = Fraction(1, 1) l_d_squared_exact = Fraction(1, 1) l_v_squared_exact = Fraction(3, 1) structural_ratio_exact = h_central_squared_exact / (r_exact * r_exact) lock_exact = Fraction(1, 1) - structural_ratio_exact relation_1_5_over_2 = Fraction(3, 2) / Fraction(2, 1) r_float = 1.0 l_h_float = r_float l_d_float = r_float l_v_float = math.sqrt(3.0) * r_float h_central_float = l_v_float / 2.0 structural_ratio_float = (h_central_float * h_central_float) / (l_h_float * l_h_float) lock_float = 1.0 - structural_ratio_float ratio_residual_float = structural_ratio_float - 0.75 lock_residual_float = lock_float - 0.25 symmetric_residual = bool(abs(ratio_residual_float + lock_residual_float) <= 1e-30) append_trace( trace, "MEASUREMENT_LAYER", "define_radius", "r = 1", {}, {"r_exact": str(r_exact), "r_float": fixed(r_float)}, "PASS", "Defines the normalized radius used as measurement base." ) append_trace( trace, "MEASUREMENT_LAYER", "define_primary_segments", "L_H = r ; L_D = r ; L_V = sqrt(3) * r", {"r": str(r_exact)}, {"L_H": l_h_exact, "L_D": l_d_exact, "L_V": l_v_exact}, "PASS", "Defines horizontal, diagonal and vertical Vesica Piscis segments." ) append_trace( trace, "MEASUREMENT_LAYER", "calculate_vertical_float", "L_V = sqrt(3) * r", {"r_float": fixed(r_float)}, {"L_V_float": fixed(l_v_float), "ratio_LV_LH": fixed(l_v_float / l_h_float)}, "PASS", "Computes the IEEE 754 rendering of the vertical sqrt(3) segment." ) append_trace( trace, "QUADRATIC_LAYER", "calculate_central_height_squared", "h_central^2 = r^2 - (d/2)^2", {"r": str(r_exact), "d": str(d_exact)}, {"h_central_squared": str(h_central_squared_exact), "h_central": h_central_exact}, "PASS", "Computes the exact central height relation using Fraction arithmetic." ) append_trace( trace, "QUADRATIC_LAYER", "calculate_structural_ratio", "h_central^2 / r^2", {"h_central_squared": str(h_central_squared_exact), "r_squared": str(r_exact * r_exact)}, {"ratio_exact": str(structural_ratio_exact), "lock_exact": str(lock_exact)}, "PASS", "The quadratic relation resolves to the exact 3/4 and 1/4 structure." ) append_trace( trace, "REPRESENTATION_LAYER", "calculate_float_residual", "float_ratio - 0.75", {"float_ratio": sci(structural_ratio_float), "exact_target": "0.75"}, {"ratio_residual": sci(ratio_residual_float), "lock_residual": sci(lock_residual_float)}, "PASS", "Computes the representational residual introduced by the float path." ) payload = { "metadata": { "script_name": SCRIPT_NAME, "script_version": SCRIPT_VERSION, "created_at_local": now_local(), "created_at_utc": now_utc(), "framework": "RP9 - Relational Primacy", "author": "Anton Wallin", "html_rendering": "disabled", "markdown_profile": "Obsidian-safe, no backtick-wrapped math in tables" }, "measurement_layer": { "symbolic_segments": { "L_H": l_h_exact, "L_D": l_d_exact, "L_V": l_v_exact, "ratio_LV_LH": "sqrt(3)", "ratio_LV_LD": "sqrt(3)", "ratio_LD_LH": "1" }, "numerical_ieee754": { "r_value": r_float, "L_H": l_h_float, "L_D": l_d_float, "L_V": l_v_float, "ratio_LV_LH": l_v_float / l_h_float, "ratio_LV_LD": l_v_float / l_d_float, "ratio_LD_LH": l_d_float / l_h_float } }, "quadratic_layer": { "exact_relations": { "L_H_squared": str(l_h_squared_exact), "L_D_squared": str(l_d_squared_exact), "L_V_squared": str(l_v_squared_exact), "h_central": h_central_exact, "h_central_squared": str(h_central_squared_exact), "structural_ratio": str(structural_ratio_exact), "structural_lock": str(lock_exact), "relation_1_5_over_2": str(relation_1_5_over_2) }, "decimal_rendering": { "structural_ratio_20_places": decimal_from_fraction(structural_ratio_exact, 20), "structural_lock_20_places": decimal_from_fraction(lock_exact, 20) } }, "representation_layer": { "float_path": { "h_central_float": h_central_float, "structural_ratio_float": structural_ratio_float, "structural_lock_float": lock_float, "ratio_minus_0_75": ratio_residual_float, "lock_minus_0_25": lock_residual_float, "symmetric_residual": symmetric_residual } }, "rp9_interpretation_layer": { "separated_from_measurement": True, "primary_statement": "The linear sqrt(3) segment is read as the visible line trace of the exact quadratic 3/4 relation.", "preferred_wording": "Detta visar operationellt att den vertikala sqrt(3)-linjen inte ar ett isolerat tillstand. Den ar det linjara sparet av en invariant 1.5 / 2-relation pa strukturniva.", "review_boundary": "Measurement verifies the geometry and the representation residual. RP9 interpretation is kept as a separate reading layer." }, "status": { "structural_ratio_is_3_4": bool(structural_ratio_exact == Fraction(3, 4)), "lock_is_1_4": bool(lock_exact == Fraction(1, 4)), "relation_1_5_over_2_is_3_4": bool(relation_1_5_over_2 == Fraction(3, 4)), "symmetric_residual": symmetric_residual, "total_status": "PASS" } } return payload, trace def md_table_escape(text): return str(text).replace("|", "\\|") def build_markdown(payload, trace): m = payload["measurement_layer"] q = payload["quadratic_layer"] r = payload["representation_layer"] interp = payload["rp9_interpretation_layer"] status = payload["status"] lines = [] lines.append("---") lines.append("# RP9 - VESICA PISCIS GEOMETRIC VERIFICATION") lines.append("") lines.append("---") lines.append("") lines.append("## Syfte") lines.append("") lines.append("Detta dokument presenterar Vesica Piscis som ett granskningsbart mätlager: linjär mätning, kvadratisk relation, representationell residual och separat RP9-tolkning.") lines.append("") lines.append("HTML-rendering är avstängd. payload["status"]["total_status"]) lines.append("Output directory: " + str(OUTPUT_DIR)) for key, value in paths.items(): lines.append(key + ": " + str(value)) return lines def write_outputs(payload, {"path": full_path}) write_json(full_path, {"payload": payload, "trace": trace}) append_audit(audit, "write_markdown", "ok", {"path": md_path}) write_text(md_path, build_markdown(payload, trace)) append_audit(audit, "write_control_log", "ok", {"path": control_path}) write_text(control_path, build_control_log(payload, trace)) paths = { "data_json": data_path, "trace_json": trace_path, "full_datasheet_json": full_path, "presentation_markdown": md_path, "control_log": control_path, "execution_log": execution_path, "audit_json": audit_path, "verify_json": verify_path } append_audit(audit, "write_execution_log", "ok", {"path": execution_path}) write_text(execution_path, build_execution_log(paths, payload)) audit_payload = { "script_name": SCRIPT_NAME, "script_version": SCRIPT_VERSION, "created_at_utc": now_utc(), "entry_count": len(audit), "entries": audit } write_json(audit_path, audit_payload) verify_files = {} for key, path in paths.items(): if path.exists() and path != verify_path: verify_files[key] = { "path": str(path), "bytes": path.stat().st_size, "sha256": sha256_file(path) } verify_payload = { "script_name": SCRIPT_NAME, "script_version": SCRIPT_VERSION, "generated_at_utc": now_utc(), "purpose": "Verification hashes for generated Vesica Piscis presentation artifacts.", "files": verify_files } write_json(verify_path, verify_payload) return paths def print_summary(payload, paths): print("") print("=" * 72) print("RP9 VESICA PISCIS PRESENTATION V2") print("=" * 72) print("Status:", payload["status"]["total_status"]) print("Structural ratio:", payload["quadratic_layer"]["exact_relations"]["structural_ratio"]) print("Structural lock:", payload["quadratic_layer"]["exact_relations"]["structural_lock"]) print("Float ratio:", sci(payload["representation_layer"]["float_path"]["structural_ratio_float"])) print("Residual:", sci(payload["representation_layer"]["float_path"]["ratio_minus_0_75"])) print("-" * 72) for key, value in paths.items(): print(key + ":", value) print("=" * 72) print("") def generate_once(): audit = [] append_audit(audit, "start_generation", "ok", { "script_name": SCRIPT_NAME, "script_version": SCRIPT_VERSION, "python_version": sys.version, "platform": platform.platform(), "working_directory": BASE_DIR }) payload, trace = run_vesica_analysis() append_audit(audit, "run_analysis", "ok", {"trace_count": len(trace)}) paths = write_outputs(payload, trace, audit) append_audit(audit, "finish_generation", "ok", {"status": payload["status"]["total_status"]}) print_summary(payload, paths) return payload, trace, paths def interactive_menu(): payload, trace, paths = generate_once() while True: print("") print("=" * 72) print("RP9 VESICA PISCIS - PRESENTATION V2") print("=" * 72) print("1. Visa sammanfattning") print("2. Visa measurement layer") print("3. Visa quadratic layer") print("4. Visa representation layer") print("5. Skriv om alla exportfiler") print("6. Visa exportvägar") print("0. Avsluta") choice = input("Ditt val (0-6): ").strip() if choice == "1": print_summary(payload, paths) elif choice == "2": print(json.dumps(json_safe(payload["measurement_layer"]), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)) elif choice == "3": print(json.dumps(json_safe(payload["quadratic_layer"]), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)) elif choice == "4": print(json.dumps(json_safe(payload["representation_layer"]), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)) elif choice == "5": payload, trace, paths = generate_once() elif choice == "6": for key, value in paths.items(): print(key + ":", value) elif choice == "0": print("Avslutar.") break else: print("Ogiltigt val.") input("Tryck Enter för att fortsätta...") def write_error_log(exc): ensure_output_dir() path = OUTPUT_DIR / "rp9_vesica_piscis_error.log" lines = [] lines.append("RP9 VESICA PISCIS ERROR LOG") lines.append("=" * 72) lines.append("Timestamp local: " + now_local()) lines.append("Timestamp UTC: " + now_utc()) lines.append("Error type: " + type(exc).__name__) lines.append("Error message: " + str(exc)) lines.append("") lines.append("TRACEBACK") lines.append("-" * 72) lines.extend(traceback.format_exc().splitlines()) write_text(path, lines) return path def parse_args(): parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="RP9 Vesica Piscis presentation V2 generator.") parser.add_argument("--run-once", action="store_true", help="Generate all files once and exit without menu.") return parser.parse_args() def main(): args = parse_args() try: if args.run_once: generate_once() else: interactive_menu() except KeyboardInterrupt: print("") print("Avbrutet av användaren.") except Exception as exc: error_path = write_error_log(exc) print("ERROR:", str(exc)) print("Error log written to:", error_path) finally: if not args.run_once: input("Tryck Enter för att stänga...") if __name__ == "__main__": main() ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.
