item.title: B. 333 & 666 Float Boundary Probe. FINAL REPORT
item.description: Float-boundary probe for the recurring 1/3 <-> 2/3 rest pulse produced from q_n = (3/4) / 2^n and 8 / q_n.To make the rest pulse machine-readable, auditable and reproducible through exact rational arithmetic and explicit float-residual checking. That each iteration gives a rest of 1/3 or 2/3. That the switching follows the expected pulse: 2/3 for even n and 1/3 for odd n. That the float representation of 1/3 and 2/3 gives a storable residual against an exact Fraction/Decimal reference. That the machine limit between 2^-49 and 2^-52 gives the quotient 8. The test shows whether the observed 0.333... <-> 0.666... ​​pulse is preserved when exactly rational structure is compared to the machine layer of the float representation.The code has been shorted and verified. item.title: 4.B. VP Render x100 IMAGES ABC Categorized.PYTHON
item.description: import numpy as np import plotly.graph_objects as go import plotly.io as pio import os import webbrowser import json import csv import math pio.renderers.default = "browser" # ============================================================ # SETTINGS # ============================================================ MODE = "all" NUM_POINTS = 600 # ANKARE RADIUS_ANCHOR = 6.0 # MICRO RADIUS_MICRO_RED = 3.0 RADIUS_MICRO_GREEN = 1.5 # MACRO RADIUS_MACRO_RED = 12.0 RADIUS_MACRO_GREEN = 24.0 COLOR_BACKGROUND = "black" COLOR_BLUE = "royalblue" COLOR_RED = "crimson" COLOR_GREEN = "#00ff66" COLOR_INNER = "#00aaff" COLOR_LEVEL2 = "#fffff0" COLOR_LEVEL3 = "#ff8800" COLOR_OUTER = "#ff0033" COLOR_COMBINED_XLINES = "white" MICRO_OPACITY = { "vesica": 1.0, "green": 0.9, "node": 1.0, "xline": 0.15, } MACRO_OPACITY = { "vesica": 0.8, "green": 0.7, "node": 1.0, "xline": 0.10, } ROTATIONS_GREEN = [ (45.0, 45.0, 0.0), (45.0, -45.0, 0.0), (-45.0, 45.0, 0.0), (-45.0, -45.0, 0.0), ] # ============================================================ # ZOOM-NIVAAER # Nivå 1 → 0.1 # Nivå 2 → 0.3 # Nivå 3 → 0.6 # Nivå 4 → 1.2 # Nivå 5 → 2.2 # ============================================================ ZOOM_LEVELS = { "N1": 0.1, "N2": 0.3, "N3": 0.6, "N4": 1.2, "N5": 2.2, } # ============================================================ # VIEW GROUPS # A = Symmetri 90° # B = Symmetri 45° # C = Asymmetri 3D # ============================================================ VIEW_GROUPS = { "A": { "folder": "A_Symmetri_90", "title": "A (Symmetri 90°)", "definition": "Rakt mot kubens 6 sidor", "axis_mode": "1 axel aktiv (ren projektion)", "views": { "A1": (1.0, 0.0, 0.0), "A2": (-1.0, 0.0, 0.0), "A3": (0.0, 1.0, 0.0), "A4": (0.0, -1.0, 0.0), "A5": (0.0, 0.0, 1.0), "A6": (0.0, 0.0, -1.0), }, }, "B": { "folder": "B_Symmetri_45", "title": "B (Symmetri 45°)", "definition": "Symmetriska diagonalplan", "axis_mode": "2 axlar aktiva (planrelation)", "views": { "B1": (1.0, 1.0, 0.0), "B2": (1.0, -1.0, 0.0), "B3": (-1.0, 1.0, 0.0), "B4": (-1.0, -1.0, 0.0), "B5": (1.0, 0.0, 1.0), "B6": (-1.0, 0.0, -1.0), }, }, "C": { "folder": "C_Asymmetri_3D", "title": "C (Asymmetri 3D)", "definition": "Kameran placerad i varje hörn av kuben", "axis_mode": "3 axlar aktiva (full struktur)", "views": { "C1": (1.0, 1.0, 1.0), "C2": (1.0, 1.0, -1.0), "C3": (1.0, -1.0, 1.0), "C4": (1.0, -1.0, -1.0), "C5": (-1.0, 1.0, 1.0), "C6": (-1.0, 1.0, -1.0), "C7": (-1.0, -1.0, 1.0), "C8": (-1.0, -1.0, -1.0), }, }, } # ============================================================ # GEOMETRY # ============================================================ def create_vesica_circles(radius, n=200): t = np.linspace(0.0, 2.0 * np.pi, n) x1 = radius * np.cos(t) - radius / 2.0 y1 = radius * np.sin(t) x2 = radius * np.cos(t) + radius / 2.0 y2 = radius * np.sin(t) return (x1, y1), (x2, y2) def rotate_3d_points(x, y, z, ax, ay, az): rad_x = np.deg2rad(ax) rad_y = np.deg2rad(ay) rad_z = np.deg2rad(az) if ax != 0.0: y_new = y * np.cos(rad_x) - z * np.sin(rad_x) z_new = y * np.sin(rad_x) + z * np.cos(rad_x) y, z = y_new, z_new if ay != 0.0: x_new = x * np.cos(rad_y) + z * np.sin(rad_y) z_new = -x * np.sin(rad_y) + z * np.cos(rad_y) x, z = x_new, z_new if az != 0.0: x_new = x * np.cos(rad_z) - y * np.sin(rad_z) y_new = x * np.sin(rad_z) + y * np.cos(rad_z) x, y = x_new, y_new return x, y, z def rotation_matrix(ax_deg, ay_deg, az_deg): ax = np.deg2rad(ax_deg) ay = np.deg2rad(ay_deg) az = np.deg2rad(az_deg) rx = np.array([ [1.0, 0.0, 0.0], [0.0, np.cos(ax), -np.sin(ax)], [0.0, np.sin(ax), np.cos(ax)], ]) ry = np.array([ [np.cos(ay), 0.0, np.sin(ay)], [0.0, 1.0, 0.0], [-np.sin(ay), 0.0, np.cos(ay)], ]) rz = np.array([ [np.cos(az), -np.sin(az), 0.0], [np.sin(az), np.cos(az), 0.0], [0.0, 0.0, 1.0], ]) return rz @ ry @ rx def build_circles(radius, rotations): circles = [] base_centers = [ np.array([-radius / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0]), np.array([radius / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0]), ] base_ex = np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0]) base_ey = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0]) base_n = np.array([0.0, 0.0, 1.0]) for rot in rotations: rmat = rotation_matrix(rot[0], rot[1], rot[2]) circles.append({ "center": rmat @ base_centers[0], "ex": rmat @ base_ex, "ey": rmat @ base_ey, "normal": rmat @ base_n, "radius": radius, }) circles.append({ "center": rmat @ base_centers[1], "ex": rmat @ base_ex, "ey": rmat @ base_ey, "normal": rmat @ base_n, "radius": radius, }) return circles def sample_circle(circle): t = np.linspace(0.0, 2.0 * np.pi, NUM_POINTS) pts = ( circle["center"].reshape(3, 1) + circle["radius"] * np.cos(t) * circle["ex"].reshape(3, 1) + circle["radius"] * np.sin(t) * circle["ey"].reshape(3, 1) ) return pts[0], pts[1], pts[2] def circle_intersection(circle_a, circle_b): c1 = circle_a["center"] c2 = circle_b["center"] n1 = circle_a["normal"] n2 = circle_b["normal"] radius = circle_a["radius"] direction = np.cross(n1, n2) norm_dir = np.linalg.norm(direction) if norm_dir < 1e-8: return [] direction = direction / norm_dir amat = np.vstack([n1, n2, direction]) bvec = np.array([ np.dot(n1, c1), np.dot(n2, c2), 0.0, ]) p0 = np.linalg.lstsq(amat, bvec, rcond=None)[0] mvec = p0 - c1 acoef = np.dot(direction, direction) bcoef = 2.0 * np.dot(mvec, direction) ccoef = np.dot(mvec, mvec) - radius ** 2 disc = bcoef ** 2 - 4.0 * acoef * ccoef if disc < 0.0: return [] sqrt_disc = np.sqrt(disc) p1 = p0 + ((-bcoef + sqrt_disc) / (2.0 * acoef)) * direction p2 = p0 + ((-bcoef - sqrt_disc) / (2.0 * acoef)) * direction return [p1, p2] def compute_intersections(circles): pts = [] for i in range(len(circles)): for j in range(i + 1, len(circles)): inter = circle_intersection(circles[i], circles[j]) for point in inter: pts.append(point) unique = [] for p in pts: exists = False for q in unique: if np.linalg.norm(p - q) < 1e-6: exists = True break if not exists: unique.append(p) return unique def classify(points): if not points: return [], [], [], [] radii = [np.linalg.norm(p) for p in points] shells = sorted(set(np.round(radii, 6))) res = [[], [], [], []] for point, radius in zip(points, radii): rr = np.round(radius, 6) for i in range(min(len(shells), 4)): if abs(rr - shells[i]) < 1e-6: res[i].append(point) break return res[0], res[1], res[2], res[3] # ============================================================ # DRAW HELPERS # ============================================================ def add_glow_line(traces, x, y, z, color, base_width, opacity): traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=x, y=y, z=z, mode="lines", line=dict(color=color, width=base_width * 3), opacity=max(0.0, min(1.0, opacity * 0.15)), showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none", ) ) traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=x, y=y, z=z, mode="lines", line=dict(color=color, width=base_width * 2), opacity=max(0.0, min(1.0, opacity * 0.30)), showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none", ) ) traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=x, y=y, z=z, mode="lines", line=dict(color=color, width=base_width), opacity=max(0.0, min(1.0, opacity)), showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none", ) ) def draw_nodes(traces, nodes, color, size, opacity=1.0): if not nodes: return traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=[p[0] for p in nodes], y=[p[1] for p in nodes], z=[p[2] for p in nodes], mode="markers", marker=dict( size=size, color=color, opacity=opacity, ), showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none", ) ) def connect_edges(traces, nodes, color, width=3, opacity=0.9, glow=False): pts = np.array(nodes) if len(pts) < 2: return dists = [] for i in range(len(pts)): for j in range(i + 1, len(pts)): dist = np.linalg.norm(pts[i] - pts[j]) if dist > 1e-6: dists.append(dist) if not dists: return threshold = min(dists) * 1.08 for i in range(len(pts)): for j in range(i + 1, len(pts)): if np.linalg.norm(pts[i] - pts[j]) <= threshold: x = [pts[i][0], pts[j][0]] y = [pts[i][1], pts[j][1]] z = [pts[i][2], pts[j][2]] if glow: add_glow_line(traces, x, y, z, color, width, opacity) else: traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=x, y=y, z=z, mode="lines", line=dict(color=color, width=width), opacity=opacity, showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none", ) ) def connect_all_pairs(traces, nodes, color, width=2, opacity=0.8, glow=False): pts = np.array(nodes) if len(pts) < 2: return for i in range(len(pts)): for j in range(i + 1, len(pts)): x = [pts[i][0], pts[j][0]] y = [pts[i][1], pts[j][1]] z = [pts[i][2], pts[j][2]] if glow: add_glow_line(traces, x, y, z, color, width, opacity) else: traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=x, y=y, z=z, mode="lines", line=dict(color=color, width=width), opacity=opacity, showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none", ) ) def add_global_xlines(traces, node_sets, color="white", opacity=0.15, width=1, glow=False): all_nodes = [p for s in node_sets for p in s] for i in range(len(all_nodes)): for j in range(i + 1, len(all_nodes)): x = [all_nodes[i][0], all_nodes[j][0]] y = [all_nodes[i][1], all_nodes[j][1]] z = [all_nodes[i][2], all_nodes[j][2]] if glow: add_glow_line(traces, x, y, z, color, width, opacity) else: traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=x, y=y, z=z, mode="lines", line=dict(color=color, width=width), opacity=opacity, showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none", ) ) def add_vesica_to_traces(traces, radius, color, opacity, rotation=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), width=4, glow=False): (c1_x, c1_y), (c2_x, c2_y) = create_vesica_circles(radius, n=NUM_POINTS) for cx, cy in [(c1_x, c1_y), (c2_x, c2_y)]: z = np.zeros_like(cx) rx, ry, rz = rotate_3d_points(cx, cy, z, rotation[0], rotation[1], rotation[2]) if glow: add_glow_line(traces, rx, ry, rz, color, width, opacity) else: traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=rx, y=ry, z=rz, mode="lines", line=dict(color=color, width=width), opacity=opacity, showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none", ) ) # ============================================================ # SYSTEM BUILDER # ============================================================ def add_shell_system(traces, red_radius, green_radius, config, line_scale=1.0, is_macro=False): macro_glow = is_macro for rot in [(90.0, 0.0, 0.0), (0.0, 90.0, 0.0)]: add_vesica_to_traces( traces=traces, radius=red_radius, color=COLOR_RED, opacity=config["vesica"] * 0.8, rotation=rot, width=max(1, int(4 * line_scale)), glow=macro_glow, ) green_circles = build_circles(green_radius, ROTATIONS_GREEN) points = compute_intersections(green_circles) inner, l2, l3, outer = classify(points) for circle in green_circles: x, y, z = sample_circle(circle) if macro_glow: add_glow_line( traces, x, y, z, COLOR_GREEN, max(1, int(4 * line_scale)), config["green"], ) else: traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=x, y=y, z=z, mode="lines", line=dict(color=COLOR_GREEN, width=max(1, int(4 * line_scale))), opacity=config["green"], showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none", ) ) sets = [ (inner, COLOR_INNER), (l2, COLOR_LEVEL2), (l3, COLOR_LEVEL3), (outer, COLOR_OUTER), ] for node_set, color in sets: connect_edges( traces=traces, nodes=node_set, color=color, width=max(1, int(3 * line_scale)), opacity=config["green"], glow=macro_glow, ) connect_all_pairs( traces=traces, nodes=node_set, color=color, width=max(1, int(2 * line_scale)), opacity=config["green"], glow=macro_glow, ) draw_nodes(traces, inner, COLOR_INNER, 6, config["node"]) draw_nodes(traces, l2, COLOR_LEVEL2, 6, config["node"]) draw_nodes(traces, l3, COLOR_LEVEL3, 6, config["node"]) draw_nodes(traces, outer, COLOR_OUTER, 7, config["node"]) # ============================================================ # FIGURE # ============================================================ def build_figure(): traces = [] add_vesica_to_traces( traces=traces, radius=RADIUS_ANCHOR, color=COLOR_BLUE, opacity=1.0, rotation=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), width=5, glow=False, ) add_shell_system( traces=traces, red_radius=RADIUS_MICRO_RED, green_radius=RADIUS_MICRO_GREEN, config=MICRO_OPACITY, line_scale=1.0, is_macro=False, ) add_shell_system( traces=traces, red_radius=RADIUS_MACRO_RED, green_radius=RADIUS_MACRO_GREEN, config=MACRO_OPACITY, line_scale=0.5, is_macro=True, ) fig = go.Figure(data=traces) fig.update_layout( template="plotly_dark", scene=dict( xaxis=dict(visible=False), yaxis=dict(visible=False), zaxis=dict(visible=False), aspectmode="data", bgcolor=COLOR_BACKGROUND, ), paper_bgcolor=COLOR_BACKGROUND, margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=0, b=0), ) return fig # ============================================================ # CAMERA HELPERS # ============================================================ def normalize_direction(direction): vec = np.array(direction, dtype=float) norm = np.linalg.norm(vec) if norm <= 1e-12: return np.array([1.0, 1.0, 1.0], dtype=float) return vec / norm def round_float(value, decimals=12): return round(float(value), decimals) def make_camera(direction, zoom_value): unit = normalize_direction(direction) eye = { "x": float(unit[0] * zoom_value), "y": float(unit[1] * zoom_value), "z": float(unit[2] * zoom_value), } return dict(eye=eye) def build_view_row(group_key, group_info, view_key, direction, level_key, zoom_value): unit = normalize_direction(direction) eye_x = float(unit[0] * zoom_value) eye_y = float(unit[1] * zoom_value) eye_z = float(unit[2] * zoom_value) row = { "group": group_key, "group_title": group_info["title"], "group_folder": group_info["folder"], "group_definition": group_info["definition"], "group_axis_mode": group_info["axis_mode"], "view_name": view_key, "level_name": level_key, "zoom_value": round_float(zoom_value, 12), "direction_x": round_float(direction[0], 12), "direction_y": round_float(direction[1], 12), "direction_z": round_float(direction[2], 12), "normalized_x": round_float(unit[0], 12), "normalized_y": round_float(unit[1], 12), "normalized_z": round_float(unit[2], 12), "eye_x": round_float(eye_x, 12), "eye_y": round_float(eye_y, 12), "eye_z": round_float(eye_z, 12), "filename": view_key + "__" + level_key + ".png", } return row # ============================================================ # OUTPUT DIRS # ============================================================ def ensure_output_dirs(): root_dir = "System_Renders_ABC_100" dir_a = os.path.join(root_dir, VIEW_GROUPS["A"]["folder"]) dir_b = os.path.join(root_dir, VIEW_GROUPS["B"]["folder"]) dir_c = os.path.join(root_dir, VIEW_GROUPS["C"]["folder"]) meta_dir = os.path.join(root_dir, "00_Metadata") os.makedirs(root_dir, exist_ok=True) os.makedirs(dir_a, exist_ok=True) os.makedirs(dir_b, exist_ok=True) os.makedirs(dir_c, exist_ok=True) os.makedirs(meta_dir, exist_ok=True) return { "root": root_dir, "A": dir_a, "B": dir_b, "C": dir_c, "meta": meta_dir, } # ============================================================ # TABLE + JSON EXPORT # ============================================================ def export_all_views_csv(rows, output_paths): csv_path = os.path.join(output_paths["meta"], "ALL_100_VIEWS_TABLE.csv") fieldnames = [ "group", "group_title", "group_folder", "group_definition", "group_axis_mode", "view_name", "level_name", "zoom_value", "direction_x", "direction_y", "direction_z", "normalized_x", "normalized_y", "normalized_z", "eye_x", "eye_y", "eye_z", "filename", ] with open(csv_path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle: writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=fieldnames) writer.writeheader() for row in rows: writer.writerow(row) return csv_path def export_all_views_json(rows, output_paths): json_path = os.path.join(output_paths["meta"], "ALL_100_VIEWS_TABLE.json") with open(json_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle: json.dump(rows, handle, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) return json_path def export_group_json(group_key, group_info, rows, output_paths): group_rows = [row for row in rows if row["group"] == group_key] payload = { "group": group_key, "title": group_info["title"], "folder": group_info["folder"], "definition": group_info["definition"], "axis_mode": group_info["axis_mode"], "total_base_views": len(group_info["views"]), "total_zoom_levels": len(ZOOM_LEVELS), "total_rendered_images": len(group_rows), "zoom_levels": ZOOM_LEVELS, "base_directions": [ { "view_name": view_name, "direction_x": direction[0], "direction_y": direction[1], "direction_z": direction[2], } for view_name, direction in group_info["views"].items() ], "rendered_views": group_rows, } json_name = group_key + "_INFO.json" json_path = os.path.join(output_paths["meta"], json_name) with open(json_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle: json.dump(payload, handle, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) return json_path def export_summary_json(rows, output_paths): payload = { "root_folder": output_paths["root"], "totals": { "groups": 3, "base_views": sum(len(g["views"]) for g in VIEW_GROUPS.values()), "zoom_levels": len(ZOOM_LEVELS), "rendered_images": len(rows), }, "formula": "Kamera = normaliserad riktning (X,Y,Z) × zoom", "groups": { key: { "title": VIEW_GROUPS[key]["title"], "folder": VIEW_GROUPS[key]["folder"], "definition": VIEW_GROUPS[key]["definition"], "axis_mode": VIEW_GROUPS[key]["axis_mode"], "base_views": len(VIEW_GROUPS[key]["views"]), "rendered_images": len([row for row in rows if row["group"] == key]), } for key in VIEW_GROUPS }, } json_path = os.path.join(output_paths["meta"], "SUMMARY.json") with open(json_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle: json.dump(payload, handle, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) return json_path # ============================================================ # RENDERING # ============================================================ def render_all_views_abc(fig): output_paths = ensure_output_dirs() all_rows = [] total_count = 0 for group_key, group_info in VIEW_GROUPS.items(): target_dir = output_paths[group_key] for view_name, direction in group_info["views"].items(): for level_name, zoom_value in ZOOM_LEVELS.items(): row = build_view_row( group_key=group_key, group_info=group_info, view_key=view_name, direction=direction, level_key=level_name, zoom_value=zoom_value, ) camera = make_camera(direction, zoom_value) fig.update_layout(scene_camera=camera) filename = row["filename"] path = os.path.join(target_dir, filename) fig.write_image(path, width=1600, height=1600) print("Klar:", path) all_rows.append(row) total_count += 1 csv_path = export_all_views_csv(all_rows, output_paths) all_json_path = export_all_views_json(all_rows, output_paths) group_json_paths = [] for group_key, group_info in VIEW_GROUPS.items(): group_json_paths.append(export_group_json(group_key, group_info, all_rows, output_paths)) summary_json_path = export_summary_json(all_rows, output_paths) return { "total_images": total_count, "rows": all_rows, "output_paths": output_paths, "csv_path": csv_path, "all_json_path": all_json_path, "group_json_paths": group_json_paths, "summary_json_path": summary_json_path, } # ============================================================ # MAIN # ============================================================ def main(): fig = build_figure() html_path = os.path.abspath("Vesica_Scale_Independent_System_ABC_100.html") fig.write_html(html_path) webbrowser.open("file://" + html_path) try: result = render_all_views_abc(fig) except Exception as exc: print("") print("FEL VID BILDRENDERING") print(str(exc)) print("") print("Om detta fel handlar om write_image eller kaleido, installera detta:") print("pip install kaleido") print("") print("HTML-filen skapades fortfarande:") print(html_path) print("") fig.show() return print("") print("KLART") print("Totalt antal bilder:", result["total_images"]) print("Forvantat antal bilder: 100") print("HTML:", html_path) print("Root:", result["output_paths"]["root"]) print("A:", result["output_paths"]["A"]) print("B:", result["output_paths"]["B"]) print("C:", result["output_paths"]["C"]) print("Metadata:", result["output_paths"]["meta"]) print("CSV:", result["csv_path"]) print("ALL JSON:", result["all_json_path"]) print("SUMMARY JSON:", result["summary_json_path"]) print("") for group_json_path in result["group_json_paths"]: print("GROUP JSON:", group_json_path) print("") fig.show() if __name__ == "__main__": main() ⚖️ — License & CopyrightLicensed under RP9-LA-2026Copyright © 2026 Anton WallinSee LICENSE for full terms.

item.title: 4.A. VP (NO-Render) x100 IMAGES ABC Categorized.PYTHON
item.description: import numpy as np import plotly.graph_objects as go import plotly.io as pio import os import webbrowser import json import csv import math pio.renderers.default = "browser" # ============================================================ # SETTINGS # ============================================================ # ============================================================ # CONTROL SWITCHES # ============================================================ RUN_RENDER = False RUN_ANALYSIS = True EXPORT_HTML = True OPEN_HTML = True SHOW_FIGURE = True MODE = "all" NUM_POINTS = 600 # ANKARE RADIUS_ANCHOR = 6.0 # MICRO RADIUS_MICRO_RED = 3.0 RADIUS_MICRO_GREEN = 1.5 # MACRO RADIUS_MACRO_RED = 12.0 RADIUS_MACRO_GREEN = 24.0 COLOR_BACKGROUND = "black" COLOR_BLUE = "royalblue" COLOR_RED = "crimson" COLOR_GREEN = "#00ff66" COLOR_INNER = "#00aaff" COLOR_LEVEL2 = "#fffff0" COLOR_LEVEL3 = "#ff8800" COLOR_OUTER = "#ff0033" COLOR_COMBINED_XLINES = "white" MICRO_OPACITY = { "vesica": 1.0, "green": 0.9, "node": 1.0, "xline": 0.15, } MACRO_OPACITY = { "vesica": 0.8, "green": 0.7, "node": 1.0, "xline": 0.10, } ROTATIONS_GREEN = [ (45.0, 45.0, 0.0), (45.0, -45.0, 0.0), (-45.0, 45.0, 0.0), (-45.0, -45.0, 0.0), ] # ============================================================ # ZOOM-NIVAAER # Nivå 1 → 0.1 # Nivå 2 → 0.3 # Nivå 3 → 0.6 # Nivå 4 → 1.2 # Nivå 5 → 2.2 # ============================================================ ZOOM_LEVELS = { "N1": 0.1, "N2": 0.3, "N3": 0.6, "N4": 1.2, "N5": 2.2, } # ============================================================ # VIEW GROUPS # A = Symmetri 90° # B = Symmetri 45° # C = Asymmetri 3D # ============================================================ VIEW_GROUPS = { "A": { "folder": "A_Symmetri_90", "title": "A (Symmetri 90°)", "definition": "Rakt mot kubens 6 sidor", "axis_mode": "1 axel aktiv (ren projektion)", "views": { "A1": (1.0, 0.0, 0.0), "A2": (-1.0, 0.0, 0.0), "A3": (0.0, 1.0, 0.0), "A4": (0.0, -1.0, 0.0), "A5": (0.0, 0.0, 1.0), "A6": (0.0, 0.0, -1.0), }, }, "B": { "folder": "B_Symmetri_45", "title": "B (Symmetri 45°)", "definition": "Symmetriska diagonalplan", "axis_mode": "2 axlar aktiva (planrelation)", "views": { "B1": (1.0, 1.0, 0.0), "B2": (1.0, -1.0, 0.0), "B3": (-1.0, 1.0, 0.0), "B4": (-1.0, -1.0, 0.0), "B5": (1.0, 0.0, 1.0), "B6": (-1.0, 0.0, -1.0), }, }, "C": { "folder": "C_Asymmetri_3D", "title": "C (Asymmetri 3D)", "definition": "Kameran placerad i varje hörn av kuben", "axis_mode": "3 axlar aktiva (full struktur)", "views": { "C1": (1.0, 1.0, 1.0), "C2": (1.0, 1.0, -1.0), "C3": (1.0, -1.0, 1.0), "C4": (1.0, -1.0, -1.0), "C5": (-1.0, 1.0, 1.0), "C6": (-1.0, 1.0, -1.0), "C7": (-1.0, -1.0, 1.0), "C8": (-1.0, -1.0, -1.0), }, }, } # ============================================================ # GEOMETRY # ============================================================ def create_vesica_circles(radius, n=200): t = np.linspace(0.0, 2.0 * np.pi, n) x1 = radius * np.cos(t) - radius / 2.0 y1 = radius * np.sin(t) x2 = radius * np.cos(t) + radius / 2.0 y2 = radius * np.sin(t) return (x1, y1), (x2, y2) def rotate_3d_points(x, y, z, ax, ay, az): rad_x = np.deg2rad(ax) rad_y = np.deg2rad(ay) rad_z = np.deg2rad(az) if ax != 0.0: y_new = y * np.cos(rad_x) - z * np.sin(rad_x) z_new = y * np.sin(rad_x) + z * np.cos(rad_x) y, z = y_new, z_new if ay != 0.0: x_new = x * np.cos(rad_y) + z * np.sin(rad_y) z_new = -x * np.sin(rad_y) + z * np.cos(rad_y) x, z = x_new, z_new if az != 0.0: x_new = x * np.cos(rad_z) - y * np.sin(rad_z) y_new = x * np.sin(rad_z) + y * np.cos(rad_z) x, y = x_new, y_new return x, y, z def rotation_matrix(ax_deg, ay_deg, az_deg): ax = np.deg2rad(ax_deg) ay = np.deg2rad(ay_deg) az = np.deg2rad(az_deg) rx = np.array([ [1.0, 0.0, 0.0], [0.0, np.cos(ax), -np.sin(ax)], [0.0, np.sin(ax), np.cos(ax)], ]) ry = np.array([ [np.cos(ay), 0.0, np.sin(ay)], [0.0, 1.0, 0.0], [-np.sin(ay), 0.0, np.cos(ay)], ]) rz = np.array([ [np.cos(az), -np.sin(az), 0.0], [np.sin(az), np.cos(az), 0.0], [0.0, 0.0, 1.0], ]) return rz @ ry @ rx def build_circles(radius, rotations): circles = [] base_centers = [ np.array([-radius / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0]), np.array([radius / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0]), ] base_ex = np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0]) base_ey = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0]) base_n = np.array([0.0, 0.0, 1.0]) for rot in rotations: rmat = rotation_matrix(rot[0], rot[1], rot[2]) circles.append({ "center": rmat @ base_centers[0], "ex": rmat @ base_ex, "ey": rmat @ base_ey, "normal": rmat @ base_n, "radius": radius, }) circles.append({ "center": rmat @ base_centers[1], "ex": rmat @ base_ex, "ey": rmat @ base_ey, "normal": rmat @ base_n, "radius": radius, }) return circles def sample_circle(circle): t = np.linspace(0.0, 2.0 * np.pi, NUM_POINTS) pts = ( circle["center"].reshape(3, 1) + circle["radius"] * np.cos(t) * circle["ex"].reshape(3, 1) + circle["radius"] * np.sin(t) * circle["ey"].reshape(3, 1) ) return pts[0], pts[1], pts[2] def circle_intersection(circle_a, circle_b): c1 = circle_a["center"] c2 = circle_b["center"] n1 = circle_a["normal"] n2 = circle_b["normal"] radius = circle_a["radius"] direction = np.cross(n1, n2) norm_dir = np.linalg.norm(direction) if norm_dir < 1e-8: return [] direction = direction / norm_dir amat = np.vstack([n1, n2, direction]) bvec = np.array([ np.dot(n1, c1), np.dot(n2, c2), 0.0, ]) p0 = np.linalg.lstsq(amat, bvec, rcond=None)[0] mvec = p0 - c1 acoef = np.dot(direction, direction) bcoef = 2.0 * np.dot(mvec, direction) ccoef = np.dot(mvec, mvec) - radius ** 2 disc = bcoef ** 2 - 4.0 * acoef * ccoef if disc < 0.0: return [] sqrt_disc = np.sqrt(disc) p1 = p0 + ((-bcoef + sqrt_disc) / (2.0 * acoef)) * direction p2 = p0 + ((-bcoef - sqrt_disc) / (2.0 * acoef)) * direction return [p1, p2] def compute_intersections(circles): pts = [] for i in range(len(circles)): for j in range(i + 1, len(circles)): inter = circle_intersection(circles[i], circles[j]) for point in inter: pts.append(point) unique = [] for p in pts: exists = False for q in unique: if np.linalg.norm(p - q) < 1e-6: exists = True break if not exists: unique.append(p) return unique def classify(points): if not points: return [], [], [], [] radii = [np.linalg.norm(p) for p in points] shells = sorted(set(np.round(radii, 6))) res = [[], [], [], []] for point, radius in zip(points, radii): rr = np.round(radius, 6) for i in range(min(len(shells), 4)): if abs(rr - shells[i]) < 1e-6: res[i].append(point) break return res[0], res[1], res[2], res[3] # ============================================================ # DRAW HELPERS # ============================================================ def add_glow_line(traces, x, y, z, color, base_width, opacity): traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=x, y=y, z=z, mode="lines", line=dict(color=color, width=base_width * 3), opacity=max(0.0, min(1.0, opacity * 0.15)), showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none", ) ) traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=x, y=y, z=z, mode="lines", line=dict(color=color, width=base_width * 2), opacity=max(0.0, min(1.0, opacity * 0.30)), showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none", ) ) traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=x, y=y, z=z, mode="lines", line=dict(color=color, width=base_width), opacity=max(0.0, min(1.0, opacity)), showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none", ) ) def draw_nodes(traces, nodes, color, size, opacity=1.0): if not nodes: return traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=[p[0] for p in nodes], y=[p[1] for p in nodes], z=[p[2] for p in nodes], mode="markers", marker=dict( size=size, color=color, opacity=opacity, ), showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none", ) ) def connect_edges(traces, nodes, color, width=3, opacity=0.9, glow=False): pts = np.array(nodes) if len(pts) < 2: return dists = [] for i in range(len(pts)): for j in range(i + 1, len(pts)): dist = np.linalg.norm(pts[i] - pts[j]) if dist > 1e-6: dists.append(dist) if not dists: return threshold = min(dists) * 1.08 for i in range(len(pts)): for j in range(i + 1, len(pts)): if np.linalg.norm(pts[i] - pts[j]) <= threshold: x = [pts[i][0], pts[j][0]] y = [pts[i][1], pts[j][1]] z = [pts[i][2], pts[j][2]] if glow: add_glow_line(traces, x, y, z, color, width, opacity) else: traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=x, y=y, z=z, mode="lines", line=dict(color=color, width=width), opacity=opacity, showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none", ) ) def connect_all_pairs(traces, nodes, color, width=2, opacity=0.8, glow=False): pts = np.array(nodes) if len(pts) < 2: return for i in range(len(pts)): for j in range(i + 1, len(pts)): x = [pts[i][0], pts[j][0]] y = [pts[i][1], pts[j][1]] z = [pts[i][2], pts[j][2]] if glow: add_glow_line(traces, x, y, z, color, width, opacity) else: traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=x, y=y, z=z, mode="lines", line=dict(color=color, width=width), opacity=opacity, showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none", ) ) def add_global_xlines(traces, node_sets, color="white", opacity=0.15, width=1, glow=False): all_nodes = [p for s in node_sets for p in s] for i in range(len(all_nodes)): for j in range(i + 1, len(all_nodes)): x = [all_nodes[i][0], all_nodes[j][0]] y = [all_nodes[i][1], all_nodes[j][1]] z = [all_nodes[i][2], all_nodes[j][2]] if glow: add_glow_line(traces, x, y, z, color, width, opacity) else: traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=x, y=y, z=z, mode="lines", line=dict(color=color, width=width), opacity=opacity, showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none", ) ) def add_vesica_to_traces(traces, radius, color, opacity, rotation=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), width=4, glow=False): (c1_x, c1_y), (c2_x, c2_y) = create_vesica_circles(radius, n=NUM_POINTS) for cx, cy in [(c1_x, c1_y), (c2_x, c2_y)]: z = np.zeros_like(cx) rx, ry, rz = rotate_3d_points(cx, cy, z, rotation[0], rotation[1], rotation[2]) if glow: add_glow_line(traces, rx, ry, rz, color, width, opacity) else: traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=rx, y=ry, z=rz, mode="lines", line=dict(color=color, width=width), opacity=opacity, showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none", ) ) # ============================================================ # SYSTEM BUILDER # ============================================================ def add_shell_system(traces, red_radius, green_radius, config, line_scale=1.0, is_macro=False): macro_glow = is_macro for rot in [(90.0, 0.0, 0.0), (0.0, 90.0, 0.0)]: add_vesica_to_traces( traces=traces, radius=red_radius, color=COLOR_RED, opacity=config["vesica"] * 0.8, rotation=rot, width=max(1, int(4 * line_scale)), glow=macro_glow, ) green_circles = build_circles(green_radius, ROTATIONS_GREEN) points = compute_intersections(green_circles) inner, l2, l3, outer = classify(points) for circle in green_circles: x, y, z = sample_circle(circle) if macro_glow: add_glow_line( traces, x, y, z, COLOR_GREEN, max(1, int(4 * line_scale)), config["green"], ) else: traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=x, y=y, z=z, mode="lines", line=dict(color=COLOR_GREEN, width=max(1, int(4 * line_scale))), opacity=config["green"], showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none", ) ) sets = [ (inner, COLOR_INNER), (l2, COLOR_LEVEL2), (l3, COLOR_LEVEL3), (outer, COLOR_OUTER), ] for node_set, color in sets: connect_edges( traces=traces, nodes=node_set, color=color, width=max(1, int(3 * line_scale)), opacity=config["green"], glow=macro_glow, ) connect_all_pairs( traces=traces, nodes=node_set, color=color, width=max(1, int(2 * line_scale)), opacity=config["green"], glow=macro_glow, ) draw_nodes(traces, inner, COLOR_INNER, 6, config["node"]) draw_nodes(traces, l2, COLOR_LEVEL2, 6, config["node"]) draw_nodes(traces, l3, COLOR_LEVEL3, 6, config["node"]) draw_nodes(traces, outer, COLOR_OUTER, 7, config["node"]) # ============================================================ # FIGURE # ============================================================ def build_figure(): traces = [] add_vesica_to_traces( traces=traces, radius=RADIUS_ANCHOR, color=COLOR_BLUE, opacity=1.0, rotation=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), width=5, glow=False, ) add_shell_system( traces=traces, red_radius=RADIUS_MICRO_RED, green_radius=RADIUS_MICRO_GREEN, config=MICRO_OPACITY, line_scale=1.0, is_macro=False, ) add_shell_system( traces=traces, red_radius=RADIUS_MACRO_RED, green_radius=RADIUS_MACRO_GREEN, config=MACRO_OPACITY, line_scale=0.5, is_macro=True, ) fig = go.Figure(data=traces) fig.update_layout( template="plotly_dark", scene=dict( xaxis=dict(visible=False), yaxis=dict(visible=False), zaxis=dict(visible=False), aspectmode="data", bgcolor=COLOR_BACKGROUND, ), paper_bgcolor=COLOR_BACKGROUND, margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=0, b=0), ) return fig # ============================================================ # CAMERA HELPERS # ============================================================ def normalize_direction(direction): vec = np.array(direction, dtype=float) norm = np.linalg.norm(vec) if norm <= 1e-12: return np.array([1.0, 1.0, 1.0], dtype=float) return vec / norm def round_float(value, decimals=12): return round(float(value), decimals) def make_camera(direction, zoom_value): unit = normalize_direction(direction) eye = { "x": float(unit[0] * zoom_value), "y": float(unit[1] * zoom_value), "z": float(unit[2] * zoom_value), } return dict(eye=eye) def build_view_row(group_key, group_info, view_key, direction, level_key, zoom_value): unit = normalize_direction(direction) eye_x = float(unit[0] * zoom_value) eye_y = float(unit[1] * zoom_value) eye_z = float(unit[2] * zoom_value) row = { "group": group_key, "group_title": group_info["title"], "group_folder": group_info["folder"], "group_definition": group_info["definition"], "group_axis_mode": group_info["axis_mode"], "view_name": view_key, "level_name": level_key, "zoom_value": round_float(zoom_value, 12), "direction_x": round_float(direction[0], 12), "direction_y": round_float(direction[1], 12), "direction_z": round_float(direction[2], 12), "normalized_x": round_float(unit[0], 12), "normalized_y": round_float(unit[1], 12), "normalized_z": round_float(unit[2], 12), "eye_x": round_float(eye_x, 12), "eye_y": round_float(eye_y, 12), "eye_z": round_float(eye_z, 12), "filename": view_key + "__" + level_key + ".png", } return row # ============================================================ # OUTPUT DIRS # ============================================================ def ensure_output_dirs(): root_dir = "System_Renders_ABC_100" dir_a = os.path.join(root_dir, VIEW_GROUPS["A"]["folder"]) dir_b = os.path.join(root_dir, VIEW_GROUPS["B"]["folder"]) dir_c = os.path.join(root_dir, VIEW_GROUPS["C"]["folder"]) meta_dir = os.path.join(root_dir, "00_Metadata") os.makedirs(root_dir, exist_ok=True) os.makedirs(dir_a, exist_ok=True) os.makedirs(dir_b, exist_ok=True) os.makedirs(dir_c, exist_ok=True) os.makedirs(meta_dir, exist_ok=True) return { "root": root_dir, "A": dir_a, "B": dir_b, "C": dir_c, "meta": meta_dir, } # ============================================================ # TABLE + JSON EXPORT # ============================================================ def export_all_views_csv(rows, output_paths): csv_path = os.path.join(output_paths["meta"], "ALL_100_VIEWS_TABLE.csv") fieldnames = [ "group", "group_title", "group_folder", "group_definition", "group_axis_mode", "view_name", "level_name", "zoom_value", "direction_x", "direction_y", "direction_z", "normalized_x", "normalized_y", "normalized_z", "eye_x", "eye_y", "eye_z", "filename", ] with open(csv_path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle: writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=fieldnames) writer.writeheader() for row in rows: writer.writerow(row) return csv_path def export_all_views_json(rows, output_paths): json_path = os.path.join(output_paths["meta"], "ALL_100_VIEWS_TABLE.json") with open(json_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle: json.dump(rows, handle, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) return json_path def export_group_json(group_key, group_info, rows, output_paths): group_rows = [row for row in rows if row["group"] == group_key] payload = { "group": group_key, "title": group_info["title"], "folder": group_info["folder"], "definition": group_info["definition"], "axis_mode": group_info["axis_mode"], "total_base_views": len(group_info["views"]), "total_zoom_levels": len(ZOOM_LEVELS), "total_rendered_images": len(group_rows), "zoom_levels": ZOOM_LEVELS, "base_directions": [ { "view_name": view_name, "direction_x": direction[0], "direction_y": direction[1], "direction_z": direction[2], } for view_name, direction in group_info["views"].items() ], "rendered_views": group_rows, } json_name = group_key + "_INFO.json" json_path = os.path.join(output_paths["meta"], json_name) with open(json_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle: json.dump(payload, handle, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) return json_path def export_summary_json(rows, output_paths): payload = { "root_folder": output_paths["root"], "totals": { "groups": 3, "base_views": sum(len(g["views"]) for g in VIEW_GROUPS.values()), "zoom_levels": len(ZOOM_LEVELS), "rendered_images": len(rows), }, "formula": "Kamera = normaliserad riktning (X,Y,Z) × zoom", "groups": { key: { "title": VIEW_GROUPS[key]["title"], "folder": VIEW_GROUPS[key]["folder"], "definition": VIEW_GROUPS[key]["definition"], "axis_mode": VIEW_GROUPS[key]["axis_mode"], "base_views": len(VIEW_GROUPS[key]["views"]), "rendered_images": len([row for row in rows if row["group"] == key]), } for key in VIEW_GROUPS }, } json_path = os.path.join(output_paths["meta"], "SUMMARY.json") with open(json_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle: json.dump(payload, handle, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) return json_path # ============================================================ # ANALYTIC CORE - STRUCTURAL VALIDATION WITHOUT TOLERANCE # ============================================================ RUN_ANALYTIC_VALIDATION = True RUN_RENDER = False def analytic_vec_neg(direction): return (-direction[0], -direction[1], -direction[2]) def analytic_vec_eq(a, b): return a[0] == b[0] and a[1] == b[1] and a[2] == b[2] def analytic_get_b5_b6(): b_views = VIEW_GROUPS["B"]["views"] return b_views["B5"], b_views["B6"] def analytic_validate_b5_b6_structure(): b5, b6 = analytic_get_b5_b6() checks = {} checks["b5_is_xz_plus_diagonal"] = analytic_vec_eq(b5, (1.0, 0.0, 1.0)) checks["b6_is_xz_minus_diagonal"] = analytic_vec_eq(b6, (-1.0, 0.0, -1.0)) checks["b6_is_exact_inverse_of_b5"] = analytic_vec_eq(b6, analytic_vec_neg(b5)) checks["both_are_in_xz_plane"] = b5[1] == 0.0 and b6[1] == 0.0 checks["same_center_by_construction"] = True checks["no_numeric_tolerance_used"] = True passed = True for value in checks.values(): if value is not True: passed = False break return { "analysis_name": "ANALYTIC_B5_B6_STRUCTURAL_VALIDATION", "source": "symbolic_view_definitions_from_VIEW_GROUPS", "method": "exact_tuple_relation_check_no_tolerance_no_distance_test", "b5_direction": {"x": b5[0], "y": b5[1], "z": b5[2]}, "b6_direction": {"x": b6[0], "y": b6[1], "z": b6[2]}, "structural_lines": [ "L0: centrumlinje genom invariant centrum", "L_plus: positiv XZ-diagonal via B5", "L_minus: negativ XZ-diagonal via B6" ], "checks": checks, "passed": passed } def export_analytic_validation(output_paths): payload = analytic_validate_b5_b6_structure() json_path = os.path.join(output_paths["meta"], "ANALYTIC_B5_B6_STRUCTURAL_VALIDATION.json") with open(json_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle: json.dump(payload, handle, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) return json_path, payload # ============================================================ # RENDERING # ============================================================ def render_all_views_abc(fig): output_paths = ensure_output_dirs() all_rows = [] total_count = 0 for group_key, group_info in VIEW_GROUPS.items(): target_dir = output_paths[group_key] for view_name, direction in group_info["views"].items(): for level_name, zoom_value in ZOOM_LEVELS.items(): row = build_view_row( group_key=group_key, group_info=group_info, view_key=view_name, direction=direction, level_key=level_name, zoom_value=zoom_value, ) camera = make_camera(direction, zoom_value) fig.update_layout(scene_camera=camera) filename = row["filename"] path = os.path.join(target_dir, filename) fig.write_image(path, width=1600, height=1600) print("Klar:", path) all_rows.append(row) total_count += 1 csv_path = export_all_views_csv(all_rows, output_paths) all_json_path = export_all_views_json(all_rows, output_paths) group_json_paths = [] for group_key, group_info in VIEW_GROUPS.items(): group_json_paths.append(export_group_json(group_key, group_info, all_rows, output_paths)) summary_json_path = export_summary_json(all_rows, output_paths) return { "total_images": total_count, "rows": all_rows, "output_paths": output_paths, "csv_path": csv_path, "all_json_path": all_json_path, "group_json_paths": group_json_paths, "summary_json_path": summary_json_path, } # ============================================================ # MAIN # ============================================================ def main(): fig = build_figure() output_paths = ensure_output_dirs() html_path = os.path.abspath("Vesica_Scale_Independent_System_ABC_100.html") fig.write_html(html_path) webbrowser.open("file://" + html_path) analytic_path = None analytic_payload = None if RUN_ANALYTIC_VALIDATION: analytic_path, analytic_payload = export_analytic_validation(output_paths) print("ANALYTIC VALIDATION:", analytic_payload["passed"]) print("ANALYTIC JSON:", analytic_path) if RUN_RENDER: try: result = render_all_views_abc(fig) except Exception as exc: print("") print("FEL VID BILDRENDERING") print(str(exc)) print("") print("Om detta fel handlar om write_image eller kaleido, installera detta:") print("pip install kaleido") print("") print("HTML-filen skapades fortfarande:") print(html_path) print("") fig.show() return print("") print("KLART") print("Totalt antal bilder:", result["total_images"]) print("Forvantat antal bilder: 100") print("HTML:", html_path) print("Root:", result["output_paths"]["root"]) print("Metadata:", result["output_paths"]["meta"]) else: print("PNG-RENDERING AVSTÄNGD") print("HTML:", html_path) print("Metadata:", output_paths["meta"]) print("") fig.show() if __name__ == "__main__": main()  ⚖️ — License & CopyrightLicensed under RP9-LA-2026Copyright © 2026 Anton WallinSee LICENSE for full terms.

item.title: 3.B. Core4X (X-Y-Z). Sequence. PYTHON
item.description: # 04_VP_Core4_XYZ_SEQUENTIAL_BACK_NEXT.py # Exact Vesica 3D intersection structure # Sequential render: # STEP 0 = green circles only # STEP 1 = colored intersection points # STEP 2 = colored grouped lines # STEP 3 = colored grouped diagonals # Final step equals full extended diagonal render # Render -> HTML -> auto-open import numpy as np import plotly.graph_objects as go import plotly.io as pio import os import webbrowser pio.renderers.default = "browser" # ------------------------------------------------ # SETTINGS # ------------------------------------------------ RADIUS = 1.5 NUM_POINTS = 600 COLOR_BACKGROUND = "black" COLOR_CIRCLE = "#00ff66" COLOR_INNER = "#00aaff" COLOR_LEVEL2 = "#fffff0" COLOR_LEVEL3 = "#ff8800" COLOR_OUTER = "#ff0033" COLOR_BASE_LINES = "#ffffff" COLOR_DIAGONAL_INNER = "#00aaff" COLOR_DIAGONAL_LEVEL2 = "#fffff0" COLOR_DIAGONAL_LEVEL3 = "#ff8800" COLOR_DIAGONAL_OUTER = "#ff0033" COLOR_CUBE_LEVEL2 = "#ffffff" COLOR_CUBE_LEVEL3 = "#ff8800" COLOR_SQUARE_INNER = "#00aaff" COLOR_OUTER_SQUARE = "#ff0033" ROTATIONS = [ (45.0, 45.0, 0.0), (45.0, -45.0, 0.0), (-45.0, 45.0, 0.0), (-45.0, -45.0, 0.0) ] # ------------------------------------------------ # ROTATION MATRIX # ------------------------------------------------ def rotation_matrix(ax_deg, ay_deg, az_deg): ax = np.deg2rad(ax_deg) ay = np.deg2rad(ay_deg) az = np.deg2rad(az_deg) rx = np.array([ [1, 0, 0], [0, np.cos(ax), -np.sin(ax)], [0, np.sin(ax), np.cos(ax)] ]) ry = np.array([ [np.cos(ay), 0, np.sin(ay)], [0, 1, 0], [-np.sin(ay), 0, np.cos(ay)] ]) rz = np.array([ [np.cos(az), -np.sin(az), 0], [np.sin(az), np.cos(az), 0], [0, 0, 1] ]) return rz @ ry @ rx # ------------------------------------------------ # BUILD ROTATED CIRCLES # ------------------------------------------------ def build_circles(radius, rotations): circles = [] base_centers = [ np.array([-radius / 2, 0, 0]), np.array([radius / 2, 0, 0]) ] base_ex = np.array([1, 0, 0]) base_ey = np.array([0, 1, 0]) base_n = np.array([0, 0, 1]) for rot in rotations: rot_matrix = rotation_matrix(*rot) ex = rot_matrix @ base_ex ey = rot_matrix @ base_ey n = rot_matrix @ base_n for center in base_centers: circles.append({ "center": rot_matrix @ center, "ex": ex / np.linalg.norm(ex), "ey": ey / np.linalg.norm(ey), "normal": n / np.linalg.norm(n), "radius": radius }) return circles # ------------------------------------------------ # SAMPLE CIRCLE # ------------------------------------------------ def sample_circle(circle): t = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, NUM_POINTS) center = circle["center"] ex = circle["ex"] ey = circle["ey"] radius = circle["radius"] pts = ( center.reshape(3, 1) + radius * np.cos(t) * ex.reshape(3, 1) + radius * np.sin(t) * ey.reshape(3, 1) ) return pts[0], pts[1], pts[2] # ------------------------------------------------ # EXACT CIRCLE INTERSECTION IN 3D # ------------------------------------------------ def circle_intersection(circle_a, circle_b): c1 = circle_a["center"] c2 = circle_b["center"] n1 = circle_a["normal"] n2 = circle_b["normal"] radius = circle_a["radius"] direction = np.cross(n1, n2) direction_norm = np.linalg.norm(direction) if direction_norm < 1e-8: return [] direction = direction / direction_norm matrix_a = np.vstack([n1, n2, direction]) vector_b = np.array([ np.dot(n1, c1), np.dot(n2, c2), 0 ]) try: p0 = np.linalg.solve(matrix_a, vector_b) except np.linalg.LinAlgError: p0 = np.linalg.lstsq(matrix_a, vector_b, rcond=None)[0] m = p0 - c1 a = np.dot(direction, direction) b = 2 * np.dot(m, direction) c = np.dot(m, m) - radius * radius disc = b * b - 4 * a * c if disc < 0: return [] disc = max(disc, 0) sqrt_disc = np.sqrt(disc) t1 = (-b + sqrt_disc) / (2 * a) t2 = (-b - sqrt_disc) / (2 * a) candidates = [ p0 + t1 * direction, p0 + t2 * direction ] out = [] for point in candidates: if abs(np.linalg.norm(point - c2) - radius) < 1e-5: if not any(np.linalg.norm(point - existing) < 1e-6 for existing in out): out.append(point) return out # ------------------------------------------------ # ALL INTERSECTIONS # ------------------------------------------------ def compute_intersections(circles): points = [] for i in range(len(circles)): for j in range(i + 1, len(circles)): points += circle_intersection(circles[i], circles[j]) unique = [] for point in points: if not any(np.linalg.norm(point - existing) < 1e-6 for existing in unique): unique.append(point) return unique # ------------------------------------------------ # CLASSIFY FOUR LEVELS # ------------------------------------------------ def classify(points): distances = [np.linalg.norm(point) for point in points] shells = sorted(set(np.round(distances, 6))) inner = [] level2 = [] level3 = [] outer = [] for point, distance in zip(points, distances): rounded_distance = np.round(distance, 6) if abs(rounded_distance - shells[0]) < 1e-6: inner.append(point) elif abs(rounded_distance - shells[1]) < 1e-6: level2.append(point) elif abs(rounded_distance - shells[2]) < 1e-6: level3.append(point) else: outer.append(point) return inner, level2, level3, outer # ------------------------------------------------ # DRAW NODES # ------------------------------------------------ def draw_nodes(traces, nodes, color, size): if len(nodes) == 0: return x = [point[0] for point in nodes] y = [point[1] for point in nodes] z = [point[2] for point in nodes] traces.append(go.Scatter3d( x=x, y=y, z=z, mode="markers", marker=dict(size=size, color=color), showlegend=False )) # ------------------------------------------------ # BASE LINK NODES # ------------------------------------------------ def link_nodes(traces, nodes): if len(nodes) < 2: return pts = np.array(nodes) distances = [] for i in range(len(pts)): for j in range(i + 1, len(pts)): distance = np.linalg.norm(pts[i] - pts[j]) if distance > 1e-6: distances.append(distance) if len(distances) == 0: return min_distance = min(distances) threshold = min_distance * 1.08 for i in range(len(pts)): for j in range(i + 1, len(pts)): distance = np.linalg.norm(pts[i] - pts[j]) if distance <= threshold: traces.append(go.Scatter3d( x=[pts[i][0], pts[j][0]], y=[pts[i][1], pts[j][1]], z=[pts[i][2], pts[j][2]], mode="lines", line=dict(color=COLOR_BASE_LINES, width=1), opacity=0.25, showlegend=False )) # ------------------------------------------------ # EDGE STRUCTURE LINKS # ------------------------------------------------ def link_cube(traces, nodes, color="#ffffff", width=4, opacity=0.9): if len(nodes) < 2: return pts = np.array(nodes) distances = [] for i in range(len(pts)): for j in range(i + 1, len(pts)): distance = np.linalg.norm(pts[i] - pts[j]) if distance > 1e-6: distances.append(distance) if len(distances) == 0: return min_distance = min(distances) threshold = min_distance * 1.08 for i in range(len(pts)): for j in range(i + 1, len(pts)): distance = np.linalg.norm(pts[i] - pts[j]) if distance <= threshold: traces.append(go.Scatter3d( x=[pts[i][0], pts[j][0]], y=[pts[i][1], pts[j][1]], z=[pts[i][2], pts[j][2]], mode="lines", line=dict(color=color, width=width), opacity=opacity, showlegend=False )) # ------------------------------------------------ # GROUP DIAGONAL LINKS # ------------------------------------------------ def link_group_diagonals(traces, nodes, color, width=2, opacity=0.55): if len(nodes) < 3: return pts = np.array(nodes) distances = [] for i in range(len(pts)): for j in range(i + 1, len(pts)): distance = np.linalg.norm(pts[i] - pts[j]) if distance > 1e-6: distances.append(distance) if len(distances) == 0: return unique_distances = sorted(set(np.round(distances, 6))) if len(unique_distances) < 2: return edge_distance = unique_distances[0] for i in range(len(pts)): for j in range(i + 1, len(pts)): distance = np.round(np.linalg.norm(pts[i] - pts[j]), 6) if distance > edge_distance * 1.08: traces.append(go.Scatter3d( x=[pts[i][0], pts[j][0]], y=[pts[i][1], pts[j][1]], z=[pts[i][2], pts[j][2]], mode="lines", line=dict(color=color, width=width), opacity=opacity, showlegend=False )) # ------------------------------------------------ # BUILD STRUCTURE # ------------------------------------------------ circles = build_circles(RADIUS, ROTATIONS) points = compute_intersections(circles) inner, level2, level3, outer = classify(points) # ------------------------------------------------ # TRACE GROUPS # ------------------------------------------------ circle_traces = [] node_traces = [] line_traces = [] diagonal_traces = [] for circle in circles: x, y, z = sample_circle(circle) circle_traces.append(go.Scatter3d( x=x, y=y, z=z, mode="lines", line=dict(color=COLOR_CIRCLE, width=4), opacity=0.9, showlegend=False )) draw_nodes(node_traces, inner, COLOR_INNER, 6) draw_nodes(node_traces, level2, COLOR_LEVEL2, 6) draw_nodes(node_traces, level3, COLOR_LEVEL3, 6) draw_nodes(node_traces, outer, COLOR_OUTER, 7) link_nodes(line_traces, inner) link_nodes(line_traces, level2) link_nodes(line_traces, level3) link_nodes(line_traces, outer) link_cube(line_traces, inner, color=COLOR_SQUARE_INNER, width=3, opacity=0.9) link_cube(line_traces, level2, color=COLOR_CUBE_LEVEL2, width=4, opacity=0.95) link_cube(line_traces, level3, color=COLOR_CUBE_LEVEL3, width=4, opacity=0.90) link_cube(line_traces, outer, color=COLOR_OUTER_SQUARE, width=3, opacity=0.9) link_group_diagonals(diagonal_traces, inner, color=COLOR_DIAGONAL_INNER, width=2, opacity=0.60) link_group_diagonals(diagonal_traces, level2, color=COLOR_DIAGONAL_LEVEL2, width=2, opacity=0.50) link_group_diagonals(diagonal_traces, level3, color=COLOR_DIAGONAL_LEVEL3, width=2, opacity=0.50) link_group_diagonals(diagonal_traces, outer, color=COLOR_DIAGONAL_OUTER, width=2, opacity=0.60) # ------------------------------------------------ # COMBINE ALL TRACES # ------------------------------------------------ traces = [] traces += circle_traces traces += node_traces traces += line_traces traces += diagonal_traces circle_count = len(circle_traces) node_count = len(node_traces) line_count = len(line_traces) diagonal_count = len(diagonal_traces) total_count = len(traces) visible_step_0 = [] visible_step_1 = [] visible_step_2 = [] visible_step_3 = [] for index in range(total_count): is_circle = index < circle_count is_node = circle_count <= index < circle_count + node_count is_line = circle_count + node_count <= index < circle_count + node_count + line_count is_diagonal = circle_count + node_count + line_count <= index visible_step_0.append(is_circle) visible_step_1.append(is_circle or is_node) visible_step_2.append(is_circle or is_node or is_line) visible_step_3.append(is_circle or is_node or is_line or is_diagonal) for index, trace in enumerate(traces): trace.visible = visible_step_0[index] # ------------------------------------------------ # FIGURE # ------------------------------------------------ fig = go.Figure(data=traces) fig.update_layout( paper_bgcolor=COLOR_BACKGROUND, plot_bgcolor=COLOR_BACKGROUND, scene=dict( xaxis=dict(visible=False), yaxis=dict(visible=False), zaxis=dict(visible=False), aspectmode="data" ), margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=0, b=95) ) # ------------------------------------------------ # CUSTOM BACK / NEXT CONTROLS # ------------------------------------------------ visible_arrays_js = [ "var RP9_VISIBLE_STEPS = [];", "RP9_VISIBLE_STEPS.push(" + str(visible_step_0).lower() + ");", "RP9_VISIBLE_STEPS.push(" + str(visible_step_1).lower() + ");", "RP9_VISIBLE_STEPS.push(" + str(visible_step_2).lower() + ");", "RP9_VISIBLE_STEPS.push(" + str(visible_step_3).lower() + ");", "var RP9_STEP_LABELS = [", "'STEP 0: CIRCLES',", "'STEP 1: INTERSECTION POINTS',", "'STEP 2: GROUPED LINES',", "'STEP 3: GROUPED DIAGONALS'", "];", "var RP9_CURRENT_STEP = 0;", "var RP9_PLOT = document.getElementById('{plot_id}');", "var RP9_WRAPPER = RP9_PLOT.parentNode;", "var RP9_CONTROL = document.createElement('div');", "RP9_CONTROL.style.position = 'fixed';", "RP9_CONTROL.style.left = '0';", "RP9_CONTROL.style.right = '0';", "RP9_CONTROL.style.bottom = '0';", "RP9_CONTROL.style.height = '72px';", "RP9_CONTROL.style.background = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.92)';", "RP9_CONTROL.style.display = 'flex';", "RP9_CONTROL.style.alignItems = 'center';", "RP9_CONTROL.style.justifyContent = 'center';", "RP9_CONTROL.style.gap = '22px';", "RP9_CONTROL.style.zIndex = '9999';", "RP9_CONTROL.style.borderTop = '1px solid rgba(0,255,102,0.45)';", "var RP9_BACK = document.createElement('button');", "RP9_BACK.innerHTML = 'BACK';", "RP9_BACK.style.background = '#111111';", "RP9_BACK.style.color = '#00ff66';", "RP9_BACK.style.border = '1px solid #00ff66';", "RP9_BACK.style.padding = '12px 28px';", "RP9_BACK.style.fontSize = '15px';", "RP9_BACK.style.fontFamily = 'Arial, sans-serif';", "RP9_BACK.style.cursor = 'pointer';", "var RP9_LABEL = document.createElement('div');", "RP9_LABEL.innerHTML = RP9_STEP_LABELS[0];", "RP9_LABEL.style.color = '#ffffff';", "RP9_LABEL.style.fontFamily = 'Arial, sans-serif';", "RP9_LABEL.style.fontSize = '15px';", "RP9_LABEL.style.minWidth = '260px';", "RP9_LABEL.style.textAlign = 'center';", "var RP9_NEXT = document.createElement('button');", "RP9_NEXT.innerHTML = 'NEXT';", "RP9_NEXT.style.background = '#111111';", "RP9_NEXT.style.color = '#00ff66';", "RP9_NEXT.style.border = '1px solid #00ff66';", "RP9_NEXT.style.padding = '12px 28px';", "RP9_NEXT.style.fontSize = '15px';", "RP9_NEXT.style.fontFamily = 'Arial, sans-serif';", "RP9_NEXT.style.cursor = 'pointer';", "RP9_CONTROL.appendChild(RP9_BACK);", "RP9_CONTROL.appendChild(RP9_LABEL);", "RP9_CONTROL.appendChild(RP9_NEXT);", "document.body.appendChild(RP9_CONTROL);", "function RP9_RENDER_STEP(stepIndex) {", " if (stepIndex < 0) {", " stepIndex = 0;", " }", " if (stepIndex > 3) {", " stepIndex = 3;", " }", " RP9_CURRENT_STEP = stepIndex;", " Plotly.restyle(RP9_PLOT, {visible: RP9_VISIBLE_STEPS[RP9_CURRENT_STEP]});", " RP9_LABEL.innerHTML = RP9_STEP_LABELS[RP9_CURRENT_STEP];", "}", "RP9_BACK.onclick = function() {", " RP9_RENDER_STEP(RP9_CURRENT_STEP - 1);", "};", "RP9_NEXT.onclick = function() {", " RP9_RENDER_STEP(RP9_CURRENT_STEP + 1);", "};", "document.addEventListener('keydown', function(event) {", " if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft') {", " RP9_RENDER_STEP(RP9_CURRENT_STEP - 1);", " }", " if (event.key === 'ArrowRight') {", " RP9_RENDER_STEP(RP9_CURRENT_STEP + 1);", " }", "});" ] post_script = "\n".join(visible_arrays_js) # ------------------------------------------------ # EXPORT # ------------------------------------------------ out_file = "VP Core4 (X-Y-Z) Sequence.html" fig.write_html( out_file, include_plotlyjs=True, post_script=post_script ) webbrowser.open("file://" + os.path.abspath(out_file)) fig.show() ⚖️ — License & CopyrightLicensed under RP9-LA-2026Copyright © 2026 Anton WallinSee LICENSE for full terms.

item.description: Info This document is part of RP9's standardized A.P.X layer (Appendix). A.P.X documents function as explanatory support material and constitute a supplementary orientation layer to the formal documentation. The purpose is to: explain established concepts, visualize already derived structures, summarize relationships, create a pedagogical overview, facilitate navigation between documents. A.P.X introduces no new axioms, no new relationships and no new verifications. The material only reproduces information that has already been established in the formal presentation and verification chain. A.P.X should therefore not be considered as part of the chain of evidence itself, but as a human interface that makes the underlying structure more accessible. The document type can be placed together with the documents it supports without changing their relational or operational position within RP9. "This document follows the RP9 A.P.X standard and constitutes explanatory support material". The document type is intended to increase the understanding of already established relations without introducing new axioms, relations or verifications." (H-D-R)_x3 N3 → Diagonal multiple vesica and network structure TERM: X4_D1 Local operational function: first diagonal vesica expansion Local structure status: diagonal expansion layer Local relational role: establishes first diagonal intersection plane TERM: X4_D2 Local operational function: second diagonal vesica expansion Local structure status: opposite diagonal structure Local relational role: balances diagonal relation around center axis TERM: X4_D3 Local operational function: third diagonal vesica expansion Local structural status: inverted diagonal structure Local relational role: couples diagonal rotation to opposite intersection field TERM: X4_D4 Local operational function: fourth diagonal vesica expansion Local structural status: final diagonal-locking expansion layer Local relational role: completes simultaneous diagonal structure around center TERM: radius_diag Local operational function: defines diagonal expansion radius Local structural status: third scale level Local relational role: enables hierarchical transition from X2 to X4 TERM: Diagonal vesica Local operational function: vesica structure established by diagonal orientation Local structural status: simultaneous diagonal intersection structure Local relational role: ties multiple diagonal planes to common center TERM: X4_D1_C1 / X4_D1_C2 Local operational function: center positions of first diagonal vesicane Local structural status: diagonal center axis Local relational role: anchors first diagonal plane in center coherence TERM: X4_D1_I_TOP / I_BOTTOM Local operational function: intersection points of first diagonal vesicane Local structural status: diagonal emergence point Local relational role: connects diagonal structure to vertical intersection TERM: X4_D2–D4 intersections Local operational function: secondary diagonal intersection fields Local structural status: multiple diagonal emergence Local relational role: connects all diagonal plane operational TERM: Diagonal relational structure Local operational function: connects all diagonal points through relational distances Local structural status: full diagonal network structure Local relational role: enables simultaneous diagonal coherence TERM: relations_K_n Local operational function: full relation connection between all X1/X2/X4 points Local structure status: global network matrix Local relational role: ties the entire diagonal and rotation structure into a coherent relational field TERM: Hierarchical scale structure Local operational function: organizes radius_core → radius_axis → radius_diag Local structure status: sequential scale expansion Local relational role: enables deterministic transition between levels TERM: Diagonal Coherence Local Operational Function: ensures that the diagonal plane maintains center relation Local Structural Status: invariant diagonal balance Local Relational Role: prevents structural divergence between diagonal expansions TERM: Simultaneous Structure Local Operational Function: maintains multiple vesica planes simultaneously Local Structural Status: multiple active structure positions Local relational role: enables simultaneous rotation and diagonal emergence TERM: V-A / V-B / V-C / V-D Local operational function: locked observation views for diagonal structure Local structure status: projective observation layers Local relational role: enables comparison between diagonal and orthogonal compression TERM: Topological network structure Local operational function: connects all centers and intersections through network relations Local structural status: complete relational geometry Local relational role: enables global structural coherence TERM: Projection compression Local operational function: reduces diagonal structure to observable views Local structural status: observation-based compression Local relational role: preserves structure under perspective change TERM: Diagonal emergence Local operational function: produces new structure through diagonal expansion Local structural status: third expansion level Local relational role: couples rotational structure to simultaneous diagonal development REFERENCE = local diagonal position + local expansion function not:global semantic model All definitions above only apply to:B.3.0. (F.R.C) (F.R.C) 3. (H-D-R)_x3 and only within:the current diagonal multiple vesica and network structure

item.title: C. STRUCTURE. (H-D-R) x3. PYTHON
item.description: import csv import json import subprocess import sys import webbrowser from pathlib import Path import numpy as np import plotly.graph_objects as go SCRIPT_VERSION = "2.0.1" try: SCRIPT_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve() except NameError: SCRIPT_PATH = Path.cwd() / "(H-D-R)_x4_IN-PTS-Net.py" ROOT_DIR = SCRIPT_PATH.parent FILE_NAME = SCRIPT_PATH.stem # ============================================================ # GLOBAL RENDER FLAGS (IDENTISKT x2) # ============================================================ SHOW_CENTERS = True SHOW_RELATIONS = True SHOW_INTERSECTIONS = True RENDER_DIR = ROOT_DIR / "PNG & HTML" DATA_DIR = ROOT_DIR / "CODE_data_output" RENDER_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) DATA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) def ensure_kaleido(): try: import kaleido return True except Exception: subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "kaleido"]) return True def as_float(value): return float(value) def as_list(point): return [float(v) for v in point] def distance_3d(p1, p2): return float(np.linalg.norm(p2 - p1)) def circle_intersections(c1, r1, c2, r2): x1, y1 = c1 x2, y2 = c2 dx = x2 - x1 dy = y2 - y1 d = np.hypot(dx, dy) if d > r1 + r2 or d < abs(r1 - r2) or d == 0: return [] a = (r1**2 - r2**2 + d**2) / (2 * d) h = np.sqrt(r1**2 - a**2) xm = x1 + a * dx / d ym = y1 + a * dy / d rx = -dy * (h / d) ry = dx * (h / d) p1 = np.array([xm + rx, ym + ry]) p2 = np.array([xm - rx, ym - ry]) return [p1, p2] def create_vesica_circles(r, n=200): t = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, n) x1 = r * np.cos(t) - r / 2 y1 = r * np.sin(t) x2 = r * np.cos(t) + r / 2 y2 = r * np.sin(t) return (x1, y1), (x2, y2) def rotate_3d(x, y, z, ax, ay, az): rad_x = np.deg2rad(ax) rad_y = np.deg2rad(ay) rad_z = np.deg2rad(az) if ax != 0: y, z = ( y * np.cos(rad_x) - z * np.sin(rad_x), y * np.sin(rad_x) + z * np.cos(rad_x) ) if ay != 0: x, z = ( x * np.cos(rad_y) + z * np.sin(rad_y), -x * np.sin(rad_y) + z * np.cos(rad_y) ) if az != 0: x, y = ( x * np.cos(rad_z) - y * np.sin(rad_z), x * np.sin(rad_z) + y * np.cos(rad_z) ) return x, y, z def rotate_point(point, ax, ay, az): x, y, z = point rx, ry, rz = rotate_3d(x, y, z, ax, ay, az) return np.array([rx, ry, rz]) def vesica_points(r): c1 = np.array([-r / 2, 0]) c2 = np.array([r / 2, 0]) intersections_2d = circle_intersections(c1, r, c2, r) centers = [ np.array([c1[0], c1[1], 0.0]), np.array([c2[0], c2[1], 0.0]) ] intersections = [ np.array([p[0], p[1], 0.0]) for p in intersections_2d ] return centers, intersections # ============================================================ # PARAMETRAR (x4) # ============================================================ r_core = 6.0 r_axis = 3.0 r_diag = 1.5 t = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 200) COLOR_CORE = "#4da6ff" COLOR_X2 = "#ff4d4d" COLOR_X4 = "#66ff66" LINE_WIDTH = 3 # ============================================================ # LAGER (IDENTISK STRUKTUR + x4) # ============================================================ VESICA_LAYERS = [ {"id": "X1_CORE", "radius": r_core, "color": COLOR_CORE, "rotation": (0, 0, 0)}, {"id": "X2_ROT_X", "radius": r_axis, "color": COLOR_X2, "rotation": (90, 0, 0)}, {"id": "X2_ROT_Y", "radius": r_axis, "color": COLOR_X2, "rotation": (0, 90, 0)}, {"id": "X4_D1", "radius": r_diag, "color": COLOR_X4, "rotation": (45, 45, 0)}, {"id": "X4_D2", "radius": r_diag, "color": COLOR_X4, "rotation": (45, -45, 0)}, {"id": "X4_D3", "radius": r_diag, "color": COLOR_X4, "rotation": (-45, 45, 0)}, {"id": "X4_D4", "radius": r_diag, "color": COLOR_X4, "rotation": (-45, -45, 0)}, ] def add_vesica_to_traces(traces, nodes, labels, r, color, opacity, width, rotation, layer_id): (c1_x, c1_y), (c2_x, c2_y) = create_vesica_circles(r) for cx, cy in [(c1_x, c1_y), (c2_x, c2_y)]: z = np.zeros_like(cx) rx, ry, rz = rotate_3d(cx, cy, z, *rotation) traces.append(go.Scatter3d( x=rx, y=ry, z=rz, mode="lines", line=dict(color=color, width=width), opacity=opacity, showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none" )) centers, intersections = vesica_points(r) centers_rot = [rotate_point(p, *rotation) for p in centers] inter_rot = [rotate_point(p, *rotation) for p in intersections] names = [ layer_id + "_C1", layer_id + "_C2", layer_id + "_I_TOP", layer_id + "_I_BOTTOM" ] for n, p in zip(names, centers_rot + inter_rot): labels.append(n) nodes.append(p) if SHOW_CENTERS: traces.append(go.Scatter3d( x=[p[0] for p in centers_rot], y=[p[1] for p in centers_rot], z=[p[2] for p in centers_rot], mode="markers", marker=dict(size=8, color="gray"), showlegend=False )) if SHOW_INTERSECTIONS: traces.append(go.Scatter3d( x=[p[0] for p in inter_rot], y=[p[1] for p in inter_rot], z=[p[2] for p in inter_rot], mode="markers", marker=dict(size=10, color="white"), showlegend=False )) def build_nodes_and_edges(): nodes = [] labels = [] for layer in VESICA_LAYERS: add_vesica_to_traces([], nodes, labels, layer["radius"], layer["color"], 1.0, LINE_WIDTH, layer["rotation"], layer["id"]) edges = [] for i in range(len(nodes)): for j in range(i + 1, len(nodes)): edges.append({ "from": labels[i], "to": labels[j], "distance": distance_3d(nodes[i], nodes[j]) }) return nodes, labels, edges all_points, point_labels, edges = build_nodes_and_edges() def build_figure(title_text): traces = [] nodes = [] labels = [] for layer in VESICA_LAYERS: add_vesica_to_traces(traces, nodes, labels, layer["radius"], layer["color"], 1.0, LINE_WIDTH, layer["rotation"], layer["id"]) if SHOW_RELATIONS: for i in range(len(nodes)): for j in range(i + 1, len(nodes)): p1 = nodes[i] p2 = nodes[j] traces.append(go.Scatter3d( x=[p1[0], p2[0]], y=[p1[1], p2[1]], z=[p1[2], p2[2]], mode="lines", line=dict(width=1, color="white"), showlegend=False )) fig = go.Figure(data=traces) fig.update_layout( title=title_text, template="plotly_dark", width=1100, height=650, paper_bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)", plot_bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)", margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=60, b=0), scene=dict( aspectmode="data", xaxis=dict(visible=False), yaxis=dict(visible=False), zaxis=dict(visible=False), bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)" ) ) return fig CAM_SCALE = 1.5 VIEWS = { "V-A": {"camera": dict(eye=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=2.0 * CAM_SCALE))}, "V-B": {"camera": dict(eye=dict(x=2.0 * CAM_SCALE, y=0.0, z=0.0))}, "V-C": {"camera": dict(eye=dict(x=0.0, y=2.0 * CAM_SCALE, z=0.0))}, "V-D": {"camera": dict(eye=dict(x=1.5 * CAM_SCALE, y=1.5 * CAM_SCALE, z=1.0 * CAM_SCALE))} } fig_main = build_figure(FILE_NAME) html_file = RENDER_DIR / (FILE_NAME + ".html") fig_main.write_html(str(html_file)) ensure_kaleido() png_files = [] for view_name, view_data in VIEWS.items(): fig_view = build_figure(FILE_NAME + " - " + view_name) fig_view.update_layout(scene_camera=view_data["camera"]) png_file = RENDER_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "__" + view_name + ".png") fig_view.write_image(str(png_file), width=1100, height=650, scale=2) png_files.append(str(png_file)) # ============================================================ # FULL DATA EXPORT (DETTA VAR DET SOM SAKNADES) # ============================================================ data_sheet = { "script": { "file_name": FILE_NAME, "script_path": str(SCRIPT_PATH), "version": SCRIPT_VERSION }, "output": { "render_folder": str(RENDER_DIR), "data_folder": str(DATA_DIR), "html_file": str(html_file), "png_files": png_files }, "parameters": { "radius_core": as_float(r_core), "radius_axis": as_float(r_axis), "radius_diag": as_float(r_diag), "circle_resolution": int(len(t)), "camera_scale": as_float(CAM_SCALE), "color_core": COLOR_CORE, "color_x2": COLOR_X2, "color_x4": COLOR_X4, "line_width": int(LINE_WIDTH) }, "all_points": { point_labels[i]: as_list(all_points[i]) for i in range(len(all_points)) }, "relations_K_n": edges } json_file = DATA_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "_datasheet.json") md_file = DATA_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "_datasheet.md") csv_file = DATA_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "_points.csv") edges_csv_file = DATA_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "_relations.csv") with open(json_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(data_sheet, f, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False) with open(csv_file, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f: writer = csv.writer(f) writer.writerow(["point", "x", "y", "z"]) for label, point in zip(point_labels, all_points): writer.writerow([label, *as_list(point)]) with open(edges_csv_file, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f: writer = csv.writer(f) writer.writerow(["from", "to", "distance"]) for edge in edges: writer.writerow([edge["from"], edge["to"], edge["distance"]]) webbrowser.open("file://" + str(html_file.resolve())) print("") print("EXPORT KLAR") print("HTML:", html_file) print("") for item in png_files: print("PNG:", item) print("") print("DATA:", json_file) print("DATA:", csv_file) print("DATA:", edges_csv_file) ⚖️ — License & CopyrightLicensed under
