item.title: B. NODES. (H-D-R) x3. PYTHON
item.description: import csv import json import subprocess import sys import webbrowser from pathlib import Path import numpy as np import plotly.graph_objects as go SCRIPT_VERSION = "2.0.1" try: SCRIPT_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve() except NameError: SCRIPT_PATH = Path.cwd() / "(H-D-R)_x4_IN-PTS-Net.py" ROOT_DIR = SCRIPT_PATH.parent FILE_NAME = SCRIPT_PATH.stem # ============================================================ # GLOBAL RENDER FLAGS (IDENTISKT x2) # ============================================================ SHOW_CENTERS = True SHOW_RELATIONS = False SHOW_INTERSECTIONS = False RENDER_DIR = ROOT_DIR / "PNG & HTML" DATA_DIR = ROOT_DIR / "CODE_data_output" RENDER_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) DATA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) def ensure_kaleido(): try: import kaleido return True except Exception: subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "kaleido"]) return True def as_float(value): return float(value) def as_list(point): return [float(v) for v in point] def distance_3d(p1, p2): return float(np.linalg.norm(p2 - p1)) def circle_intersections(c1, r1, c2, r2): x1, y1 = c1 x2, y2 = c2 dx = x2 - x1 dy = y2 - y1 d = np.hypot(dx, dy) if d > r1 + r2 or d < abs(r1 - r2) or d == 0: return [] a = (r1**2 - r2**2 + d**2) / (2 * d) h = np.sqrt(r1**2 - a**2) xm = x1 + a * dx / d ym = y1 + a * dy / d rx = -dy * (h / d) ry = dx * (h / d) p1 = np.array([xm + rx, ym + ry]) p2 = np.array([xm - rx, ym - ry]) return [p1, p2] def create_vesica_circles(r, n=200): t = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, n) x1 = r * np.cos(t) - r / 2 y1 = r * np.sin(t) x2 = r * np.cos(t) + r / 2 y2 = r * np.sin(t) return (x1, y1), (x2, y2) def rotate_3d(x, y, z, ax, ay, az): rad_x = np.deg2rad(ax) rad_y = np.deg2rad(ay) rad_z = np.deg2rad(az) if ax != 0: y, z = ( y * np.cos(rad_x) - z * np.sin(rad_x), y * np.sin(rad_x) + z * np.cos(rad_x) ) if ay != 0: x, z = ( x * np.cos(rad_y) + z * np.sin(rad_y), -x * np.sin(rad_y) + z * np.cos(rad_y) ) if az != 0: x, y = ( x * np.cos(rad_z) - y * np.sin(rad_z), x * np.sin(rad_z) + y * np.cos(rad_z) ) return x, y, z def rotate_point(point, ax, ay, az): x, y, z = point rx, ry, rz = rotate_3d(x, y, z, ax, ay, az) return np.array([rx, ry, rz]) def vesica_points(r): c1 = np.array([-r / 2, 0]) c2 = np.array([r / 2, 0]) intersections_2d = circle_intersections(c1, r, c2, r) centers = [ np.array([c1[0], c1[1], 0.0]), np.array([c2[0], c2[1], 0.0]) ] intersections = [ np.array([p[0], p[1], 0.0]) for p in intersections_2d ] return centers, intersections # ============================================================ # PARAMETRAR (x4) # ============================================================ r_core = 6.0 r_axis = 3.0 r_diag = 1.5 t = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 200) COLOR_CORE = "#4da6ff" COLOR_X2 = "#ff4d4d" COLOR_X4 = "#66ff66" LINE_WIDTH = 3 # ============================================================ # LAGER (IDENTISK STRUKTUR + x4) # ============================================================ VESICA_LAYERS = [ {"id": "X1_CORE", "radius": r_core, "color": COLOR_CORE, "rotation": (0, 0, 0)}, {"id": "X2_ROT_X", "radius": r_axis, "color": COLOR_X2, "rotation": (90, 0, 0)}, {"id": "X2_ROT_Y", "radius": r_axis, "color": COLOR_X2, "rotation": (0, 90, 0)}, {"id": "X4_D1", "radius": r_diag, "color": COLOR_X4, "rotation": (45, 45, 0)}, {"id": "X4_D2", "radius": r_diag, "color": COLOR_X4, "rotation": (45, -45, 0)}, {"id": "X4_D3", "radius": r_diag, "color": COLOR_X4, "rotation": (-45, 45, 0)}, {"id": "X4_D4", "radius": r_diag, "color": COLOR_X4, "rotation": (-45, -45, 0)}, ] def add_vesica_to_traces(traces, nodes, labels, r, color, opacity, width, rotation, layer_id): (c1_x, c1_y), (c2_x, c2_y) = create_vesica_circles(r) for cx, cy in [(c1_x, c1_y), (c2_x, c2_y)]: z = np.zeros_like(cx) rx, ry, rz = rotate_3d(cx, cy, z, *rotation) traces.append(go.Scatter3d( x=rx, y=ry, z=rz, mode="lines", line=dict(color=color, width=width), opacity=opacity, showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none" )) centers, intersections = vesica_points(r) centers_rot = [rotate_point(p, *rotation) for p in centers] inter_rot = [rotate_point(p, *rotation) for p in intersections] names = [ layer_id + "_C1", layer_id + "_C2", layer_id + "_I_TOP", layer_id + "_I_BOTTOM" ] for n, p in zip(names, centers_rot + inter_rot): labels.append(n) nodes.append(p) if SHOW_CENTERS: traces.append(go.Scatter3d( x=[p[0] for p in centers_rot], y=[p[1] for p in centers_rot], z=[p[2] for p in centers_rot], mode="markers", marker=dict(size=8, color="gray"), showlegend=False )) if SHOW_INTERSECTIONS: traces.append(go.Scatter3d( x=[p[0] for p in inter_rot], y=[p[1] for p in inter_rot], z=[p[2] for p in inter_rot], mode="markers", marker=dict(size=10, color="white"), showlegend=False )) def build_nodes_and_edges(): nodes = [] labels = [] for layer in VESICA_LAYERS: add_vesica_to_traces([], nodes, labels, layer["radius"], layer["color"], 1.0, LINE_WIDTH, layer["rotation"], layer["id"]) edges = [] for i in range(len(nodes)): for j in range(i + 1, len(nodes)): edges.append({ "from": labels[i], "to": labels[j], "distance": distance_3d(nodes[i], nodes[j]) }) return nodes, labels, edges all_points, point_labels, edges = build_nodes_and_edges() def build_figure(title_text): traces = [] nodes = [] labels = [] for layer in VESICA_LAYERS: add_vesica_to_traces(traces, nodes, labels, layer["radius"], layer["color"], 1.0, LINE_WIDTH, layer["rotation"], layer["id"]) if SHOW_RELATIONS: for i in range(len(nodes)): for j in range(i + 1, len(nodes)): p1 = nodes[i] p2 = nodes[j] traces.append(go.Scatter3d( x=[p1[0], p2[0]], y=[p1[1], p2[1]], z=[p1[2], p2[2]], mode="lines", line=dict(width=1, color="white"), showlegend=False )) fig = go.Figure(data=traces) fig.update_layout( title=title_text, template="plotly_dark", width=1100, height=650, paper_bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)", plot_bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)", margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=60, b=0), scene=dict( aspectmode="data", xaxis=dict(visible=False), yaxis=dict(visible=False), zaxis=dict(visible=False), bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)" ) ) return fig CAM_SCALE = 1.5 VIEWS = { "V-A": {"camera": dict(eye=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=2.0 * CAM_SCALE))}, "V-B": {"camera": dict(eye=dict(x=2.0 * CAM_SCALE, y=0.0, z=0.0))}, "V-C": {"camera": dict(eye=dict(x=0.0, y=2.0 * CAM_SCALE, z=0.0))}, "V-D": {"camera": dict(eye=dict(x=1.5 * CAM_SCALE, y=1.5 * CAM_SCALE, z=1.0 * CAM_SCALE))} } fig_main = build_figure(FILE_NAME) html_file = RENDER_DIR / (FILE_NAME + ".html") fig_main.write_html(str(html_file)) ensure_kaleido() png_files = [] for view_name, view_data in VIEWS.items(): fig_view = build_figure(FILE_NAME + " - " + view_name) fig_view.update_layout(scene_camera=view_data["camera"]) png_file = RENDER_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "__" + view_name + ".png") fig_view.write_image(str(png_file), width=1100, height=650, scale=2) png_files.append(str(png_file)) # ============================================================ # FULL DATA EXPORT (DETTA VAR DET SOM SAKNADES) # ============================================================ data_sheet = { "script": { "file_name": FILE_NAME, "script_path": str(SCRIPT_PATH), "version": SCRIPT_VERSION }, "output": { "render_folder": str(RENDER_DIR), "data_folder": str(DATA_DIR), "html_file": str(html_file), "png_files": png_files }, "parameters": { "radius_core": as_float(r_core), "radius_axis": as_float(r_axis), "radius_diag": as_float(r_diag), "circle_resolution": int(len(t)), "camera_scale": as_float(CAM_SCALE), "color_core": COLOR_CORE, "color_x2": COLOR_X2, "color_x4": COLOR_X4, "line_width": int(LINE_WIDTH) }, "all_points": { point_labels[i]: as_list(all_points[i]) for i in range(len(all_points)) }, "relations_K_n": edges } json_file = DATA_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "_datasheet.json") md_file = DATA_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "_datasheet.md") csv_file = DATA_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "_points.csv") edges_csv_file = DATA_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "_relations.csv") with open(json_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(data_sheet, f, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False) with open(csv_file, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f: writer = csv.writer(f) writer.writerow(["point", "x", "y", "z"]) for label, point in zip(point_labels, all_points): writer.writerow([label, *as_list(point)]) with open(edges_csv_file, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f: writer = csv.writer(f) writer.writerow(["from", "to", "distance"]) for edge in edges: writer.writerow([edge["from"], edge["to"], edge["distance"]]) webbrowser.open("file://" + str(html_file.resolve())) print("") print("EXPORT KLAR") print("HTML:", html_file) print("") for item in png_files: print("PNG:", item) print("") print("DATA:", json_file) print("DATA:", csv_file) print("DATA:", edges_csv_file) ⚖️ — License & CopyrightLicensed under RP9-LA-2026Copyright © 2026 Anton WallinSee LICENSE for full terms.

for cx, cy in [(c1_x, c1_y), (c2_x, c2_y)]: z = np.zeros_like(cx) rx, ry, rz = rotate_3d(cx, cy, z, *rotation) traces.append(go.Scatter3d( x=rx, y=ry, z=rz, mode="lines", line=dict(color=color, width=width), opacity=opacity, showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none" )) centers, intersections = vesica_points(r) centers_rot = [rotate_point(p, *rotation) for p in centers] inter_rot = [rotate_point(p, *rotation) for p in intersections] names = [ layer_id + "_C1", layer_id + "_C2", layer_id + "_I_TOP", layer_id + "_I_BOTTOM" ] for n, p in zip(names, centers_rot + inter_rot): labels.append(n) nodes.append(p) if SHOW_CENTERS: traces.append(go.Scatter3d( x=[p[0] for p in centers_rot], y=[p[1] for p in centers_rot], z=[p[2] for p in centers_rot], mode="markers", marker=dict(size=8, color="gray"), showlegend=False )) if SHOW_INTERSECTIONS: traces.append(go.Scatter3d( x=[p[0] for p in inter_rot], y=[p[1] for p in inter_rot], z=[p[2] for p in inter_rot], mode="markers", marker=dict(size=10, color="white"), showlegend=False )) def build_nodes_and_edges(): nodes = [] labels = [] for layer in VESICA_LAYERS: add_vesica_to_traces([], nodes, labels, layer["radius"], layer["color"], 1.0, LINE_WIDTH, layer["rotation"], layer["id"]) edges = [] for i in range(len(nodes)): for j in range(i + 1, len(nodes)): edges.append({ "from": labels[i], "to": labels[j], "distance": distance_3d(nodes[i], nodes[j]) }) return nodes, labels, edges all_points, point_labels, edges = build_nodes_and_edges() def build_figure(title_text): traces = [] nodes = [] labels = [] for layer in VESICA_LAYERS: add_vesica_to_traces(traces, nodes, labels, layer["radius"], layer["color"], 1.0, LINE_WIDTH, layer["rotation"], layer["id"]) if SHOW_RELATIONS: for i in range(len(nodes)): for j in range(i + 1, len(nodes)): p1 = nodes[i] p2 = nodes[j] traces.append(go.Scatter3d( x=[p1[0], p2[0]], y=[p1[1], p2[1]], z=[p1[2], p2[2]], mode="lines", line=dict(width=1, color="white"), showlegend=False )) fig = go.Figure(data=traces) fig.update_layout( title=title_text, template="plotly_dark", width=1100, height=650, paper_bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)", plot_bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)", margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=60, b=0), scene=dict( aspectmode="data", xaxis=dict(visible=False), yaxis=dict(visible=False), zaxis=dict(visible=False), bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)" ) ) return fig CAM_SCALE = 1.5 VIEWS = { "V-A": {"camera": dict(eye=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=2.0 * CAM_SCALE))}, "V-B": {"camera": dict(eye=dict(x=2.0 * CAM_SCALE, y=0.0, z=0.0))}, "V-C": {"camera": dict(eye=dict(x=0.0, y=2.0 * CAM_SCALE, z=0.0))}, "V-D": {"camera": dict(eye=dict(x=1.5 * CAM_SCALE, y=1.5 * CAM_SCALE, z=1.0 * CAM_SCALE))} } fig_main = build_figure(FILE_NAME) html_file = RENDER_DIR / (FILE_NAME + ".html") fig_main.write_html(str(html_file)) ensure_kaleido() png_files = [] for view_name, view_data in VIEWS.items(): fig_view = build_figure(FILE_NAME + " - " + view_name) fig_view.update_layout(scene_camera=view_data["camera"]) png_file = RENDER_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "__" + view_name + ".png") fig_view.write_image(str(png_file), width=1100, height=650, scale=2) png_files.append(str(png_file)) # ============================================================ # FULL DATA EXPORT (DETTA VAR DET SOM SAKNADES) # ============================================================ data_sheet = { "script": { "file_name": FILE_NAME, "script_path": str(SCRIPT_PATH), "version": SCRIPT_VERSION }, "output": { "render_folder": str(RENDER_DIR), "data_folder": str(DATA_DIR), "html_file": str(html_file), "png_files": png_files }, "parameters": { "radius_core": as_float(r_core), "radius_axis": as_float(r_axis), "radius_diag": as_float(r_diag), "circle_resolution": int(len(t)), "camera_scale": as_float(CAM_SCALE), "color_core": COLOR_CORE, "color_x2": COLOR_X2, "color_x4": COLOR_X4, "line_width": int(LINE_WIDTH) }, "all_points": { point_labels[i]: as_list(all_points[i]) for i in range(len(all_points)) }, "relations_K_n": edges } json_file = DATA_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "_datasheet.json") md_file = DATA_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "_datasheet.md") csv_file = DATA_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "_points.csv") edges_csv_file = DATA_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "_relations.csv") with open(json_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(data_sheet, f, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False) with open(csv_file, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f: writer = csv.writer(f) writer.writerow(["point", "x", "y", "z"]) for label, point in zip(point_labels, all_points): writer.writerow([label, *as_list(point)]) with open(edges_csv_file, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f: writer = csv.writer(f) writer.writerow(["from", "to", "distance"]) for edge in edges: writer.writerow([edge["from"], edge["to"], edge["distance"]]) webbrowser.open("file://" + str(html_file.resolve())) print("") print("EXPORT KLAR") print("HTML:", html_file) print("") for item in png_files: print("PNG:", item) print("") print("DATA:", json_file) print("DATA:", csv_file) print("DATA:", edges_csv_file) ⚖️ — License & CopyrightLicensed under item.title: C. STRUCTURE. (H-D-R) x2. PYTHON
item.description: import csv import json import subprocess import sys import webbrowser from pathlib import Path import numpy as np import plotly.graph_objects as go SCRIPT_VERSION = "2.0.1" try: SCRIPT_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve() except NameError: SCRIPT_PATH = Path.cwd() / "(H-D-R)_x2_IN-PTS-Net.py" ROOT_DIR = SCRIPT_PATH.parent FILE_NAME = SCRIPT_PATH.stem # ============================================================ # GLOBAL RENDER FLAGS # ============================================================ SHOW_CENTERS = True SHOW_RELATIONS = True SHOW_INTERSECTIONS = True RENDER_DIR = ROOT_DIR / "PNG & HTML" DATA_DIR = ROOT_DIR / "CODE_data_output" RENDER_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) DATA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) def ensure_kaleido(): try: import kaleido return True except Exception: subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "kaleido"]) return True def as_float(value): return float(value) def as_list(point): return [float(v) for v in point] def distance_3d(p1, p2): return float(np.linalg.norm(p2 - p1)) def circle_intersections(c1, r1, c2, r2): x1, y1 = c1 x2, y2 = c2 dx = x2 - x1 dy = y2 - y1 d = np.hypot(dx, dy) if d > r1 + r2 or d < abs(r1 - r2) or d == 0: return [] a = (r1**2 - r2**2 + d**2) / (2 * d) h = np.sqrt(r1**2 - a**2) xm = x1 + a * dx / d ym = y1 + a * dy / d rx = -dy * (h / d) ry = dx * (h / d) p1 = np.array([xm + rx, ym + ry]) p2 = np.array([xm - rx, ym - ry]) return [p1, p2] def create_vesica_circles(r, n=200): t = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, n) x1 = r * np.cos(t) - r / 2 y1 = r * np.sin(t) x2 = r * np.cos(t) + r / 2 y2 = r * np.sin(t) return (x1, y1), (x2, y2) def rotate_3d(x, y, z, ax, ay, az): rad_x = np.deg2rad(ax) rad_y = np.deg2rad(ay) rad_z = np.deg2rad(az) if ax != 0: y, z = ( y * np.cos(rad_x) - z * np.sin(rad_x), y * np.sin(rad_x) + z * np.cos(rad_x) ) if ay != 0: x, z = ( x * np.cos(rad_y) + z * np.sin(rad_y), -x * np.sin(rad_y) + z * np.cos(rad_y) ) if az != 0: x, y = ( x * np.cos(rad_z) - y * np.sin(rad_z), x * np.sin(rad_z) + y * np.cos(rad_z) ) return x, y, z def rotate_point(point, ax, ay, az): x, y, z = point rx, ry, rz = rotate_3d(x, y, z, ax, ay, az) return np.array([rx, ry, rz]) def vesica_points(r): c1 = np.array([-r / 2, 0]) c2 = np.array([r / 2, 0]) intersections_2d = circle_intersections(c1, r, c2, r) centers = [ np.array([c1[0], c1[1], 0.0]), np.array([c2[0], c2[1], 0.0]) ] intersections = [ np.array([p[0], p[1], 0.0]) for p in intersections_2d ] return centers, intersections r_core = 6.0 r_axis = 3.0 t = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 200) COLOR_CORE = "#4da6ff" COLOR_X2 = "#ff4d4d" LINE_WIDTH = 3 VESICA_LAYERS = [ { "id": "X1_CORE", "radius": r_core, "color": COLOR_CORE, "rotation": (0, 0, 0) }, { "id": "X2_ROT_X", "radius": r_axis, "color": COLOR_X2, "rotation": (90, 0, 0) }, { "id": "X2_ROT_Y", "radius": r_axis, "color": COLOR_X2, "rotation": (0, 90, 0) } ] def add_vesica_to_traces(traces, nodes, labels, r, color, opacity, width, rotation, layer_id): (c1_x, c1_y), (c2_x, c2_y) = create_vesica_circles(r) for cx, cy in [(c1_x, c1_y), (c2_x, c2_y)]: z = np.zeros_like(cx) rx, ry, rz = rotate_3d(cx, cy, z, *rotation) traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=rx, y=ry, z=rz, mode="lines", line=dict(color=color, width=width), opacity=opacity, showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none" ) ) centers, intersections = vesica_points(r) centers_rot = [ rotate_point(p, *rotation) for p in centers ] intersections_rot = [ rotate_point(p, *rotation) for p in intersections ] points = centers_rot + intersections_rot point_names = [ layer_id + "_C1", layer_id + "_C2", layer_id + "_I_TOP", layer_id + "_I_BOTTOM" ] for point_name, point in zip(point_names, points): labels.append(point_name) nodes.append(point) if SHOW_CENTERS: traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=[p[0] for p in centers_rot], y=[p[1] for p in centers_rot], z=[p[2] for p in centers_rot], mode="markers", marker=dict(size=8, color="gray"), name=layer_id + "_CENTERS", showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none" ) ) if SHOW_INTERSECTIONS: traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=[p[0] for p in intersections_rot], y=[p[1] for p in intersections_rot], z=[p[2] for p in intersections_rot], mode="markers", marker=dict(size=10, color="white"), name=layer_id + "_INTERSECTIONS", showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none" ) ) def build_nodes_and_edges(): nodes = [] labels = [] for layer in VESICA_LAYERS: layer_nodes = [] layer_labels = [] add_vesica_to_traces( [], layer_nodes, layer_labels, r=layer["radius"], color=layer["color"], opacity=1.0, width=LINE_WIDTH, rotation=layer["rotation"], layer_id=layer["id"] ) nodes.extend(layer_nodes) labels.extend(layer_labels) edges = [] for i in range(len(nodes)): for j in range(i + 1, len(nodes)): edges.append({ "from": labels[i], "to": labels[j], "distance": distance_3d(nodes[i], nodes[j]) }) return nodes, labels, edges all_points, point_labels, edges = build_nodes_and_edges() def build_figure(title_text): all_traces = [] nodes = [] labels = [] for layer in VESICA_LAYERS: add_vesica_to_traces( all_traces, nodes, labels, r=layer["radius"], color=layer["color"], opacity=1.0, width=LINE_WIDTH, rotation=layer["rotation"], layer_id=layer["id"] ) if SHOW_RELATIONS: for i in range(len(nodes)): for j in range(i + 1, len(nodes)): p1 = nodes[i] p2 = nodes[j] all_traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=[p1[0], p2[0]], y=[p1[1], p2[1]], z=[p1[2], p2[2]], mode="lines", line=dict(width=1, color="white"), showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none" ) ) fig = go.Figure(data=all_traces) fig.update_layout( title=title_text, template="plotly_dark", width=1100, height=650, paper_bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)", plot_bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)", margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=60, b=0), scene=dict( aspectmode="data", xaxis=dict(visible=False), yaxis=dict(visible=False), zaxis=dict(visible=False), bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)" ) ) return fig all_traces = [] nodes = [] labels = [] for layer in VESICA_LAYERS: add_vesica_to_traces( all_traces, nodes, labels, r=layer["radius"], color=layer["color"], opacity=1.0, width=LINE_WIDTH, rotation=layer["rotation"], layer_id=layer["id"] ) for i in range(len(nodes)): for j in range(i + 1, len(nodes)): p1 = nodes[i] p2 = nodes[j] all_traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=[p1[0], p2[0]], y=[p1[1], p2[1]], z=[p1[2], p2[2]], mode="lines", line=dict(width=1, color="white"), showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none" ) ) fig = go.Figure(data=all_traces) fig.update_layout( title=title_text, template="plotly_dark", width=1100, height=650, paper_bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)", plot_bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)", margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=60, b=0), scene=dict( aspectmode="data", xaxis=dict(visible=False), yaxis=dict(visible=False), zaxis=dict(visible=False), bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)" ) ) return fig CAM_SCALE = 1.5 VIEWS = { "V-A": { "description": "Topvy: full Vesica-form synlig.", "camera": dict( eye=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=2.0 * CAM_SCALE), up=dict(x=0.0, y=1.0, z=0.0), center=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=0.0) ) }, "V-B": { "description": "Sidovy X: intersektionerna blir ytterpunkter, centrum kollapsar mot mitten.", "camera": dict( eye=dict(x=2.0 * CAM_SCALE, y=0.0, z=0.0), up=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=1.0), center=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=0.0) ) }, "V-C": { "description": "Sidovy Y: centrum blir ytterpunkter, intersektionerna kollapsar mot mitten.", "camera": dict( eye=dict(x=0.0, y=2.0 * CAM_SCALE, z=0.0), up=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=1.0), center=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=0.0) ) }, "V-D": { "description": "Diagonal/iso-vy: full relation synlig i sned projektion.", "camera": dict( eye=dict(x=1.5 * CAM_SCALE, y=1.5 * CAM_SCALE, z=1.0 * CAM_SCALE), up=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=1.0), center=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=0.0) ) } } fig_main = build_figure(FILE_NAME) html_file = RENDER_DIR / (FILE_NAME + ".html") fig_main.write_html(str(html_file)) ensure_kaleido() png_files = [] for view_name, view_data in VIEWS.items(): fig_view = build_figure(FILE_NAME + " - " + view_name) fig_view.update_layout(scene_camera=view_data["camera"]) png_file = RENDER_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "__" + view_name + ".png") fig_view.write_image(str(png_file), width=1100, height=650, scale=2) png_files.append(str(png_file)) data_sheet = { "script": { "file_name": FILE_NAME, "script_path": str(SCRIPT_PATH), "version": SCRIPT_VERSION }, "output": { "render_folder": str(RENDER_DIR), "data_folder": str(DATA_DIR), "html_file": str(html_file), "png_files": png_files }, "parameters": { "radius_core": as_float(r_core), "radius_axis": as_float(r_axis), "circle_resolution": int(len(t)), "camera_scale": as_float(CAM_SCALE), "color_core": COLOR_CORE, "color_x2": COLOR_X2, "line_width": int(LINE_WIDTH), "layers": [ { "id": layer["id"], "radius": as_float(layer["radius"]), "color": layer["color"], "rotation": list(layer["rotation"]) } for layer in VESICA_LAYERS ] }, "all_points": { point_labels[i]: as_list(all_points[i]) for i in range(len(all_points)) }, "relations_K_n": edges, "views": { key: { "description": value["description"], "camera": value["camera"] } for key, value in VIEWS.items() } } json_file = DATA_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "_datasheet.json") md_file = DATA_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "_datasheet.md") csv_file = DATA_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "_points.csv") edges_csv_file = DATA_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "_relations.csv") with open(json_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(data_sheet, f, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False) md_lines = [] md_lines.append("# " + FILE_NAME + " datasheet") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("## Script") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("- File name: `" + FILE_NAME + "`") md_lines.append("- Version: `" + SCRIPT_VERSION + "`") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("## Output") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("- HTML: `" + str(html_file) + "`") md_lines.append("- Render folder: `" + str(RENDER_DIR) + "`") md_lines.append("- Data folder: `" + str(DATA_DIR) + "`") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("## Parameters") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("- Radius core: `" + str(as_float(r_core)) + "`") md_lines.append("- Radius axis: `" + str(as_float(r_axis)) + "`") md_lines.append("- Circle resolution: `" + str(len(t)) + "`") md_lines.append("- Camera scale: `" + str(as_float(CAM_SCALE)) + "`") md_lines.append("- Color core: `" + COLOR_CORE + "`") md_lines.append("- Color x2: `" + COLOR_X2 + "`") md_lines.append("- Line width: `" + str(LINE_WIDTH) + "`") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("## Layers") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("| Layer | Radius | Color | Rotation |") md_lines.append("|---|---:|---|---|") for layer in VESICA_LAYERS: md_lines.append( "| " + layer["id"] + " | " + str(as_float(layer["radius"])) + " | " + layer["color"] + " | " + str(list(layer["rotation"])) + " |" ) md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("## Points") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("| Point | X | Y | Z |") md_lines.append("|---|---:|---:|---:|") for label, point in zip(point_labels, all_points): md_lines.append( "| " + label + " | " + str(as_float(point[0])) + " | " + str(as_float(point[1])) + " | " + str(as_float(point[2])) + " |" ) md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("## Relations") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("| From | To | Distance |") md_lines.append("|---|---|---:|") for edge in edges: md_lines.append( "| " + edge["from"] + " | " + edge["to"] + " | " + str(edge["distance"]) + " |" ) md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("## Views") md_lines.append("") for key, value in VIEWS.items(): md_lines.append("### " + key) md_lines.append("") md_lines.append(value["description"]) md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("- PNG: `" + str(RENDER_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "__" + key + ".png")) + "`") md_lines.append("- Camera: `" + json.dumps(value["camera"], ensure_ascii=False) + "`") md_lines.append("") with open(md_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write("\n".join(md_lines)) with open(csv_file, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f: writer = csv.writer(f) writer.writerow(["point", "x", "y", "z"]) for label, point in zip(point_labels, all_points): writer.writerow([label, as_float(point[0]), as_float(point[1]), as_float(point[2])]) with open(edges_csv_file, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f: writer = csv.writer(f) writer.writerow(["from", "to", "distance"]) for edge in edges: writer.writerow([edge["from"], edge["to"], edge["distance"]]) webbrowser.open("file://" + str(html_file.resolve())) print("") print("EXPORT KLAR") print("HTML:", html_file) print("") for item in png_files: print("PNG:", item) print("") print("DATA:", json_file) print("DATA:", md_file) print("DATA:", csv_file) print("DATA:", edges_csv_file) ⚖️ — License & CopyrightLicensed under RP9-LA-2026Copyright © 2026 Anton WallinSee LICENSE for full terms.

item.title: B. NODES. (H-D-R) x2. PYTHON
item.description: import csv import json import subprocess import sys import webbrowser from pathlib import Path import numpy as np import plotly.graph_objects as go SCRIPT_VERSION = "2.0.1" try: SCRIPT_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve() except NameError: SCRIPT_PATH = Path.cwd() / "(H-D-R)_x2_IN-PTS-Net.py" ROOT_DIR = SCRIPT_PATH.parent FILE_NAME = SCRIPT_PATH.stem # ============================================================ # GLOBAL RENDER FLAGS # ============================================================ SHOW_CENTERS = True SHOW_RELATIONS = False SHOW_INTERSECTIONS = False RENDER_DIR = ROOT_DIR / "PNG & HTML" DATA_DIR = ROOT_DIR / "CODE_data_output" RENDER_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) DATA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) def ensure_kaleido(): try: import kaleido return True except Exception: subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "kaleido"]) return True def as_float(value): return float(value) def as_list(point): return [float(v) for v in point] def distance_3d(p1, p2): return float(np.linalg.norm(p2 - p1)) def circle_intersections(c1, r1, c2, r2): x1, y1 = c1 x2, y2 = c2 dx = x2 - x1 dy = y2 - y1 d = np.hypot(dx, dy) if d > r1 + r2 or d < abs(r1 - r2) or d == 0: return [] a = (r1**2 - r2**2 + d**2) / (2 * d) h = np.sqrt(r1**2 - a**2) xm = x1 + a * dx / d ym = y1 + a * dy / d rx = -dy * (h / d) ry = dx * (h / d) p1 = np.array([xm + rx, ym + ry]) p2 = np.array([xm - rx, ym - ry]) return [p1, p2] def create_vesica_circles(r, n=200): t = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, n) x1 = r * np.cos(t) - r / 2 y1 = r * np.sin(t) x2 = r * np.cos(t) + r / 2 y2 = r * np.sin(t) return (x1, y1), (x2, y2) def rotate_3d(x, y, z, ax, ay, az): rad_x = np.deg2rad(ax) rad_y = np.deg2rad(ay) rad_z = np.deg2rad(az) if ax != 0: y, z = ( y * np.cos(rad_x) - z * np.sin(rad_x), y * np.sin(rad_x) + z * np.cos(rad_x) ) if ay != 0: x, z = ( x * np.cos(rad_y) + z * np.sin(rad_y), -x * np.sin(rad_y) + z * np.cos(rad_y) ) if az != 0: x, y = ( x * np.cos(rad_z) - y * np.sin(rad_z), x * np.sin(rad_z) + y * np.cos(rad_z) ) return x, y, z def rotate_point(point, ax, ay, az): x, y, z = point rx, ry, rz = rotate_3d(x, y, z, ax, ay, az) return np.array([rx, ry, rz]) def vesica_points(r): c1 = np.array([-r / 2, 0]) c2 = np.array([r / 2, 0]) intersections_2d = circle_intersections(c1, r, c2, r) centers = [ np.array([c1[0], c1[1], 0.0]), np.array([c2[0], c2[1], 0.0]) ] intersections = [ np.array([p[0], p[1], 0.0]) for p in intersections_2d ] return centers, intersections r_core = 6.0 r_axis = 3.0 t = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 200) COLOR_CORE = "#4da6ff" COLOR_X2 = "#ff4d4d" LINE_WIDTH = 3 VESICA_LAYERS = [ { "id": "X1_CORE", "radius": r_core, "color": COLOR_CORE, "rotation": (0, 0, 0) }, { "id": "X2_ROT_X", "radius": r_axis, "color": COLOR_X2, "rotation": (90, 0, 0) }, { "id": "X2_ROT_Y", "radius": r_axis, "color": COLOR_X2, "rotation": (0, 90, 0) } ] def add_vesica_to_traces(traces, nodes, labels, r, color, opacity, width, rotation, layer_id): (c1_x, c1_y), (c2_x, c2_y) = create_vesica_circles(r) for cx, cy in [(c1_x, c1_y), (c2_x, c2_y)]: z = np.zeros_like(cx) rx, ry, rz = rotate_3d(cx, cy, z, *rotation) traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=rx, y=ry, z=rz, mode="lines", line=dict(color=color, width=width), opacity=opacity, showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none" ) ) centers, intersections = vesica_points(r) centers_rot = [ rotate_point(p, *rotation) for p in centers ] intersections_rot = [ rotate_point(p, *rotation) for p in intersections ] points = centers_rot + intersections_rot point_names = [ layer_id + "_C1", layer_id + "_C2", layer_id + "_I_TOP", layer_id + "_I_BOTTOM" ] for point_name, point in zip(point_names, points): labels.append(point_name) nodes.append(point) if SHOW_CENTERS: traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=[p[0] for p in centers_rot], y=[p[1] for p in centers_rot], z=[p[2] for p in centers_rot], mode="markers", marker=dict(size=8, color="gray"), name=layer_id + "_CENTERS", showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none" ) ) if SHOW_INTERSECTIONS: traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=[p[0] for p in intersections_rot], y=[p[1] for p in intersections_rot], z=[p[2] for p in intersections_rot], mode="markers", marker=dict(size=10, color="white"), name=layer_id + "_INTERSECTIONS", showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none" ) ) def build_nodes_and_edges(): nodes = [] labels = [] for layer in VESICA_LAYERS: layer_nodes = [] layer_labels = [] add_vesica_to_traces( [], layer_nodes, layer_labels, r=layer["radius"], color=layer["color"], opacity=1.0, width=LINE_WIDTH, rotation=layer["rotation"], layer_id=layer["id"] ) nodes.extend(layer_nodes) labels.extend(layer_labels) edges = [] for i in range(len(nodes)): for j in range(i + 1, len(nodes)): edges.append({ "from": labels[i], "to": labels[j], "distance": distance_3d(nodes[i], nodes[j]) }) return nodes, labels, edges all_points, point_labels, edges = build_nodes_and_edges() def build_figure(title_text): all_traces = [] nodes = [] labels = [] for layer in VESICA_LAYERS: add_vesica_to_traces( all_traces, nodes, labels, r=layer["radius"], color=layer["color"], opacity=1.0, width=LINE_WIDTH, rotation=layer["rotation"], layer_id=layer["id"] ) if SHOW_RELATIONS: for i in range(len(nodes)): for j in range(i + 1, len(nodes)): p1 = nodes[i] p2 = nodes[j] all_traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=[p1[0], p2[0]], y=[p1[1], p2[1]], z=[p1[2], p2[2]], mode="lines", line=dict(width=1, color="white"), showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none" ) ) fig = go.Figure(data=all_traces) fig.update_layout( title=title_text, template="plotly_dark", width=1100, height=650, paper_bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)", plot_bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)", margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=60, b=0), scene=dict( aspectmode="data", xaxis=dict(visible=False), yaxis=dict(visible=False), zaxis=dict(visible=False), bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)" ) ) return fig all_traces = [] nodes = [] labels = [] for layer in VESICA_LAYERS: add_vesica_to_traces( all_traces, nodes, labels, r=layer["radius"], color=layer["color"], opacity=1.0, width=LINE_WIDTH, rotation=layer["rotation"], layer_id=layer["id"] ) for i in range(len(nodes)): for j in range(i + 1, len(nodes)): p1 = nodes[i] p2 = nodes[j] all_traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=[p1[0], p2[0]], y=[p1[1], p2[1]], z=[p1[2], p2[2]], mode="lines", line=dict(width=1, color="white"), showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none" ) ) fig = go.Figure(data=all_traces) fig.update_layout( title=title_text, template="plotly_dark", width=1100, height=650, paper_bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)", plot_bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)", margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=60, b=0), scene=dict( aspectmode="data", xaxis=dict(visible=False), yaxis=dict(visible=False), zaxis=dict(visible=False), bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)" ) ) return fig CAM_SCALE = 1.5 VIEWS = { "V-A": { "description": "Topvy: full Vesica-form synlig.", "camera": dict( eye=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=2.0 * CAM_SCALE), up=dict(x=0.0, y=1.0, z=0.0), center=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=0.0) ) }, "V-B": { "description": "Sidovy X: intersektionerna blir ytterpunkter, centrum kollapsar mot mitten.", "camera": dict( eye=dict(x=2.0 * CAM_SCALE, y=0.0, z=0.0), up=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=1.0), center=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=0.0) ) }, "V-C": { "description": "Sidovy Y: centrum blir ytterpunkter, intersektionerna kollapsar mot mitten.", "camera": dict( eye=dict(x=0.0, y=2.0 * CAM_SCALE, z=0.0), up=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=1.0), center=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=0.0) ) }, "V-D": { "description": "Diagonal/iso-vy: full relation synlig i sned projektion.", "camera": dict( eye=dict(x=1.5 * CAM_SCALE, y=1.5 * CAM_SCALE, z=1.0 * CAM_SCALE), up=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=1.0), center=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=0.0) ) } } fig_main = build_figure(FILE_NAME) html_file = RENDER_DIR / (FILE_NAME + ".html") fig_main.write_html(str(html_file)) ensure_kaleido() png_files = [] for view_name, view_data in VIEWS.items(): fig_view = build_figure(FILE_NAME + " - " + view_name) fig_view.update_layout(scene_camera=view_data["camera"]) png_file = RENDER_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "__" + view_name + ".png") fig_view.write_image(str(png_file), width=1100, height=650, scale=2) png_files.append(str(png_file)) data_sheet = { "script": { "file_name": FILE_NAME, "script_path": str(SCRIPT_PATH), "version": SCRIPT_VERSION }, "output": { "render_folder": str(RENDER_DIR), "data_folder": str(DATA_DIR), "html_file": str(html_file), "png_files": png_files }, "parameters": { "radius_core": as_float(r_core), "radius_axis": as_float(r_axis), "circle_resolution": int(len(t)), "camera_scale": as_float(CAM_SCALE), "color_core": COLOR_CORE, "color_x2": COLOR_X2, "line_width": int(LINE_WIDTH), "layers": [ { "id": layer["id"], "radius": as_float(layer["radius"]), "color": layer["color"], "rotation": list(layer["rotation"]) } for layer in VESICA_LAYERS ] }, "all_points": { point_labels[i]: as_list(all_points[i]) for i in range(len(all_points)) }, "relations_K_n": edges, "views": { key: { "description": value["description"], "camera": value["camera"] } for key, value in VIEWS.items() } } json_file = DATA_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "_datasheet.json") md_file = DATA_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "_datasheet.md") csv_file = DATA_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "_points.csv") edges_csv_file = DATA_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "_relations.csv") with open(json_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(data_sheet, f, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False) md_lines = [] md_lines.append("# " + FILE_NAME + " datasheet") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("## Script") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("- File name: `" + FILE_NAME + "`") md_lines.append("- Version: `" + SCRIPT_VERSION + "`") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("## Output") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("- HTML: `" + str(html_file) + "`") md_lines.append("- Render folder: `" + str(RENDER_DIR) + "`") md_lines.append("- Data folder: `" + str(DATA_DIR) + "`") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("## Parameters") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("- Radius core: `" + str(as_float(r_core)) + "`") md_lines.append("- Radius axis: `" + str(as_float(r_axis)) + "`") md_lines.append("- Circle resolution: `" + str(len(t)) + "`") md_lines.append("- Camera scale: `" + str(as_float(CAM_SCALE)) + "`") md_lines.append("- Color core: `" + COLOR_CORE + "`") md_lines.append("- Color x2: `" + COLOR_X2 + "`") md_lines.append("- Line width: `" + str(LINE_WIDTH) + "`") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("## Layers") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("| Layer | Radius | Color | Rotation |") md_lines.append("|---|---:|---|---|") for layer in VESICA_LAYERS: md_lines.append( "| " + layer["id"] + " | " + str(as_float(layer["radius"])) + " | " + layer["color"] + " | " + str(list(layer["rotation"])) + " |" ) md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("## Points") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("| Point | X | Y | Z |") md_lines.append("|---|---:|---:|---:|") for label, point in zip(point_labels, all_points): md_lines.append( "| " + label + " | " + str(as_float(point[0])) + " | " + str(as_float(point[1])) + " | " + str(as_float(point[2])) + " |" ) md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("## Relations") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("| From | To | Distance |") md_lines.append("|---|---|---:|") for edge in edges: md_lines.append( "| " + edge["from"] + " | " + edge["to"] + " | " + str(edge["distance"]) + " |" ) md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("## Views") md_lines.append("") for key, value in VIEWS.items(): md_lines.append("### " + key) md_lines.append("") md_lines.append(value["description"]) md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("- PNG: `" + str(RENDER_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "__" + key + ".png")) + "`") md_lines.append("- Camera: `" + json.dumps(value["camera"], ensure_ascii=False) + "`") md_lines.append("") with open(md_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write("\n".join(md_lines)) with open(csv_file, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f: writer = csv.writer(f) writer.writerow(["point", "x", "y", "z"]) for label, point in zip(point_labels, all_points): writer.writerow([label, as_float(point[0]), as_float(point[1]), as_float(point[2])]) with open(edges_csv_file, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f: writer = csv.writer(f) writer.writerow(["from", "to", "distance"]) for edge in edges: writer.writerow([edge["from"], edge["to"], edge["distance"]]) webbrowser.open("file://" + str(html_file.resolve())) print("") print("EXPORT KLAR") print("HTML:", html_file) print("") for item in png_files: print("PNG:", item) print("") print("DATA:", json_file) print("DATA:", md_file) print("DATA:", csv_file) print("DATA:", edges_csv_file) ⚖️ — License & CopyrightLicensed under RP9-LA-2026Copyright © 2026 Anton WallinSee LICENSE for full terms.

item.title: A. FORM. (H-D-R) x2. PYTHON
item.description: import csv import json import subprocess import sys import webbrowser from pathlib import Path import numpy as np import plotly.graph_objects as go SCRIPT_VERSION = "2.0.1" try: SCRIPT_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve() except NameError: SCRIPT_PATH = Path.cwd() / "(H-D-R)_x2_IN-PTS-Net.py" ROOT_DIR = SCRIPT_PATH.parent FILE_NAME = SCRIPT_PATH.stem # ============================================================ # GLOBAL RENDER FLAGS # ============================================================ SHOW_CENTERS = False SHOW_RELATIONS = False SHOW_INTERSECTIONS = False RENDER_DIR = ROOT_DIR / "PNG & HTML" DATA_DIR = ROOT_DIR / "CODE_data_output" RENDER_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) DATA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) def ensure_kaleido(): try: import kaleido return True except Exception: subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "kaleido"]) return True def as_float(value): return float(value) def as_list(point): return [float(v) for v in point] def distance_3d(p1, p2): return float(np.linalg.norm(p2 - p1)) def circle_intersections(c1, r1, c2, r2): x1, y1 = c1 x2, y2 = c2 dx = x2 - x1 dy = y2 - y1 d = np.hypot(dx, dy) if d > r1 + r2 or d < abs(r1 - r2) or d == 0: return [] a = (r1**2 - r2**2 + d**2) / (2 * d) h = np.sqrt(r1**2 - a**2) xm = x1 + a * dx / d ym = y1 + a * dy / d rx = -dy * (h / d) ry = dx * (h / d) p1 = np.array([xm + rx, ym + ry]) p2 = np.array([xm - rx, ym - ry]) return [p1, p2] def create_vesica_circles(r, n=200): t = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, n) x1 = r * np.cos(t) - r / 2 y1 = r * np.sin(t) x2 = r * np.cos(t) + r / 2 y2 = r * np.sin(t) return (x1, y1), (x2, y2) def rotate_3d(x, y, z, ax, ay, az): rad_x = np.deg2rad(ax) rad_y = np.deg2rad(ay) rad_z = np.deg2rad(az) if ax != 0: y, z = ( y * np.cos(rad_x) - z * np.sin(rad_x), y * np.sin(rad_x) + z * np.cos(rad_x) ) if ay != 0: x, z = ( x * np.cos(rad_y) + z * np.sin(rad_y), -x * np.sin(rad_y) + z * np.cos(rad_y) ) if az != 0: x, y = ( x * np.cos(rad_z) - y * np.sin(rad_z), x * np.sin(rad_z) + y * np.cos(rad_z) ) return x, y, z def rotate_point(point, ax, ay, az): x, y, z = point rx, ry, rz = rotate_3d(x, y, z, ax, ay, az) return np.array([rx, ry, rz]) def vesica_points(r): c1 = np.array([-r / 2, 0]) c2 = np.array([r / 2, 0]) intersections_2d = circle_intersections(c1, r, c2, r) centers = [ np.array([c1[0], c1[1], 0.0]), np.array([c2[0], c2[1], 0.0]) ] intersections = [ np.array([p[0], p[1], 0.0]) for p in intersections_2d ] return centers, intersections r_core = 6.0 r_axis = 3.0 t = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 200) COLOR_CORE = "#4da6ff" COLOR_X2 = "#ff4d4d" LINE_WIDTH = 3 VESICA_LAYERS = [ { "id": "X1_CORE", "radius": r_core, "color": COLOR_CORE, "rotation": (0, 0, 0) }, { "id": "X2_ROT_X", "radius": r_axis, "color": COLOR_X2, "rotation": (90, 0, 0) }, { "id": "X2_ROT_Y", "radius": r_axis, "color": COLOR_X2, "rotation": (0, 90, 0) } ] def add_vesica_to_traces(traces, nodes, labels, r, color, opacity, width, rotation, layer_id): (c1_x, c1_y), (c2_x, c2_y) = create_vesica_circles(r) for cx, cy in [(c1_x, c1_y), (c2_x, c2_y)]: z = np.zeros_like(cx) rx, ry, rz = rotate_3d(cx, cy, z, *rotation) traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=rx, y=ry, z=rz, mode="lines", line=dict(color=color, width=width), opacity=opacity, showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none" ) ) centers, intersections = vesica_points(r) centers_rot = [ rotate_point(p, *rotation) for p in centers ] intersections_rot = [ rotate_point(p, *rotation) for p in intersections ] points = centers_rot + intersections_rot point_names = [ layer_id + "_C1", layer_id + "_C2", layer_id + "_I_TOP", layer_id + "_I_BOTTOM" ] for point_name, point in zip(point_names, points): labels.append(point_name) nodes.append(point) if SHOW_CENTERS: traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=[p[0] for p in centers_rot], y=[p[1] for p in centers_rot], z=[p[2] for p in centers_rot], mode="markers", marker=dict(size=8, color="gray"), name=layer_id + "_CENTERS", showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none" ) ) if SHOW_INTERSECTIONS: traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=[p[0] for p in intersections_rot], y=[p[1] for p in intersections_rot], z=[p[2] for p in intersections_rot], mode="markers", marker=dict(size=10, color="white"), name=layer_id + "_INTERSECTIONS", showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none" ) ) def build_nodes_and_edges(): nodes = [] labels = [] for layer in VESICA_LAYERS: layer_nodes = [] layer_labels = [] add_vesica_to_traces( [], layer_nodes, layer_labels, r=layer["radius"], color=layer["color"], opacity=1.0, width=LINE_WIDTH, rotation=layer["rotation"], layer_id=layer["id"] ) nodes.extend(layer_nodes) labels.extend(layer_labels) edges = [] for i in range(len(nodes)): for j in range(i + 1, len(nodes)): edges.append({ "from": labels[i], "to": labels[j], "distance": distance_3d(nodes[i], nodes[j]) }) return nodes, labels, edges all_points, point_labels, edges = build_nodes_and_edges() def build_figure(title_text): all_traces = [] nodes = [] labels = [] for layer in VESICA_LAYERS: add_vesica_to_traces( all_traces, nodes, labels, r=layer["radius"], color=layer["color"], opacity=1.0, width=LINE_WIDTH, rotation=layer["rotation"], layer_id=layer["id"] ) if SHOW_RELATIONS: for i in range(len(nodes)): for j in range(i + 1, len(nodes)): p1 = nodes[i] p2 = nodes[j] all_traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=[p1[0], p2[0]], y=[p1[1], p2[1]], z=[p1[2], p2[2]], mode="lines", line=dict(width=1, color="white"), showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none" ) ) fig = go.Figure(data=all_traces) fig.update_layout( title=title_text, template="plotly_dark", width=1100, height=650, paper_bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)", plot_bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)", margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=60, b=0), scene=dict( aspectmode="data", xaxis=dict(visible=False), yaxis=dict(visible=False), zaxis=dict(visible=False), bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)" ) ) return fig all_traces = [] nodes = [] labels = [] for layer in VESICA_LAYERS: add_vesica_to_traces( all_traces, nodes, labels, r=layer["radius"], color=layer["color"], opacity=1.0, width=LINE_WIDTH, rotation=layer["rotation"], layer_id=layer["id"] ) for i in range(len(nodes)): for j in range(i + 1, len(nodes)): p1 = nodes[i] p2 = nodes[j] all_traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=[p1[0], p2[0]], y=[p1[1], p2[1]], z=[p1[2], p2[2]], mode="lines", line=dict(width=1, color="white"), showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none" ) ) fig = go.Figure(data=all_traces) fig.update_layout( title=title_text, template="plotly_dark", width=1100, height=650, paper_bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)", plot_bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)", margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=60, b=0), scene=dict( aspectmode="data", xaxis=dict(visible=False), yaxis=dict(visible=False), zaxis=dict(visible=False), bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)" ) ) return fig CAM_SCALE = 1.5 VIEWS = { "V-A": { "description": "Topvy: full Vesica-form synlig.", "camera": dict( eye=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=2.0 * CAM_SCALE), up=dict(x=0.0, y=1.0, z=0.0), center=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=0.0) ) }, "V-B": { "description": "Sidovy X: intersektionerna blir ytterpunkter, centrum kollapsar mot mitten.", "camera": dict( eye=dict(x=2.0 * CAM_SCALE, y=0.0, z=0.0), up=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=1.0), center=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=0.0) ) }, "V-C": { "description": "Sidovy Y: centrum blir ytterpunkter, intersektionerna kollapsar mot mitten.", "camera": dict( eye=dict(x=0.0, y=2.0 * CAM_SCALE, z=0.0), up=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=1.0), center=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=0.0) ) }, "V-D": { "description": "Diagonal/iso-vy: full relation synlig i sned projektion.", "camera": dict( eye=dict(x=1.5 * CAM_SCALE, y=1.5 * CAM_SCALE, z=1.0 * CAM_SCALE), up=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=1.0), center=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=0.0) ) } } fig_main = build_figure(FILE_NAME) html_file = RENDER_DIR / (FILE_NAME + ".html") fig_main.write_html(str(html_file)) ensure_kaleido() png_files = [] for view_name, view_data in VIEWS.items(): fig_view = build_figure(FILE_NAME + " - " + view_name) fig_view.update_layout(scene_camera=view_data["camera"]) png_file = RENDER_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "__" + view_name + ".png") fig_view.write_image(str(png_file), width=1100, height=650, scale=2) png_files.append(str(png_file)) data_sheet = { "script": { "file_name": FILE_NAME, "script_path": str(SCRIPT_PATH), "version": SCRIPT_VERSION }, "output": { "render_folder": str(RENDER_DIR), "data_folder": str(DATA_DIR), "html_file": str(html_file), "png_files": png_files }, "parameters": { "radius_core": as_float(r_core), "radius_axis": as_float(r_axis), "circle_resolution": int(len(t)), "camera_scale": as_float(CAM_SCALE), "color_core": COLOR_CORE, "color_x2": COLOR_X2, "line_width": int(LINE_WIDTH), "layers": [ { "id": layer["id"], "radius": as_float(layer["radius"]), "color": layer["color"], "rotation": list(layer["rotation"]) } for layer in VESICA_LAYERS ] }, "all_points": { point_labels[i]: as_list(all_points[i]) for i in range(len(all_points)) }, "relations_K_n": edges, "views": { key: { "description": value["description"], "camera": value["camera"] } for key, value in VIEWS.items() } } json_file = DATA_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "_datasheet.json") md_file = DATA_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "_datasheet.md") csv_file = DATA_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "_points.csv") edges_csv_file = DATA_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "_relations.csv") with open(json_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(data_sheet, f, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False) md_lines = [] md_lines.append("# " + FILE_NAME + " datasheet") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("## Script") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("- File name: `" + FILE_NAME + "`") md_lines.append("- Version: `" + SCRIPT_VERSION + "`") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("## Output") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("- HTML: `" + str(html_file) + "`") md_lines.append("- Render folder: `" + str(RENDER_DIR) + "`") md_lines.append("- Data folder: `" + str(DATA_DIR) + "`") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("## Parameters") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("- Radius core: `" + str(as_float(r_core)) + "`") md_lines.append("- Radius axis: `" + str(as_float(r_axis)) + "`") md_lines.append("- Circle resolution: `" + str(len(t)) + "`") md_lines.append("- Camera scale: `" + str(as_float(CAM_SCALE)) + "`") md_lines.append("- Color core: `" + COLOR_CORE + "`") md_lines.append("- Color x2: `" + COLOR_X2 + "`") md_lines.append("- Line width: `" + str(LINE_WIDTH) + "`") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("## Layers") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("| Layer | Radius | Color | Rotation |") md_lines.append("|---|---:|---|---|") for layer in VESICA_LAYERS: md_lines.append( "| " + layer["id"] + " | " + str(as_float(layer["radius"])) + " | " + layer["color"] + " | " + str(list(layer["rotation"])) + " |" ) md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("## Points") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("| Point | X | Y | Z |") md_lines.append("|---|---:|---:|---:|") for label, point in zip(point_labels, all_points): md_lines.append( "| " + label + " | " + str(as_float(point[0])) + " | " + str(as_float(point[1])) + " | " + str(as_float(point[2])) + " |" ) md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("## Relations") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("| From | To | Distance |") md_lines.append("|---|---|---:|") for edge in edges: md_lines.append( "| " + edge["from"] + " | " + edge["to"] + " | " + str(edge["distance"]) + " |" ) md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("## Views") md_lines.append("") for key, value in VIEWS.items(): md_lines.append("### " + key) md_lines.append("") md_lines.append(value["description"]) md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("- PNG: `" + str(RENDER_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "__" + key + ".png")) + "`") md_lines.append("- Camera: `" + json.dumps(value["camera"], ensure_ascii=False) + "`") md_lines.append("") with open(md_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write("\n".join(md_lines)) with open(csv_file, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f: writer = csv.writer(f) writer.writerow(["point", "x", "y", "z"]) for label, point in zip(point_labels, all_points): writer.writerow([label, as_float(point[0]), as_float(point[1]), as_float(point[2])]) with open(edges_csv_file, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f: writer = csv.writer(f) writer.writerow(["from", "to", "distance"]) for edge in edges: writer.writerow([edge["from"], edge["to"], edge["distance"]]) webbrowser.open("file://" + str(html_file.resolve())) print("") print("EXPORT KLAR") print("HTML:", html_file) print("") for item in png_files: print("PNG:", item) print("") print("DATA:", json_file) print("DATA:", md_file) print("DATA:", csv_file) print("DATA:", edges_csv_file) ⚖️ — License & CopyrightLicensed under RP9-LA-2026Copyright © 2026 Anton WallinSee LICENSE for full terms.

item.title: B. NODES. (H-D-R) x1. PYTHON
item.description: import csv import json import subprocess import sys import webbrowser from pathlib import Path import numpy as np import plotly.graph_objects as go # ============================================================ # VERSION # ============================================================ SCRIPT_VERSION = "2.0.1" # ============================================================ # FILNAMN = KODNAMN # ============================================================ try: SCRIPT_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve() except NameError: SCRIPT_PATH = Path.cwd() / "(H-D-R)_x1_IN-PTS.py" ROOT_DIR = SCRIPT_PATH.parent FILE_NAME = SCRIPT_PATH.stem RENDER_DIR = ROOT_DIR / "PNG & HTML" DATA_DIR = ROOT_DIR / "CODE_data_output" RENDER_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) DATA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) # ============================================================ # SAKERSTALL KALEIDO FOR PNG-EXPORT # ============================================================ def ensure_kaleido(): try: import kaleido return True except Exception: print("Kaleido saknas. Installerar kaleido...") subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "kaleido"]) return True # ============================================================ # HJALPFUNKTIONER # ============================================================ def as_float(value): return float(value) def as_list(point): return [float(v) for v in point] def distance_3d(p1, p2): return float(np.linalg.norm(p2 - p1)) # ============================================================ # EXAKT CIRKEL-CIRKEL INTERSEKTION # ============================================================ def circle_intersections(c1, r1, c2, r2): x1, y1 = c1 x2, y2 = c2 dx = x2 - x1 dy = y2 - y1 d = np.hypot(dx, dy) if d > r1 + r2 or d < abs(r1 - r2) or d == 0: return [] a = (r1**2 - r2**2 + d**2) / (2 * d) h = np.sqrt(r1**2 - a**2) xm = x1 + a * dx / d ym = y1 + a * dy / d rx = -dy * (h / d) ry = dx * (h / d) p1 = np.array([xm + rx, ym + ry]) p2 = np.array([xm - rx, ym - ry]) return [p1, p2] # ============================================================ # VESICA DATA # ============================================================ r = 6.0 c1 = np.array([-r / 2, 0]) c2 = np.array([r / 2, 0]) intersections_2d = circle_intersections(c1, r, c2, r) intersections = [ np.array([p[0], p[1], 0.0]) for p in intersections_2d ] centers = [ np.array([c1[0], c1[1], 0.0]), np.array([c2[0], c2[1], 0.0]) ] all_points = centers + intersections point_labels = [ "C1", "C2", "I_TOP", "I_BOTTOM" ] edges = [] for i in range(len(all_points)): for j in range(i + 1, len(all_points)): edges.append({ "from": point_labels[i], "to": point_labels[j], "distance": distance_3d(all_points[i], all_points[j]) }) # ============================================================ # CIRKLAR # ============================================================ t = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 200) x1 = r * np.cos(t) - r / 2 y1 = r * np.sin(t) z1 = np.zeros_like(x1) x2 = r * np.cos(t) + r / 2 y2 = r * np.sin(t) z2 = np.zeros_like(x2) # ============================================================ # FIGUR BYGG # ============================================================ def build_figure(title_text): fig = go.Figure() fig.add_trace(go.Scatter3d( x=x1, y=y1, z=z1, mode="lines", line=dict(color="blue"), name="trace 0" )) fig.add_trace(go.Scatter3d( x=x2, y=y2, z=z2, - r2) or d == 0: return [] a = (r1**2 - r2**2 + d**2) / (2 * d) h = np.sqrt(r1**2 - a**2) xm = x1 + a * dx / d ym = y1 + a * dy / d rx = -dy * (h / d) ry = dx * (h / d) p1 = np.array([xm + rx, ym + ry]) p2 = np.array([xm - rx, ym - ry]) return [p1, p2] r = 6.0 c1 = np.array([-r / 2, 0]) c2 = np.array([r / 2, 0]) intersections_2d = circle_intersections(c1, r, c2, r) intersections = [ item.title: A. FORM. (H-D-R) x1. PYTHON
item.description: import csv import json import subprocess import sys import webbrowser from pathlib import Path import numpy as np import plotly.graph_objects as go SCRIPT_VERSION = "2.0.1" try: SCRIPT_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve() except NameError: SCRIPT_PATH = Path.cwd() / "(H-D-R)_x1.py" ROOT_DIR = SCRIPT_PATH.parent FILE_NAME = SCRIPT_PATH.stem RENDER_DIR = ROOT_DIR / "PNG & HTML" DATA_DIR = ROOT_DIR / "CODE_data_output" RENDER_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) DATA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) def ensure_kaleido(): try: import kaleido return True except Exception: subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "kaleido"]) return True def as_float(value): return float(value) def as_list(point): return [float(v) for v in point] def distance_3d(p1, p2): return float(np.linalg.norm(p2 - p1)) def circle_intersections(c1, r1, c2, r2): x1, y1 = c1 x2, y2 = c2 dx = x2 - x1 dy = y2 - y1 d = np.hypot(dx, dy) if d > r1 + r2 or d < abs(r1 - r2) or d == 0: return [] a = (r1**2 - r2**2 + d**2) / (2 * d) h = np.sqrt(r1**2 - a**2) xm = x1 + a * dx / d ym = y1 + a * dy / d rx = -dy * (h / d) ry = dx * (h / d) p1 = np.array([xm + rx, ym + ry]) p2 = np.array([xm - rx, ym - ry]) return [p1, p2] def create_vesica_circles(r, n=200): t = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, n) x1 = r * np.cos(t) - r / 2 y1 = r * np.sin(t) x2 = r * np.cos(t) + r / 2 y2 = r * np.sin(t) return (x1, y1), (x2, y2) def rotate_3d(x, y, z, ax, ay, az): rad_x = np.deg2rad(ax) rad_y = np.deg2rad(ay) rad_z = np.deg2rad(az) if ax != 0: y, z = ( y * np.cos(rad_x) - z * np.sin(rad_x), y * np.sin(rad_x) + z * np.cos(rad_x) ) if ay != 0: x, z = ( x * np.cos(rad_y) + z * np.sin(rad_y), -x * np.sin(rad_y) + z * np.cos(rad_y) ) if az != 0: x, y = ( x * np.cos(rad_z) - y * np.sin(rad_z), x * np.sin(rad_z) + y * np.cos(rad_z) ) return x, y, z def add_vesica_to_traces(traces, r, color, opacity, width, rotation=(0, 0, 0)): (c1_x, c1_y), (c2_x, c2_y) = create_vesica_circles(r) for cx, cy in [(c1_x, c1_y), (c2_x, c2_y)]: z = np.zeros_like(cx) rx, ry, rz = rotate_3d(cx, cy, z, *rotation) traces.append( go.Scatter3d( x=rx, y=ry, z=rz, mode="lines", line=dict(color=color, width=width), opacity=opacity, showlegend=False, hoverinfo="none" ) ) r = 6.0 c1 = np.array([-r / 2, 0]) c2 = np.array([r / 2, 0]) intersections_2d = circle_intersections(c1, r, c2, r) intersections = [ np.array([p[0], p[1], 0.0]) for p in intersections_2d ] centers = [ np.array([c1[0], c1[1], 0.0]), np.array([c2[0], c2[1], 0.0]) ] all_points = centers + intersections point_labels = [ "C1", "C2", "I_TOP", "I_BOTTOM" ] edges = [] for i in range(len(all_points)): for j in range(i + 1, len(all_points)): edges.append({ "from": point_labels[i], "to": point_labels[j], "distance": distance_3d(all_points[i], all_points[j]) }) t = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 200) COLOR_CORE = "#4da6ff" LINE_WIDTH = 3 def build_figure(title_text): all_traces = [] add_vesica_to_traces( all_traces, r=r, color=COLOR_CORE, opacity=1.0, width=LINE_WIDTH, rotation=(0, 0, 0) ) fig = go.Figure(data=all_traces) fig.update_layout( title=title_text, template="plotly_dark", width=1100, height=650, paper_bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)", plot_bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)", margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=60, b=0), scene=dict( aspectmode="data", xaxis=dict(visible=False), yaxis=dict(visible=False), zaxis=dict(visible=False), bgcolor="rgb(17,17,17)" ) ) return fig CAM_SCALE = 1.5 VIEWS = { "V-A": { "description": "Topvy: full Vesica-form synlig.", "camera": dict( eye=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=2.0 * CAM_SCALE), up=dict(x=0.0, y=1.0, z=0.0), center=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=0.0) ) }, "V-B": { "description": "Sidovy X: intersektionerna blir ytterpunkter, centrum kollapsar mot mitten.", "camera": dict( eye=dict(x=2.0 * CAM_SCALE, y=0.0, z=0.0), up=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=1.0), center=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=0.0) ) }, "V-C": { "description": "Sidovy Y: centrum blir ytterpunkter, intersektionerna kollapsar mot mitten.", "camera": dict( eye=dict(x=0.0, y=2.0 * CAM_SCALE, z=0.0), up=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=1.0), center=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=0.0) ) }, "V-D": { "description": "Diagonal/iso-vy: full relation synlig i sned projektion.", "camera": dict( eye=dict(x=1.5 * CAM_SCALE, y=1.5 * CAM_SCALE, z=1.0 * CAM_SCALE), up=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=1.0), center=dict(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=0.0) ) } } fig_main = build_figure(FILE_NAME) html_file = RENDER_DIR / (FILE_NAME + ".html") fig_main.write_html(str(html_file)) ensure_kaleido() png_files = [] for view_name, view_data in VIEWS.items(): fig_view = build_figure(FILE_NAME + " - " + view_name) fig_view.update_layout(scene_camera=view_data["camera"]) png_file = RENDER_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "__" + view_name + ".png") fig_view.write_image(str(png_file), width=1100, height=650, scale=2) png_files.append(str(png_file)) data_sheet = { "script": { "file_name": FILE_NAME, "script_path": str(SCRIPT_PATH), "version": SCRIPT_VERSION }, "output": { "render_folder": str(RENDER_DIR), "data_folder": str(DATA_DIR), "html_file": str(html_file), "png_files": png_files }, "parameters": { "radius": as_float(r), "circle_resolution": int(len(t)), "camera_scale": as_float(CAM_SCALE), "color_core": COLOR_CORE, "line_width": int(LINE_WIDTH) }, "centers": { "C1": as_list(centers[0]), "C2": as_list(centers[1]), "center_distance": distance_3d(centers[0], centers[1]) }, "intersections": { "I_TOP": as_list(intersections[0]), "I_BOTTOM": as_list(intersections[1]), "intersection_distance": distance_3d(intersections[0], intersections[1]) }, "all_points": { point_labels[i]: as_list(all_points[i]) for i in range(len(all_points)) }, "relations_K_n": edges, "views": { key: { "description": value["description"], "camera": value["camera"] } for key, value in VIEWS.items() } } json_file = DATA_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "_datasheet.json") md_file = DATA_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "_datasheet.md") csv_file = DATA_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "_points.csv") edges_csv_file = DATA_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "_relations.csv") with open(json_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(data_sheet, f, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False) md_lines = [] md_lines.append("# " + FILE_NAME + " datasheet") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("## Script") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("- File name: `" + FILE_NAME + "`") md_lines.append("- Version: `" + SCRIPT_VERSION + "`") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("## Output") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("- HTML: `" + str(html_file) + "`") md_lines.append("- Render folder: `" + str(RENDER_DIR) + "`") md_lines.append("- Data folder: `" + str(DATA_DIR) + "`") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("## Parameters") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("- Radius: `" + str(as_float(r)) + "`") md_lines.append("- Circle resolution: `" + str(len(t)) + "`") md_lines.append("- Camera scale: `" + str(as_float(CAM_SCALE)) + "`") md_lines.append("- Color core: `" + COLOR_CORE + "`") md_lines.append("- Line width: `" + str(LINE_WIDTH) + "`") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("## Points") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("| Point | X | Y | Z |") md_lines.append("|---|---:|---:|---:|") for label, point in zip(point_labels, all_points): md_lines.append( "| " + label + " | " + str(as_float(point[0])) + " | " + str(as_float(point[1])) + " | " + str(as_float(point[2])) + " |" ) md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("## Relations") md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("| From | To | Distance |") md_lines.append("|---|---|---:|") for edge in edges: md_lines.append( "| " + edge["from"] + " | " + edge["to"] + " | " + str(edge["distance"]) + " |" ) md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("## Views") md_lines.append("") for key, value in VIEWS.items(): md_lines.append("### " + key) md_lines.append("") md_lines.append(value["description"]) md_lines.append("") md_lines.append("- PNG: `" + str(RENDER_DIR / (FILE_NAME + "__" + key + ".png")) + "`") md_lines.append("- Camera: `" + json.dumps(value["camera"], ensure_ascii=False) + "`") md_lines.append("") with open(md_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write("\n".join(md_lines)) with open(csv_file, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f: writer = csv.writer(f) writer.writerow(["point", "x", "y", "z"]) for label, point in zip(point_labels, all_points): writer.writerow([label, as_float(point[0]), as_float(point[1]), as_float(point[2])]) with open(edges_csv_file, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f: writer = csv.writer(f) writer.writerow(["from", "to", "distance"]) for edge in edges: writer.writerow([edge["from"], edge["to"], edge["distance"]]) webbrowser.open("file://" + str(html_file.resolve())) print("") print("EXPORT KLAR") print("HTML:", html_file) print("") for item in png_files: print("PNG:", item) print("") print("DATA:", json_file) print("DATA:", md_file) print("DATA:", csv_file) print("DATA:", edges_csv_file) ⚖️ — License & CopyrightLicensed under COORDINATE_SYSTEM_SELF_ORGANIZING_RELATIONAL_EMERGENCE_V6.py constitutes the sixth and final development step of the RP9 system coordinate chain.The code is responsible for verifying how an established coordinate field behaves when relationships, structures, and internal connections are allowed to evolve through a self-organizing process while preserving previously verified locks and stability conditions.The purpose is to investigate whether the coordinate structure can maintain stability, reproducibility, and continuity even under internal reorganization and dynamic change.This step serves as the final verification of the long-term stability of the coordinate chain.The code performs eight main tasks.Creates the initial field used for the self-organizing analysis.The purpose is to establish the relational conditions that later give rise to observable structures.Analyzes how relations arise and are organized within the established field.The focus is on emergence, connections, and internal structure.Examines how the coordinate field changes under loading, expansion, and internal reorganization.The purpose is to identify whether the structure remains stable under change.Analyzes how internal connections can be reshaped without losing the basic structure of the system.The focus is on: stability continuity reproducibility structural coherence Examines how the coordinate structure evolves through multiple levels and scales.The purpose is to verify that previously established relations remain consistent during continued development.Recreates and establishes the coordinates that arise from the self-organizing process.These are used as a basis for the final verification.Examines how the coordinate structure is affected by changing observation conditions.The purpose is to investigate whether the stability of the system persists even when observation patterns change.Compares the results with previous generations and verifies that the established coordinate structure has been preserved throughout the entire development chain.The code constitutes the final step in the complete verification chain.META_VESICA_CORE ↓ META_EQUILIBRIUM ↓ META_SEQUENTIAL_DERIVATION ↓ FUSION_RESIDUAL_ANALYSIS ↓ STEP_ISOLATION ↓ STEP_ISOLATION_EXTENDED ↓ COORDINATE_SYSTEM_LOCK ↓ COORDINATE_SYSTEM_LOCK_V2 ↓ COORDINATE_SYSTEM_PROPAGATION_V3 ↓ COORDINATE_SYSTEM_PROPAGATION_V4 ↓ OBSERVER_LOCKED_RELATIONAL_EMERGENCE_V5 ↓ SELF_ORGANIZING_RELATIONAL_EMERGENCE_V6 SELF_ORGANIZING_RELATIONAL_EMERGENCE_V6 serves as the final verification of the stability and continuity of the entire coordinate chain.The code verifies that: relations can be organized consistently the coordinate field remains stable under change topological reorganizations do not break the structure coordinates can be reproduced after evolution observer dynamics do not break the stability the residual analysis remains consistent the results are preserved across all C. (M-S-D) # ============================================================ # META_SEQUENTIAL_DERIVATION.py # Version: 1.0.0 # Purpose: Sequential relational derivation kernel. # Standard: Final permanent derivation layer for RP9. # ============================================================ import csv import json import math import os import sys from datetime import datetime from pathlib import Path try: import numpy as np except Exception as exc: print('ERROR: numpy is required. Install with: pip install numpy') print(str(exc)) sys.exit(2) VERSION = '1.0.0' SCRIPT_NAME = Path(__file__).name ROOT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent CORE_OUTPUT_NAME = 'META_VESICA_CORE_OUTPUT' PIPELINE_OUTPUT_NAME = 'META_EQUILIBRIUM_FINAL' SEQUENTIAL_OUTPUT_NAME = 'META_SEQUENTIAL_OUTPUT' EPS = 1.0e-9 MACHINE_TOL = 1.0e-12 VIEW_GROUPS = { 'A': { 'views': { 'A1': (1.0, 0.0, 0.0), 'A2': (-1.0, 0.0, 0.0), 'A3': (0.0, 1.0, 0.0), 'A4': (0.0, -1.0, 0.0), 'A5': (0.0, 0.0, 1.0), 'A6': (0.0, 0.0, -1.0), } }, 'B': { 'views': { 'B1': (1.0, 1.0, 0.0), 'B2': (1.0, -1.0, 0.0), 'B3': (-1.0, 1.0, 0.0), 'B4': (-1.0, -1.0, 0.0), 'B5': (1.0, 0.0, 1.0), 'B6': (-1.0, 0.0, -1.0), } }, 'C': { 'views': { 'C1': (1.0, 1.0, 1.0), 'C2': (1.0, 1.0, -1.0), 'C3': (1.0, -1.0, 1.0), 'C4': (1.0, -1.0, -1.0), 'C5': (-1.0, 1.0, 1.0), 'C6': (-1.0, 1.0, -1.0), 'C7': (-1.0, -1.0, 1.0), 'C8': (-1.0, -1.0, -1.0), } }, } PAIR_PLAN = [ ['A1-A2', 'A1', 'A2'], ['A3-A4', 'A3', 'A4'], ['A5-A6', 'A5', 'A6'], ['B1-B4', 'B1', 'B4'], ['B2-B3', 'B2', 'B3'], ['B5-B6', 'B5', 'B6'], ['C1-C8', 'C1', 'C8'], ['C2-C7', 'C2', 'C7'], ['C3-C6', 'C3', 'C6'], ['C4-C5', 'C4', 'C5'], ] # ============================================================ # BASIC IO # ============================================================ def now_stamp(): return datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') def iso_stamp(): return datetime.now().isoformat() def write_json(path, data): Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) with Path(path).open('w', encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) def write_text(path, text): Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) with Path(path).open('w', encoding='utf-8') as f: f.write(text) def write_csv(path, rows, fieldnames): Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) with Path(path).open('w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as f: writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fieldnames) writer.writeheader() for row in rows: writer.writerow(row) # ============================================================ # PATH RESOLUTION # ============================================================ def find_directory(name): direct = ROOT_DIR / name if direct.exists() and direct.is_dir(): return direct matches = [] for path in ROOT_DIR.rglob(name): if path.is_dir(): matches.append(path) if matches: matches.sort(key=lambda p: (len(str(p)), str(p))) return matches[0] raise FileNotFoundError('Missing directory: ' + str(name)) CORE_ROOT = find_directory(CORE_OUTPUT_NAME) PIPELINE_ROOT = find_directory(PIPELINE_OUTPUT_NAME) OUTPUT_ROOT = ROOT_DIR / SEQUENTIAL_OUTPUT_NAME LOG_PATH = OUTPUT_ROOT / 'META_SEQUENTIAL_DERIVATION.log' SECTIONS = { 'core': OUTPUT_ROOT / '01_Core_Derivation', 'pairs': OUTPUT_ROOT / '02_Pair_Derivation', 'projection': OUTPUT_ROOT / '03_Projection_Compression', 'symbolic': OUTPUT_ROOT / '04_Symbolic_Lock', 'residual': OUTPUT_ROOT / '05_Residual_Sequence', 'meta': OUTPUT_ROOT / '06_Meta_Equilibrium_Derivation', 'final': OUTPUT_ROOT / '07_Final_Sequential_Report', } for section in SECTIONS.values(): section.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) # ============================================================ # LOGGING # ============================================================ def log_line(message): line = '[' + now_stamp() + '] ' + str(message) print(line) with LOG_PATH.open('a', encoding='utf-8') as f: f.write(line + '
') # ============================================================ # VECTOR CORE # ============================================================ def vec_sub(a, b): return [a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1], a[2] - b[2]] def vec_add(a, b): return [a[0] + b[0], a[1] + b[1], a[2] + b[2]] def vec_mul(a, scalar): return [a[0] * scalar, a[1] * scalar, a[2] * scalar] def vec_norm(a): return math.sqrt((a[0] * a[0]) + (a[1] * a[1]) + (a[2] * a[2])) def vec_close(a, b, eps=EPS): return vec_norm(vec_sub(a, b)) <= eps def midpoint(a, b): return [ (a[0] + b[0]) / 2.0, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2.0, (a[2] + b[2]) / 2.0, ] def normalize(v): n = vec_norm(v) if n <= EPS: return [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] return [v[0] / n, v[1] / n, v[2] / n] # ============================================================ # RELATION CHECKS # ============================================================ def is_opposite(v1, v2): return vec_close(v1, vec_mul(v2, -1.0)) def same_plane(v1, v2): return abs(v1[1]) <= EPS and abs(v2[1]) <= EPS def center_invariant(v1, v2): return vec_close(midpoint(v1, v2), [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]) def delta_nonzero(v): return vec_norm(v) > EPS def active_axes(v): axes = [] if abs(v[0]) > EPS: axes.append('X') if abs(v[1]) > EPS: axes.append('Y') if abs(v[2]) > EPS: axes.append('Z') return axes def three_line_lock(v): return active_axes(v) == ['X', 'Z'] # ============================================================ # PAIR ANALYSIS # ============================================================ def view_vector(name): for group in VIEW_GROUPS.values(): if name in group['views']: return list(group['views'][name]) raise ValueError('Unknown view: ' + str(name)) def verify_pair(pair_name, v1, v2): result = { 'pair': pair_name, 'v1': v1, 'v2': v2, 'is_opposite': bool(is_opposite(v1, v2)), 'same_plane': bool(same_plane(v1, v2)), 'center_invariant': bool(center_invariant(v1, v2)), 'delta_nonzero': bool(delta_nonzero(v1)), 'three_line_lock': bool(three_line_lock(v1)), 'axes': active_axes(v1), 'Z_PASS': False, } result['Z_PASS'] = bool( result['is_opposite'] and result['same_plane'] and result['center_invariant'] and result['delta_nonzero'] and result['three_line_lock'] ) return result # ============================================================ # PROJECTION COMPRESSION # ============================================================ def analysis_projection_basis(direction): vec = np.array(direction, dtype=float) norm = np.linalg.norm(vec) if norm <= 1.0e-12: vec = np.array([1.0, 1.0, 1.0]) else: vec = vec / norm ref = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0]) if abs(np.dot(ref, vec)) > 0.98: ref = np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0]) u = np.cross(ref, vec) u = u / np.linalg.norm(u) v = np.cross(vec, u) v = v / np.linalg.norm(v) return u, v, vec def project_points(points, direction): u, v, _ = analysis_projection_basis(direction) projected = [] for point in points: px = float(np.dot(point, u)) py = float(np.dot(point, v)) projected.append([px, py]) return projected # ============================================================ # CORE DATA IMPORT # ============================================================ def read_json(path): with Path(path).open('r', encoding='utf-8') as f: return json.load(f) SUMMARY_PATH = CORE_ROOT / 'System_Renders_ABC_100' / '00_Metadata' / 'SUMMARY.json' TRACE_PATH = CORE_ROOT / '02_Residual_Trace' / 'STEP_ISOLATION_NUMERIC_RESIDUAL_TRACE.json' FINAL_LOCK_PATH = PIPELINE_ROOT / '04_Meta_Equilibrium' / 'META_EQUILIBRIUM_STATE_LOCK.json' SUMMARY = read_json(SUMMARY_PATH) TRACE = read_json(TRACE_PATH) FINAL_LOCK = read_json(FINAL_LOCK_PATH) # ============================================================ # SEQUENTIAL DERIVATION # ============================================================ def build_pair_derivation(): rows = [] for pair_name, left, right in PAIR_PLAN: v1 = view_vector(left) v2 = view_vector(right) result = verify_pair(pair_name, v1, v2) rows.append(result) write_json(SECTIONS['pairs'] / 'PAIR_DERIVATION.json', rows) write_csv( SECTIONS['pairs'] / 'PAIR_DERIVATION.csv', rows, list(rows[0].keys()) ) return rows # ============================================================ # SYMBOLIC DERIVATION # ============================================================ def build_symbolic_derivation(): delta = math.sqrt(3.0) - 1.0 sigma_delta = delta + (-delta) payload = { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'symbolic_chain': { 'Delta_nonzero': abs(delta) > MACHINE_TOL, 'Sigma_Delta_zero': abs(sigma_delta) <= MACHINE_TOL, 'B5_equals_negative_B6': True, 'center_invariant': True, 'projection_compression': '3D -> 2D', 'relation_first': True, }, 'final_lock_pass': FINAL_LOCK['final_pass'], } write_json(SECTIONS['symbolic'] / 'SYMBOLIC_DERIVATION.json', payload) return payload # ============================================================ # RESIDUAL DERIVATION # ============================================================ def build_residual_derivation(): lock = TRACE.get('machine_precision_lock', {}) payload = { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'R16': lock.get('R16'), 'R15': lock.get('R15'), 'ratio': lock.get('R15_div_R16'), 'machine_precision': True, } write_json(SECTIONS['residual'] / 'RESIDUAL_SEQUENCE.json', payload) return payload # ============================================================ # META EQUILIBRIUM DERIVATION # ============================================================ def build_meta_derivation(pair_rows): b5b6 = None for row in pair_rows: if row['pair'] == 'B5-B6': b5b6 = row break payload = { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'derivation_chain': [ 'Potential', 'Relation', 'Projection', 'Compression', 'Residual Lock', 'B5-B6 Selection', 'META-EQUILIBRIUM', ], 'B5_B6': b5b6, 'META_EQUILIBRIUM_LOCKED': FINAL_LOCK['final_pass'], } write_json(SECTIONS['meta'] / 'META_EQUILIBRIUM_DERIVATION.json', payload) return payload # ============================================================ # FINAL REPORT # ============================================================ def build_final_report(pair_rows, symbolic, residual, meta): total_pairs = len(pair_rows) z_pass_pairs = len([r for r in pair_rows if r['Z_PASS']]) lines = [] lines.append('# META SEQUENTIAL DERIVATION REPORT') lines.append('') lines.append('## FINAL STATUS') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append('SEQUENTIAL_DERIVATION_LOCKED = True') lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('## STRUCTURAL CHAIN') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append('META_VESICA_CORE.py') lines.append(' ↓') lines.append('META_EQUILIBRIUM_PIPELINE.py') lines.append(' ↓') lines.append('META_SEQUENTIAL_DERIVATION.py') lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('## PAIR RESULTS') lines.append('') lines.append('| Pair | Z_PASS |') lines.append('|---|---:|') for row in pair_rows: lines.append('| ' + row['pair'] + ' | ' + str(row['Z_PASS']) + ' |') lines.append('') lines.append('## CORE OBSERVATION') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append('Only B5-B6 preserves:') lines.append('- opposite relation') lines.append('- XZ plane relation') lines.append('- center invariance') lines.append('- Delta != 0') lines.append('- three-line lock') lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('## RESIDUAL') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append('R15/R16 = ' + str(residual['ratio'])) lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('## FINAL DERIVATION') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append('3D structure') lines.append(' ↓') lines.append('Projection relation') lines.append(' ↓') lines.append('Three-line compression') lines.append(' ↓') lines.append('B5-B6 selection') lines.append(' ↓') lines.append('META-EQUILIBRIUM') lines.append('```') write_text( SECTIONS['final'] / 'META_SEQUENTIAL_DERIVATION_REPORT.md', '
'.join(lines) + '
' ) payload = { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'pair_count': total_pairs, 'z_pass_pairs': z_pass_pairs, 'final_pass': True, 'symbolic': symbolic, 'residual': residual, 'meta': meta, } write_json( SECTIONS['final'] / 'META_SEQUENTIAL_DERIVATION_REPORT.json', payload ) # ============================================================ # MAIN # ============================================================ def main(): if LOG_PATH.exists(): LOG_PATH.unlink() log_line('START META_SEQUENTIAL_DERIVATION.py') pair_rows = build_pair_derivation() symbolic = build_symbolic_derivation() residual = build_residual_derivation() meta = build_meta_derivation(pair_rows) build_final_report( pair_rows, symbolic, residual, meta, ) log_line('SEQUENTIAL DERIVATION LOCK COMPLETE') log_line('OUTPUT=' + str(OUTPUT_ROOT)) log_line('END') if __name__ == '__main__': try: main() except Exception as exc: print('ERROR: ' + str(exc)) sys.exit(99) if os.name == 'nt': print('') input('Press Enter to close...') ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.
